rules.quote: never reintroduce a fixed port
rules.rule: Never reintroduce a hardcoded fixed port for the app's debugging or MCP endpoints; discover them through the published temp file instead.

rules.quote: one that merely spawns `bin.mjs` is fine
rules.rule: A .mcp.json that only spawns tools/owa-devtools-mcp/bin.mjs over stdio is allowed; a .mcp.json that names a URL is not.

rules.quote: `enableRemoteDebugging()` must stay synchronous and run before `ready`
rules.rule: Keep enableRemoteDebugging() synchronous and run it before the app's ready event.

rules.quote: must never be falsy
rules.rule: Never let the browserUrl value be falsy, because an empty one makes chrome-devtools-mcp launch its own Chrome.

rules.quote: Wrap after, never before.
rules.rule: When hooking the MCP transport's onmessage in server.connect, wrap it after the SDK has installed its own handler, never before.

rules.quote:
App-level tools read the DOM or use `ipcRenderer`; they never `import()` an
app module
rules.rule: App-level owa tools must read the DOM or use ipcRenderer and must never import() an app module.

rules.quote: needs an app RESTART to take effect
rules.rule: After editing anything under tools/owa-devtools-mcp/, restart the app for the changes to take effect.

rules.quote: the knowledge index needs `node extra-work/build-knowledge.mjs` re-run
rules.rule: After changing the knowledge sources, re-run `node extra-work/build-knowledge.mjs` to rebuild the knowledge index.

rules.quote:
so it sets `data-bs-theme` AND its
own `color`
rules.rule: In the chatbot popup, set data-bs-theme and its own color explicitly so text is not light-coloured on a dark background.

rules.quote: internal notes are for the model to read, never to quote
rules.rule: Never quote internal notes in a user-facing chatbot answer; the offline bot searches only kind 'manual' content.

rules.quote: A key is a thing the user has to be told about.
rules.rule: When the user has no AI provider key, tell the user about it and offer the Open AI settings button.

rules.quote:
every such button writes `setting-tabs` = `a` and opens
`setting.html` themselves rather than importing `openAISetting`
rules.rule: Buttons that open AI settings must write setting-tabs = a and open setting.html themselves, not import openAISetting, to avoid opening a second settings window.

rules.quote: the OpenAI list has to be filtered
rules.rule: Filter the OpenAI model list so only chat models are offered, excluding speech, image and embedding models.

rules.quote:
only reasoning models may be sent
`reasoning_effort`
rules.rule: Send reasoning_effort only to reasoning models, matched by /^(gpt-5(?!-chat)|o[0-9])/, never to gpt-5-chat-latest.

rules.quote: so the OpenAI budget is 6 000 and its effort is
rules.rule: For GPT-5 requests, set the max_completion_tokens budget to 6000 and reasoning effort to low.

rules.quote: the ask has to NAME what to demo
rules.rule: When asking the model to build a demo, the ask must name what to demo.

rules.quote: must not spend the 6-round tool budget
rules.rule: When building a guide, do not spend the tool-round budget checking every label with owa_find_ui; reach owa_guide_start before the budget runs out.

rules.quote: every **bold** phrase is a candidate control
rules.rule: In recipe steps, bold only control labels, since only bold phrases become guide targets; do not bold keystrokes or verbs.

rules.quote: No font comes from the internet
rules.rule: Do not load fonts from the internet in the chatbot window; use the font files the app ships.

rules.quote: nor `.btn` beyond a few zero-padding `btn-link` text buttons
rules.rule: In the 460px chatbot window, do not use the .btn class except for a few zero-padding btn-link text buttons, and do not use .app-data.

rules.quote: make sure all actions have backup action
rules.rule: Make sure every agent action that changes user data has a backup action, so it can be undone.

rules.quote: Snapshot BEFORE the
rules.rule: Before changing agent-managed user data, snapshot the affected file first using snapshotAgentFile, snapshotAgentEditing, or snapshotAgentFileForDelete, as applicable.

rules.quote: then `runWithAgentBackup(summary, restores,
rules.rule: Run each agent change through runWithAgentBackup(summary, restores, change) after its snapshot is taken.

rules.quote: a backup that cannot be saved throws `NoBackupError` and the change is refused.
rules.rule: Refuse the change if its backup cannot be saved.

rules.quote: A document delete is `trashAgentFile`
rules.rule: Delete a document by calling trashAgentFile, which moves it to the OS trash rather than removing it permanently.

rules.quote: takes its own backup first
rules.rule: Before an undo applies its changes, take a backup of its own.

rules.quote: a script checking undo must pass each change's own `undoId`
rules.rule: When a script checks undo, pass each change's own undoId so it does not undo another session's work.

rules.quote: except an undo, by its own id, of a change the same session made with a tool that takes nothing away
rules.rule: Exempt an undo, made by its own id, of a change the same session made with a non-removal tool, from the removal rate limit.

rules.quote: do not write a second address check anywhere
rules.rule: Do not write a second loopback/private-address check; reuse the shared checkIsLocalHostname predicate used by guardGuestSessionRequests and checkWebUrl.

rules.quote: Never `<all_urls>`
rules.rule: Never use `<all_urls>` as the URL filter for the AI Chat guest session's onBeforeRequest registration.

rules.quote: never narrow the filter to address patterns
rules.rule: Never narrow the AI Chat guest session's request filter to address patterns (such as 127.0.0.1); keep the filter on host wildcards and ws/wss schemes.

rules.quote: Keep the positive controls
rules.rule: Keep the positive-control checks in probe-aichat.mjs that confirm the site's own origin and a public wss:// echo still answer after changing the guest request wall.

rules.quote: it starts real loopback servers
rules.rule: When probing the guest wall, start real loopback servers in the probe rather than inferring refusal from a page's closed 1006 result.

rules.quote: read what ARRIVED
rules.rule: When verifying the guest wall, check what actually arrived at each loopback listener, not only what the page reports.

rules.quote:
no key, no MCP, no knowledge, and
the *Enable AI features* switch does not touch it
rules.rule: Do not treat the AI Chat window as the app's chatbot; it has no API key, MCP, or knowledge, and the Enable AI features switch does not affect it.

rules.quote: The guest is not a `list_pages` target
rules.rule: Do not expect the sandboxed AI Chat guest webview to appear as a page target in list_pages.

rules.quote:
the host page is a locked-down
window the `owa_*` tools refuse like the chatbot's
rules.rule: Do not use owa_* tools on the AI Chat host page; they refuse it just as they refuse the chatbot's window.

rules.quote:
nothing drives the site inside, and sign-in checks
(and claude.ai's Cloudflare box on a first visit) are by hand.
rules.rule: Do not attempt to drive the website inside the AI Chat guest; sign-in checks and Cloudflare verification must be done by hand.

rules.quote:
`webviewTag: true` is handed to that ONE page by its bounds key in
`genPopupWebPreferences`
rules.rule: Set webviewTag to true only for the single AI Chat page identified by its bounds key in genPopupWebPreferences, and not for any other page.

rules.quote: `allowpopups` must reach the element as the string `""`
rules.rule: Pass allowpopups to the webview element as the empty string "" and never as a boolean.

rules.quote:
If Google ever refuses a sign-in, rewrite the `User-Agent` HEADER for its
sign-in hosts only, never what the page's script reads.
rules.rule: If Google refuses a sign-in, change the User-Agent header only for Google sign-in hosts and never alter the user agent value the page's script reads.

rules.quote: `window.open` → system browser for a press only
rules.rule: Open window.open requests in the system browser only when triggered by a user press in that guest.

rules.quote:
`window.open` → system browser for a press only, no permissions but clipboard
write
rules.rule: Do not grant the AI Chat guest any permissions except clipboard write.

rules.quote:
the handler now hands the browser a page only
within 5 s of a press in that guest
rules.rule: Hand a page to the system browser only if it was triggered by a press in that guest within 5 seconds.

rules.quote: `*://` is http(s) only
rules.rule: Restrict AI Chat guest navigation to http and https URLs only, excluding ws and wss.

rules.quote: the filter named `ws://` and `wss://`
rules.rule: Filter ws:// and wss:// WebSocket URLs in the AI Chat guest navigation filter.

rules.quote:
The camera stays refused, even
beside the microphone
rules.rule: Keep camera permission refused for AI Chat guests, even when microphone access is granted.

rules.quote:
The permission CHECK must
answer yes for that page
rules.rule: The permission check must return yes for the site page that has been granted microphone access.

rules.quote:
`handlePopupWindowOpen`
lets an AI Chat page past the "already open" deny up to
`MAX_AI_CHAT_WINDOW_COUNT` (3
rules.rule: Allow an AI Chat page to open a new window past the already-open deny only up to MAX_AI_CHAT_WINDOW_COUNT (3) windows.

rules.quote: skips raising the open ones
rules.rule: When opening a new AI Chat window, do not raise the already-open AI Chat windows.

rules.quote:
The new window's
parent is the OPENER's parent
rules.rule: Set a new AI Chat window's parent to the opener's parent, not the opener window itself.

rules.quote: `webviewTag` is now spelled `false` for every other page
rules.rule: Set webviewTag to false for every page other than the AI Chat page.

rules.quote: use en's font-family as default app
rules.rule: Use English's font-family as the app's default font.

rules.quote: language's font-family, when available
rules.rule: Add the selected language's font-family to the font stack when one is available.

rules.quote: Language first, English after
rules.rule: Place the selected language's font-family before English's font-family in the font stack.

rules.quote: embed and set app-Google-Sans
rules.rule: Make every page embed and set app-Google-Sans.

rules.quote: remove any unused files to reduce bundle size
rules.rule: Remove any unused font files to reduce bundle size.

rules.quote: OFL.txt stays, as the licence requires
rules.rule: Keep OFL.txt when removing font files, as the licence requires.

rules.quote: English sets `fontFamily` but NOT `globalFontFamily` / `getFontFamilyFiles`
rules.rule: Set fontFamily for English but do not set globalFontFamily or getFontFamilyFiles for it.

rules.quote: A new page that skips `boot.ts` has to register English's faces itself
rules.rule: When a new page skips boot.ts, register English's faces itself.

rules.quote: and name `app-Google-Sans`
rules.rule: When a new page skips boot.ts, name app-Google-Sans as its font family.

rules.quote: Changing the screen stack means changing `screen.scss` and
rules.rule: When changing the screen font stack, change screen.scss and SCREEN_FONT_FAMILY together.

rules.quote: so do not add a face that
rules.rule: Do not add a font face that nothing draws.

rules.quote: Removing that copy is open-lyric's change
rules.rule: Do not remove open-lyric's bundled Google Sans copy from this repo; that change belongs to open-lyric.

rules.quote:
must NOT statically import
`LyricAppDocument`
rules.rule: Do not statically import LyricAppDocument into src/app-document-list/appDocumentHelpers.tsx, even to add a lyric branch to varyAppDocumentFromFilePath.

rules.quote:
When only the path is needed,
`checkIsVaryAppDocumentFilePathOnScreen(filePath)` remains the right call.
rules.rule: When only the file path is needed, call checkIsVaryAppDocumentFilePathOnScreen(filePath).

rules.quote:
Where
the getter may not be registered yet,
`await import('../lyric-list/LyricAppDocument')` first
(as `getSelectedVaryAppDocument` does).
rules.rule: When the lyric getter may not be registered yet, first run `await import('../lyric-list/LyricAppDocument')` before using it.

rules.quote: wraps its text in `<bdi>`
rules.rule: Wrap the text of any element carrying the `.app-ellipsis-left` class in a `<bdi>` element so the name renders in its true order.

rules.quote:
text
put there WITHOUT `<bdi>` reverses again
rules.rule: Never place text in an `.app-ellipsis-left` element without wrapping it in `<bdi>`, because it will render reversed.

rules.quote: never trust a name read off a thumbnail footer / path chip
rules.rule: Never trust a file name read off a thumbnail footer or path chip as the true file name.

rules.quote:
confirm
against the directory listing (or `fileSource.fullName` in the DOM `title`) before
using it in a selector, a bug report, or a test fixture
rules.rule: Before using a file name in a selector, bug report, or test fixture, confirm it against the directory listing or the DOM `title` attribute (`fileSource.fullName`).

rules.quote: `<div className="app" data-bs-theme={theme}
rules.rule: Wrap the AppWindowToolsComp controller in a `<div className="app" data-bs-theme={theme}>` with `style={{display:'contents'}}` so the theme tokens apply.

rules.quote: `lyricEditor` gets its own `#app-window-tools` div in the html
rules.rule: Give the lyricEditor entry its own `#app-window-tools` div in its HTML and mount the tools into it with `getReactRoot(containerId)`.

rules.quote: It and `experiment` also had to start calling `init()`
rules.rule: Make the lyricEditor and experiment entries call `init()` so the tools have a locale for `tran`.

rules.quote: `{ isRoutedToFocusedWindow: true }` (`src/lang/langHelpers.ts` →
rules.rule: Pass `{ isRoutedToFocusedWindow: true }` when registering a menu item through setAppMenuItems so the click goes to the focused window.

rules.quote: keep owner routing on purpose
rules.rule: Keep owner routing for the `lang`, `file`, `insert` and `view` menu keys, and do not pass isRoutedToFocusedWindow for them.

rules.quote: a press every open page has its own answer to
rules.rule: Pass `{ isSentToAllWindows: true }` only for a menu click that every open page answers by its own page.

rules.quote: calls `openChatbotPage()` in its OWN window rather than
rules.rule: Have AppAssistantComp call `openChatbotPage()` in its own window instead of asking the main process to open it.

rules.quote: `Object.defineProperty(file, 'appFilePath', {value: path})`.
rules.rule: When driving a file drop through CDP, stamp `appFilePath` on the File with `Object.defineProperty(file, 'appFilePath', {value: path})`.

rules.quote: (`file.appFilePath = path`) **silently does nothing**
rules.rule: Never stamp `appFilePath` on a File with plain assignment (`file.appFilePath = path`), because it silently does nothing.

rules.quote: in `evaluate_script`, build the drop as
rules.rule: When simulating a file drop with `evaluate_script`, build the drop using the File, Event, and dataTransfer pattern shown in the file.

rules.quote: **read back `file.appFilePath`** in the same call
rules.rule: After stamping `appFilePath`, read back `file.appFilePath` in the same call; if it is an empty string, treat the stamp as failed.

rules.quote: be a real `File`
rules.rule: Make the object that receives the `appFilePath` stamp a real `File` instance, not a plain object.

rules.quote: Before filing an untranslated-label bug, reload the window first.
rules.rule: Before filing an untranslated-label bug, reload the window first, since components that don't re-render on a locale switch may still show English until reload.

rules.quote:
Do not
re-add it in any form.
rules.rule: Do not re-add the appProvider mock (in any form) to the test setup or the codebase.

rules.quote: A new test whose import graph reaches `appProvider` must stub it in its own file:
rules.rule: When writing a new test whose import graph reaches appProvider, stub appProvider with vi.mock inside that test's own file.

rules.quote: only what it calls
rules.rule: When stubbing appProvider with vi.mock, include in the mock factory only the members the test actually calls.

rules.quote: copy the nearest one rather than
rules.rule: When writing an appProvider mock, copy the nearest existing test's mock rather than inventing a new shape.

rules.quote: must NOT mock it
rules.rule: Do not mock appProvider in src/server/appProvider.test.ts; that test must exercise the real injection path.

rules.quote: Prefer keeping shared constants in a LEAF module
rules.rule: Prefer keeping shared constants in a leaf module so that node-env tests never reach langHelpers.

rules.quote: import shared values from a module nobody mocks.
rules.rule: Import shared values from a module that no test mocks, so that mocked-module named exports are not undefined.

rules.quote:
Check the newest
  import, not the assertion.
rules.rule: When a whole test file fails with one error whose stack runs appProvider.ts → langHelpers.ts → a module, check the newest import rather than the assertion.

rules.quote: The kind stays in the extension
rules.rule: Keep the archive kind in the extension of a password-protected bundle (e.g. `.owapf.enc`, not a shared `.enc`) so drop gates and file dialogs can route it by name.

rules.quote: detection is by the container magic
rules.rule: Detect whether an archive is password-protected by its OWAENC container magic, never by its file name.

rules.quote: The dialog is loaded on demand.
rules.rule: Load the password dialog on demand, not through a static import.

rules.quote: the archive modules import only `src/helper/archivePasswordHelpers.ts`, which `import()`s it at call time
rules.rule: Have archive modules import only `src/helper/archivePasswordHelpers.ts`, which dynamically imports the dialog at call time.

rules.quote: holding every naming/extension rule
rules.rule: Keep every naming and extension rule in `src/helper/archiveNameHelpers.ts`.

rules.quote: Do not "stabilise" either one back behind a ref.
rules.rule: Do not wrap the `onChange` callback in `ArchivePasswordComp` or `ArchiveItemSelectorComp` back behind a ref to stabilise it.

rules.quote: Never put a popup between a re-ask and its
rules.rule: Never place a popup between a re-ask and its retry.

rules.quote: the two fields simply have to AGREE
rules.rule: Require the two password fields to match; both empty is the valid no-password case.

rules.quote: a value typed into Confirm alone is flagged instead of silently exporting unprotected
rules.rule: Flag a value entered only in the Confirm field as an error instead of exporting unprotected.

rules.quote: counts everything the bundle held that did not come in, not just the importer's own skips.
rules.rule: Make the bible import's `M skipped` count include everything the bundle held that did not come in, not only the importer's own skips.

rules.quote: It renders `title` and `invalidMessage` RAW
rules.rule: Have `ArchiveItemSelectorComp` render `title` and `invalidMessage` raw, and have callers translate them before passing them in.

rules.quote: A `tran(choice.title)` there blanks the whole popup
rules.rule: Do not call `tran()` on a bible row's title, since it is a key with no dictionary entry.

rules.quote: `dataArchiveMenuHelpers.handleImporting` opens it ONCE and passes the plain path to both `readDataArchiveManifest` and `importDataArchive`
rules.rule: In `dataArchiveMenuHelpers.handleImporting`, open a protected data archive once and pass the plain path to both `readDataArchiveManifest` and `importDataArchive`.

rules.quote: do not re-introduce a second open
rules.rule: Do not open a protected data archive a second time when importing it.

rules.quote: `maxmem` MUST be passed explicitly
rules.rule: Always pass `maxmem` explicitly to scrypt, because Node's 32MB default throws.

rules.quote: A new "needs your attention" state behind Settings follows the same trail:
rules.rule: When adding a new "needs your attention" state behind Settings, signal it with the same trail: the top-bar gear (SettingButtonComp), then the Settings tab (genTabTitle in SettingComp.tsx), then the item itself.

rules.quote: One amber, never animated
rules.rule: Show the needs-attention indicator in a single amber color and never animate it.

rules.quote: The look runs ONCE per launch, in the main window, 10 s after start
rules.rule: Run the package update check once per launch, in the main window, 10 seconds after app start.

rules.quote: with the checking code `import()`ed only then
rules.rule: Load the update-checking code via dynamic import only at that scheduled check time, not at startup.

rules.quote: the answer lives in MAIN
rules.rule: Store the package update check result in the main process, with null meaning no check has run yet.

rules.quote: must not ask the network again
rules.rule: Do not make a new network update check when a main-window page switch reloads the renderer.

rules.quote: Nothing installed asks the network nothing.
rules.rule: If no languages or extra binaries are installed, make no network request for update checks.

rules.quote: REPORT what they learn
rules.rule: Panels that already read update facts (the Languages tab, the Extra Binaries card) should report what they learn so that an update clears the attention dots in every window without a second network check.

rules.quote: A report carries only the half it knows.
rules.rule: An update report should include only the part of the update information the reporting panel actually knows.

rules.quote: No CSS reaches the screen unchecked.
rules.rule: Never send CSS to the projector screen unless it has passed the CSS code check (checkCssCodeProblem).

rules.quote: kept only when `checkCssCodeProblem`
rules.rule: Keep a person's own CSS only when checkCssCodeProblem passes it.

rules.quote: no `:host` / `::slotted` / `::part` or `<`
rules.rule: Reject a person's own CSS that contains :host, ::slotted, ::part, or <.

rules.quote: colours only from the parsed parts (a test holds it)
rules.rule: Take a built-in CSS effect's colours only from its parsed parts.

rules.quote: with a seeded PRNG
rules.rule: Generate built-in CSS effect markup with a seeded PRNG.

rules.quote: CSS effects move `transform` / `opacity` only
rules.rule: Animate only transform and opacity in CSS effects.

rules.quote: sizes in container units
rules.rule: Size CSS effects in container units (cqmin).

rules.quote: keyframes injected once per document
rules.rule: Inject CSS effect keyframes once per document.

rules.quote: must define `mainImage`, loops bounded by a constant
rules.rule: Ensure GLSL shader code defines mainImage and has loops bounded by a constant.

rules.quote: a CSS gradient of the colours always sits under the canvas
rules.rule: Keep a CSS gradient of the colours under the GLSL canvas so a runtime failure never leaves a transparent projector.

rules.quote: after a context loss that code is not restarted in that window
rules.rule: Do not restart the GLSL runtime in a window after its WebGL context is lost.

rules.quote: Live only where presented
rules.rule: Run animations live only where the page is presented (appProvider.isPageScreen).

rules.quote: Everywhere else -- tiles, Mini Screen, slide and run-sheet
rules.rule: Draw a still, not a live animation, for tiles, Mini Screen, slide and run-sheet previews, print, and PowerPoint.

rules.quote: created on demand
rules.rule: Create the shared offscreen WebGL still context on demand.

rules.quote: the whole context given back after 10 s idle
rules.rule: Release the shared still WebGL context after 10 s idle.

rules.quote: A tile moves only under the pointer
rules.rule: Move a tile's animation only while the pointer is over it.

rules.quote: waits until it has been in view
rules.rule: Hold a tile's animation until the tile has been in view.

rules.quote: Text contrast reuses the fill's, on the colour the animation READS as
rules.rule: Compute text contrast for an animation from the colour it reads as.

rules.quote: the animation is see-through (opacity under 100 or a translucent colour)
rules.rule: Do not use the read-colour contrast fill when the animation is see-through (opacity under 100 or a translucent colour).

rules.quote: A new effect needs its cover in both maps
rules.rule: Add a cover entry for each new effect in both CSS_COLOR_COVER_MAP and GLSL_COLOR_COVER_MAP.

rules.quote: blend is lifted onto the Screen Show box (`findScreenShowBackgroundBlend`)
rules.rule: Lift an animation's blend onto the Screen Show box unless the overlay has its own blend.

rules.quote: Customize and Shader Code debounce per instance
rules.rule: Debounce Customize and Shader Code changes per picker instance with genTimeoutAttempt(500).

rules.quote: Apply in the code panel flushes at once.
rules.rule: Flush a pending Shader Code change immediately when Apply is pressed in the code panel.

rules.quote: a fresh model uri per opening disposed after close
rules.rule: Create a fresh Monaco model uri for each code editor opening and dispose it after closing.

rules.quote: pinned top left ONLY when Properties places it
rules.rule: Pin a foreground overlay box top left only when Properties places it nowhere.

rules.quote: Live only in the screen window
rules.rule: Run foreground animations live only in the screen window.

rules.quote: while its session has nothing up and a picker PER SCREEN once it has
rules.rule: Show one picker when the session has nothing up, and one picker per screen once it has something up.

rules.quote: Customize-closed is the session's, shared.
rules.rule: Keep the Customize-closed state shared per session, not per screen.

rules.quote: ROW the one up is in (`findPaintShowRow`
rules.rule: Walk a show through the row the currently-up background is in (findPaintShowRow).

rules.quote: never as a string
rules.rule: Compare show rows as a fill or an animation, never as a string.

rules.quote: Its clocks live OUTSIDE React
rules.rule: Keep a show's timers outside React in applyAutoPlayRunners, keyed by the settings prefix.

rules.quote: a show started in one session ends the others'
rules.rule: End the shows in the other sessions when a show starts in one session.

rules.quote: A clear ends a show
rules.rule: End a running show when the background is cleared.

rules.quote: the TAB on what is up, not by the strip, which leaves with the clear
rules.rule: Call syncBackgroundPaintAutoPlayRunners from the tab based on what is up, not from the session strip.

rules.quote: A step goes through `applyBackgroundSrcWithSyncGroup`, never the press path
rules.rule: Apply a show step through applyBackgroundSrcWithSyncGroup, never through the press path.

rules.quote: walk only the session's OWN overlays, each keeping its look
rules.rule: Have foreground shows step only the session's own overlays, each keeping its look.

rules.quote: under `foreground-{fill,animation}{suffix}`
rules.rule: Key foreground show timers as foreground-{fill,animation}{suffix}.

rules.quote: key === base || key.startsWith(base + '-')
rules.rule: Test a timer's ownership by exact key match (key === base || key.startsWith(base + '-')).

rules.quote: Nothing is built at load and nothing is
rules.rule: Build no samples at load and keep none.

rules.quote: no list of every sample, no map, no cache
rules.rule: Keep no list of every sample, no map, and no cache for animation labels.

rules.quote: is found per category from its ONE effect's few looks
rules.rule: Find an animation's label per category from its one effect's few looks, after a ground pre-check.

rules.quote: Every src is unique across all categories (a test).
rules.rule: Keep every sample src unique across all categories.

rules.quote: changes only when the person changes it
rules.rule: Change the remembered category only when the person changes it.

rules.quote: 30 at most, the saved-preset store
rules.rule: Keep at most 30 pins in the shared pin list.

rules.quote: shown above the category's tiles whatever is chosen
rules.rule: Show pins above the category's tiles whatever is chosen.

rules.quote: the pin button is a SIBLING of the tile (never inside its
rules.rule: Render the pin button as a sibling of the tile, never inside its role=button element.

rules.quote: shown on hover or focus as an opacity change
rules.rule: Show the pin button on hover or focus as an opacity change.

rules.quote: it opens on the held one's side
rules.rule: Open the Dark/Light switch on the held sample's side.

rules.quote: moves only when a SAMPLE of the other side is held
rules.rule: Move the Dark/Light switch only when a sample of the other side is held.

rules.quote: the side is never stored, unlike the category
rules.rule: Never store the Dark/Light side.

rules.quote: every Light sample reads LIGHT to the text-contrast check
rules.rule: Make every Light sample read as light to the text-contrast check.

rules.quote: Pins hold both sides and show above either.
rules.rule: Let pins hold both Dark and Light samples and show above either side.

rules.quote: src for src what there always was
rules.rule: Keep the Dark side's samples identical, src for src, to what existed before.

rules.quote: a Light one is named `… (Light)` (the Dark name unchanged)
rules.rule: Name a Light sample with a ' (Light)' suffix and leave the Dark name unchanged.

rules.quote: ground colour first, dark enough for white words
rules.rule: Put the ground colour first in each category's palettes, dark enough for white words.

rules.quote: in 4, 3 and 2 numbered LOOKS
rules.rule: Give the first, second, and third lead effect 4, 3, and 2 numbered looks.

rules.quote: never faster or sparser
rules.rule: Make numbered looks never faster or sparser than their lead effect.

rules.quote: Read a fix's bookkeeping, not only its call
rules.rule: When evaluating a fix, read its bookkeeping (what it counts as a change), not only the model's call.

rules.quote: Shape the long writes FLAT.

rules.quote: Test the JOB (help prepare: draft, review, every fix pressed), not the first draft alone.

rules.quote: Edit `src/` only between runs

rules.quote: Describe what is wanted with no phrase to copy

rules.quote: Say a different word is different, in so many words.

rules.rule: Before blaming a hint's wording for poor results, read which hint each measured ask actually carries.

rules.quote: needs the scratch instance RELAUNCHED

rules.quote: Compare the two sides of ONE read, never a figure across reads.

rules.quote: a shortcut must never be a colour or a size

rules.rule: Before adjusting a `--bs-*` variable, check for other `.app <element>` hardcodes that may override it.

rules.quote:
Never run `npm run build` (or `npm run electron:build`, `npm run test:e2e`, or a
`pack:*`) while the dev app is up for `owa-devtools` verification.
rules.rule: Never run `npm run build`, `npm run electron:build`, `npm run test:e2e`, or any `pack:*` script while the dev app is running for owa-devtools verification.

rules.quote: `npm run lint` any time.
rules.rule: Run `npm run lint` at any time, whether or not the dev app is running.

rules.quote: Run it whenever, app up or not.
rules.rule: Run `npm run lint` whenever needed, whether or not the dev app is up.

rules.quote: do all live verification and state restoration FIRST
rules.rule: When a real build is needed during a live session, complete all live verification and state restoration before running the build.

rules.quote: read the log BODY
rules.rule: After running a build, read the full log body, not just the summary.

rules.quote: the app closed rather than any code fix
rules.rule: If a build fails with EPERM on a `db-exts/*.dll` file, close the app and re-run the build instead of changing code.

rules.quote: expect to relaunch with `env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE npm run dev` afterwards and re-verify
rules.rule: If a build must run mid-session, relaunch the app with `env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE npm run dev` afterwards and re-verify.

rules.quote:
check for a competing
stack before relaunching
rules.rule: Before relaunching the app, check for a competing dev stack.

rules.quote: `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process` sorted by `CreationDate`
rules.rule: On Windows, check for a competing dev stack by listing `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process` sorted by `CreationDate`.

rules.quote: macOS: `lsof +D electron-build` / `ps -o pid,lstart,args`
rules.rule: On macOS, check for a competing dev stack using `lsof +D electron-build` and `ps -o pid,lstart,args`.

rules.quote:
don't "restore" state on top of
a live session
rules.rule: Do not restore state on top of a live app session that is actively being driven.

rules.quote:
detect the gesture from the pointer events
themselves rather than reaching for a mouse event
rules.rule: On a drag surface, detect click or double-click gestures from the pointer events themselves rather than from mouse events (click, dblclick).

rules.quote:
and `stopPropagation()`s the
second so it starts no move
rules.rule: When handling a double-press on a drag header, call stopPropagation() on the second pointerdown so it does not start a move.

rules.quote:
Same trap awaits any future click handler on a resize handle
or on the body of a widget with `isBodyDraggable`
rules.rule: Do not attach click handlers to a resize handle or to the body of a widget with isBodyDraggable, since their pointerdown is canceled and no click will fire.

rules.quote: `CanvasItemAudio` is preview-only.
rules.rule: Treat the CanvasItemAudio canvas item as preview-only: do not sync it to the projected screen and do not preload it.

rules.quote: do not "unify" the two branches
rules.rule: Do not merge the preview-only audio sync branch in cleanupSlideContent with the sync wiring used for PPTX/DOCX embedded media.

rules.quote: mixing them up is the trap
rules.rule: Do not confuse checkIsRemoteMediaSource (is the source off this machine, http(s) only) with checkIsUrlMediaSource (is the source already a URL, http(s) or file://).

rules.quote: A link goes verbatim into `filePath` (video/audio) or `srcData` (image).
rules.rule: Pass a media link unchanged into filePath for video/audio items or into srcData for image items.

rules.quote: a URL is used verbatim, a plain path goes through `pathToFileURL`
rules.rule: In video and audio renderers, use a URL source verbatim and convert only a plain path with pathToFileURL.

rules.quote: A `file://` source run through `pathToFileURL` yields a mangled, dead `src`.
rules.rule: Do not pass a file:// media source through pathToFileURL.

rules.quote: It calls each class's **`genCanvasItemPropsFromLink(url, boxProps)`**, NOT `genCanvasItemFromLink(x, y, url)`
rules.rule: When converting a lyric attachment link to canvas item props, call genCanvasItemPropsFromLink(url, boxProps) and do not call genCanvasItemFromLink(x, y, url).

rules.quote: still yields its slide, just with no item
rules.rule: When an attachment link is unusable, still produce the attachment's slide but create no canvas item for it.

rules.quote: `blendMode` is absent or a real mode, never the string `normal`
rules.rule: When storing a canvas item's blendMode, leave it absent or set it to a real blend mode; never store the string `normal`.

rules.quote: It goes in `genBoxStyle`, NOT `genShapeBoxStyle`.
rules.rule: Place a canvas item's blend mode style in `genBoxStyle`, not in `genShapeBoxStyle`.

rules.quote: The editor puts it on `.editor-controller-box-wrapper`
rules.rule: In the Document Editor, apply a canvas item's blend mode to the `.editor-controller-box-wrapper` element.

rules.quote:
Leave that wrapper unpositioned: a positioned
  ancestor there becomes the boxes' `offsetParent` and moves every number the
  drag engine reads.
rules.rule: Leave the transparency checkerboard wrapper (in `BodyRendererComp`) unpositioned, without a position value, so it does not become the boxes' offsetParent.

rules.quote: It goes in `genShapeBoxStyle`, NOT `genBoxStyle`
rules.rule: Put canvas item shadow styling in `genShapeBoxStyle`, not in `genBoxStyle`.

rules.quote: `shadow` is absent or a whole repaired object, never a `none` kind
rules.rule: Never store a canvas item's shadow as an object with kind `none`; leave the shadow key absent or store a complete, repaired shadow object.

rules.quote: Only an unknown `kind` means "no shadow"
rules.rule: Treat a canvas item shadow as no shadow only when its kind is unknown, and repair every other invalid field instead of discarding the shadow.

rules.quote: a hand-edited document must never reach the screen as written
rules.rule: Never render a hand-edited canvas shadow exactly as written; repair its values before display.

rules.quote: ±200px offset
rules.rule: Clamp canvas shadow offsets to the range ±200px.

rules.quote: 0–200px blur
rules.rule: Clamp canvas shadow blur to the range 0–200px.

rules.quote: whole pixels
rules.rule: Round canvas shadow offset and blur values to whole pixels.

rules.quote: The panel reads its own state back through `toValidCanvasShadow`
rules.rule: Have the shadow properties panel read its state back through `toValidCanvasShadow` so it displays the values that will be stored.

rules.quote: never **Discard changed**
rules.rule: When reverting test edits in the Document Editor, use the Undo button and never use Discard changed.

rules.quote: the script is the way to measure it again
rules.rule: To measure casting latency again, use the scratchpad script that joins the TV as a second CASTV2 sender and compares its currentTime with the stream's newest tfdt.

rules.quote:
Do NOT use `await import('/src/…')` inside `mcp__owa-devtools__evaluate_script`
to inspect app module state
rules.rule: Do not use `await import(...)` of app modules inside the owa-devtools `evaluate_script` tool to inspect app module state.

rules.quote:
probe app state through the DOM (`data-react-comp-name`, class
names, `aria-pressed`, disabled buttons) or by walking React fibers off a DOM node
rules.rule: When probing app state in the running app, inspect the DOM (data attributes, class names, aria-pressed, disabled buttons) or walk React fibers from a DOM node rather than importing modules.

rules.quote: never by importing modules
rules.rule: Never probe app state by importing modules.

rules.quote:
Verify keyboard
behavior by observable app effects instead
rules.rule: Verify keyboard behavior by observing app effects rather than inspecting module internals.

rules.quote: Keep it that way
rules.rule: When a CDP port resolve fails, throw describeDeadPin()'s sentence, which names the pinned port, who set the pin, and what the app actually published. Do not revert to generic text like "start the app".

rules.quote: `resolveAppBrowserUrl` and `listCandidatePorts` must agree about which app is
rules.rule: Keep resolveAppBrowserUrl and listCandidatePorts in agreement about which app is being driven.

rules.quote: keep their precedence the same when adding another selector
rules.rule: When adding a new app selector, keep the precedence the same in both resolveAppBrowserUrl and listCandidatePorts.

rules.quote: check `owa_app_state` before acting when multiple
rules.rule: Check owa_app_state before acting when multiple instances of the same kind are open.

rules.quote:
Verify the guest effect at the glyph level
with `CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode` over the webview target's own
`/json/list` entry
rules.rule: To verify the effect of the font setting inside an AI Chat guest, check at the glyph level using `CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode` over the webview target's own `/json/list` entry, not `evaluate_script` on the host page.

rules.quote: Only the LAST message shows its options
rules.rule: Show quick-reply options only on the most recent chat message, never on earlier messages.

rules.quote: never while busy
rules.rule: Do not show quick-reply options while the chatbot is busy.

rules.quote: keeps its reference and chapter buttons at any position
rules.rule: On a Resources reading card, keep the reference and chapter buttons at any message position.

rules.quote: at any position, never while busy
rules.rule: Do not show Resources reading card buttons while the chatbot is busy.

rules.quote: The guide-rescue turn gets none
rules.rule: Do not show quick-reply options on a guide-rescue turn.

rules.quote: `handleAsking` skips the layers whenever `shownText` is set
rules.rule: Skip all quick-reply option layers whenever shownText is set.

rules.quote: `Yes` and `No thanks` are those exact words
rules.rule: Use exactly the labels "Yes" and "No thanks" for yes/no quick-reply options.

rules.quote: Pressing SENDS, unlike the type-ahead list, which fills the box
rules.rule: When a quick-reply option is pressed, send it as the user's message immediately rather than filling the input box.

rules.quote: The options are stored on the message
rules.rule: Store quick-reply options on the chat message they belong to.

rules.quote: re-capped on read
rules.rule: Re-apply the button cap when stored quick-reply options are read back.

rules.quote: first one that yields anything wins
rules.rule: Generate quick-reply options from the layers in order and use the first layer that yields any options.

rules.quote: The line is CUT at the marker
rules.rule: Cut the answer's line at the OPTIONS: marker wherever the marker appears in that line.

rules.quote: it is stripped whether or not it parsed into anything usable
rules.rule: Strip the OPTIONS: marker from the answer even when its options do not parse into anything usable.

rules.quote: caps both rows TOGETHER
rules.rule: Apply the button cap to the combined rows of buttons together, not separately to each row.

rules.quote: Adding a provider means deciding `isModelListRanked` for it.
rules.rule: When adding a new chatbot provider, decide its isModelListRanked value.

rules.quote: nothing is counted or sent by a thumb
rules.rule: Do not count or send anything when a thumb (👍 or 👎) is pressed on a chatbot answer.

rules.quote: a tally per model or a thumb carried by Report is a decision about what leaves the computer — ask first
rules.rule: Ask the user before adding a per-model tally of thumb presses.

rules.quote: a tally per model or a thumb carried by Report is a decision about what leaves the computer — ask first
rules.rule: Ask the user before sending a thumb rating along with a Report.

rules.quote: The history is ONE list for the whole window, not per tab
rules.rule: Keep a single ask-history list for the whole chat window, not a separate list per tab.

rules.quote:
Nothing longer than 2000 chars is remembered AT ALL rather than
  remembered truncated
rules.rule: Do not remember any asked question longer than 2000 characters, and never store it truncated.

rules.quote: Seeded from the saved conversations on first load
rules.rule: On first load, seed the ask history from the saved conversations.

rules.quote: Only `you` messages with NO `note`
rules.rule: When seeding history from saved conversations, include only user messages that have no note.

rules.quote: Only what came out of the BOX is recorded
rules.rule: Record an entry in the ask history only when it came out of the input box.

rules.quote: never `handleAsking` itself
rules.rule: Do not record questions in the ask history from within handleAsking itself.

rules.quote: Typing resets to -1; so does switching tabs.
rules.rule: Reset the history recall index to -1 when the user types or switches tabs.

rules.quote: **Alt**, not the bare arrows — those belong to the caret
rules.rule: Use Alt+Up/Down to recall history, not the bare arrow keys, which belong to the caret and the suggestion list.

rules.quote: A recall also dismisses the suggestion list
rules.rule: When a history recall happens, dismiss the suggestion list.

rules.quote: The caret is moved to the END of the recalled text
rules.rule: After recalling a history entry, move the caret to the end of the recalled text.

rules.quote: it must not fire on ordinary typing
rules.rule: Do not move the caret to the end on ordinary typing; only do so on a history recall.

rules.quote: The tip is RANDOM and never the same twice running
rules.rule: Show a random tip, and never show the same tip twice in a row.

rules.quote: a press gives another and returns the caret to the box
rules.rule: When the tip-shuffle key is pressed, show another tip and return the caret to the input box.

rules.quote: Every tip must name something the window actually does
rules.rule: Every tip must name a feature the chat window actually provides.

rules.quote: The two chevrons beside it WALK the list
rules.rule: Make the two chevrons beside the tip step through the tip list in order, rather than picking random tips.

rules.quote: the arrows are ordered and wrap
rules.rule: Make the tip chevrons wrap around at the ends of the tip list.

rules.quote: Every path remembers what it showed
rules.rule: Every code path that shows a tip must record that tip as shown (rememberChatTip).

rules.quote: `genChatTip` stays pure so the choosing is testable with no setting store
rules.rule: Keep genChatTip a pure function that does not read or write any setting store.

rules.quote: `+ count` before the modulo is load-bearing
rules.rule: When stepping back through tips, add the count before applying the modulo so the index never goes negative.

rules.quote: The arrows are drawn at half opacity, NOT revealed on hover
rules.rule: Draw the tip chevrons at half opacity, always visible, and do not hide them until hover.

rules.quote: Never persist the bytes.
rules.rule: Never persist attachment picture bytes to the saved chat session file; keep only the attachment description, and hold pictures in a bounded in-memory map.

rules.quote: `toValidAttachments` LISTS the fields it copies rather than spreading
rules.rule: When validating attachments in toValidAttachments, list each field to copy explicitly instead of spreading the object.

rules.quote: Never put a picture in `message.text`.
rules.rule: Never put picture data in a message's text field.

rules.quote: `toHistoryTurn` writes `(with a picture attached)` instead.
rules.rule: In history turns, write the placeholder "(with a picture attached)" in place of picture data.

rules.quote: Resize, do not merely re-encode.
rules.rule: Resize pictures before sending them to a model; do not merely re-encode them.

rules.quote: 1024px long edge
rules.rule: Resize pictures so the long edge is 1024px.

rules.quote: PNG first
rules.rule: Encode resized pictures as PNG first rather than JPEG.

rules.quote: An attachment-only ask must still carry a QUESTION.
rules.rule: An ask that consists only of attachments must still include a question text.

rules.quote: The transcript is NOT built from it
rules.rule: Do not build the chat transcript from the model-ask text; show the chip the user actually sent instead.

rules.quote: Refuse a blind model before the call.
rules.rule: Refuse to send an image to a model that cannot see images, before making the call.

rules.quote: The picker swallows the choosing click in the CAPTURE phase
rules.rule: The picker must swallow the choosing click in the capture phase, on mousedown as well as click.

rules.quote: Every chip is pressable
rules.rule: Make every attachment chip pressable.

rules.quote: by its STORED SELECTOR (`owa_highlight_selector`, the third client-only tool)
rules.rule: Ring a control by its stored selector, not by its words.

rules.quote: The chip's name comes from `labelPartsOf`, not `describe`'s `label`.
rules.rule: Take a chip's name from labelPartsOf, not from describe's label.

rules.quote: A comment with a backtick inside `picker.mjs`/`domMatch.mjs`/`guide.mjs`
rules.rule: Never put a backtick inside a comment in picker.mjs, domMatch.mjs, or guide.mjs.

rules.quote: Every ASSET chip opens the same preview
rules.rule: Make every asset chip open the same preview.

rules.quote: every preview downloads
rules.rule: Give every asset preview a Download action.

rules.quote: Content is read only on opening and dropped on closing
rules.rule: Read preview content only when the preview opens, and drop it when the preview closes.

rules.quote: `fsGetFileSize` is asked FIRST
rules.rule: Ask for the file size with fsGetFileSize before reading a file for preview.

rules.quote: Downloads is revealed, never copied twice
rules.rule: When a file is already in Downloads, reveal it rather than copying it again.

rules.quote: words the window already holds, NEVER by `kind`
rules.rule: Decide whether an asset is text by its file name or by words the window already holds, never by its kind.

rules.quote: Every picture chip carries a copy icon
rules.rule: Give every picture chip a copy icon.

rules.quote: it stops the click and the key so the press does not also open the preview or ring a control
rules.rule: A copy icon press must stop the click and the key so it does not also open the preview or ring a control.

rules.quote: goes through `copyImageToClipboard` in `attachmentHelpers.ts`
rules.rule: Copy pictures to the clipboard only through copyImageToClipboard in attachmentHelpers.ts.

rules.quote: which redraws anything that is not PNG first
rules.rule: Redraw any non-PNG image as PNG before copying it to the clipboard.

rules.quote: so an answer never pretends to have read it
rules.rule: Never let an answer pretend to have read a file that cannot be opened.

rules.quote: A line starting with / in the chatbot's ask box is a built-in command run through the app's own tools with NO model
rules.rule: Run a chatbot ask-box line starting with / as a built-in command through the app's own tools, without calling any model.

rules.quote: the button under its answer is a pseudo tool a model cannot fire
rules.rule: Never let a model start the button-under-answer pseudo tool.

rules.quote: never be startable by a model
rules.rule: Never make a built-in command startable by a model.

rules.quote:
`handleAsking` runs them BEFORE any provider is
looked at
rules.rule: Run built-in commands in handleAsking before any provider is looked at.

rules.quote: `/btw <words>` is the one slash line that DOES go to a model
rules.rule: Send the /btw <words> line to a model as the only slash line that goes to a model.

rules.quote:
NO tools (the MCP session is
not opened
rules.rule: For /btw general questions, call the model with no tools and do not open the MCP session.

rules.quote:
With no assistant, or one
that fails, the answer says a general question needs an assistant and
offers **Open AI settings** — the guide never answers it.
rules.rule: For /btw with no assistant or a failing one, say a general question needs an assistant and offer Open AI settings; never answer the question yourself.

rules.quote: (1) read the effect back after acting (screens before AND after)
rules.rule: When adding a new built-in command, read the effect back after acting, capturing screens before and after.

rules.quote:
(2) never
let a tool's error text reach the user
rules.rule: When adding a new built-in command, never let a tool's error text reach the user.

rules.quote:
(4) be filed by PAGE in `COMMAND_PAGE_MAP` when it reads or acts on one
page's state
rules.rule: When adding a new built-in command that reads or acts on one page's state, file it by page in COMMAND_PAGE_MAP.

rules.quote:
off its page it
is not offered and is refused with **Go to the Presenter**.
rules.rule: Off its page, do not offer a page-specific built-in command and refuse it with Go to the Presenter.

rules.quote: Picture them with chrome-devtools' `take_screenshot` given
rules.rule: To picture the help window or the AI Chat window, use chrome-devtools' take_screenshot with that page's id from list_pages, not owa_screenshot.

rules.quote: Set `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` (or run from PowerShell).
rules.rule: When running a script from Git Bash with a leading-slash argument, set MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 (or run the script from PowerShell) so the argument is not rewritten.

rules.quote: a driver must COUNT tabs, never read `.disabled`
rules.rule: Count the chatbot window's tabs to detect the 12-tab cap; never read the New chat control's .disabled property.

rules.quote: Close the tabs first (`button.chat-tab-close`, one click per React render,
rules.rule: Close the chatbot window's tabs first by clicking button.chat-tab-close, one click per React render.

rules.quote: with a wait between)
rules.rule: Wait between successive button.chat-tab-close clicks.

rules.quote: read a message's author from its **Ask again**
rules.rule: Read a message's author from the title of its Ask again button, not from the message text.

rules.quote: Put the default back before
rules.rule: Before the last ask, restore the window's default provider and model by running a throwaway /commands with --provider=Claude --model=claude-sonnet-5.

rules.quote: read the provider on every answer's head row.
rules.rule: Read the provider from the head row of every answer.

rules.quote: Escape in the box, then click something that
rules.rule: When words are in the focused box and the type-ahead list covers the newest answer's tool row, press Escape in the box before clicking that answer's tool-row button.

rules.quote: is not the box (the answer's ASSISTANT label), then press; or keep the box empty.
rules.rule: Before pressing a newest-answer tool-row button, click something that is not the box, such as the answer's ASSISTANT label, or keep the box empty.

rules.quote: Hold the session in a background script
rules.rule: Hold the Debugger breakpoint session in a background script.

rules.quote: restart it after an edit hot-reloads the window
rules.rule: Restart the breakpoint session after an edit hot-reloads the window.

rules.quote: on the way out remove the breakpoint, `Debugger.disable` and delete the global.
rules.rule: When finished, remove the breakpoint, call Debugger.disable, and delete the page global.

rules.quote: Read `owa_app_state.instances[0].pid` on every answer
rules.rule: Read owa_app_state.instances[0].pid on every answer.

rules.quote: Close down to one before the first ask of every batch.
rules.rule: Before the first ask of every batch, close the chatbot window's tabs down to one.

rules.quote: Close tabs from the END down to one
rules.rule: Before a corpus run and again before a second batch, close tabs from the last one back to one, keeping the first tab.

rules.quote: Drive the dev instance by its own port
rules.rule: Drive the dev instance through its own port by reading GET http://127.0.0.1:<port>/json and opening the page's webSocketDebuggerUrl, not through owa-devtools tools.

rules.quote: call `process.exit(0)` at the end
rules.rule: Call process.exit(0) at the end of a script that opens a WebSocket to the dev instance.

rules.quote: Verify such a window by CLASS and by `getBoundingClientRect`
rules.rule: Verify a hidden or minimised chatbot window by its CSS class and getBoundingClientRect, not by screenshot.

rules.quote: wait ~1 s after a scroll for the throttled frame
rules.rule: After scrolling a hidden chatbot window, wait about 1 second for the throttled frame that dispatches the scroll event.

rules.quote: take the pictures once the window is in front.
rules.rule: Take screenshots of a chatbot window only once the window is in front.

rules.quote: assign `scrollTop`
rules.rule: To scroll a hidden chatbot window, assign scrollTop instead of dispatching mouseWheel events.

rules.quote: say in the row that the desktop was locked.
rules.rule: When measuring while the desktop is locked, state in the result row that the desktop was locked.

rules.quote: wait node-side, and
rules.rule: When the desktop is locked, wait on the Node side rather than with an in-page timer.

rules.quote: Bring the app to the front before a tool-driven or timed measurement.
rules.rule: Bring the app to the front before a tool-driven or timed measurement.

rules.quote: Read window state off the OS, not the page
rules.rule: Determine window visibility from the OS, not from document.visibilityState.

rules.quote: Read the picker back after the change event and retry until it says what
rules.rule: After a focus pick change event, read the picker back and retry until it shows the requested focus.

rules.quote: batch the `tools/` edits, then verify.
rules.rule: Batch edits under tools/owa-devtools-mcp/ before verifying, since each edit restarts the app under npm run electron:dev.

rules.quote: Read `owa_list_screens` straight after any acting follow-through and hide what
rules.rule: After any acting follow-through, read owa_list_screens and hide what the driver turned on before doing anything else.

rules.quote: what the driver's own press turned on, and only with nothing else using the app
rules.rule: Hide only what the driver's own press turned on, and only when nothing else is using the app.

rules.quote: any `/owa-enhance-chatbot` run quotes those fields for a cost claim
rules.rule: When making a cost claim in an /owa-enhance-chatbot run, quote the provider's own usage fields rather than an estimate.

rules.quote: any change to `genSystemPrompt` or the tool list re-checks that round 2's `cache_read_input_tokens` is still ≥ the prefix
rules.rule: After any change to genSystemPrompt or the chatbot's tool list, re-check that round 2's cache_read_input_tokens is still at least the size of the prefix.

rules.quote: never the setting
rules.rule: Take the app language from `document.documentElement.lang` (via `getAppLangCode`), never from the language setting.

rules.quote: Adding a language is adding that file (and its `tran()` dictionary)
rules.rule: To add a language, add its `assistant.json` file and its `tran()` dictionary, without changing code.

rules.quote: no code names Khmer
rules.rule: Never name a specific language (such as Khmer) in code.

rules.quote: never weigh a language by name
rules.rule: Never weigh a language by its name when detecting the language of a line.

rules.quote: A language's list is the fix for a line it loses
rules.rule: When a line is detected as the wrong language, fix it by adding words to that language's word list.

rules.quote: go through the chatbot's own `tran` / `tranLabel` / `fillWords`
rules.rule: Route window words through the chatbot's own `tran`, `tranLabel`, and `fillWords` helpers.

rules.quote: a new user-facing string in the chatbot goes through `tran()`
rules.rule: Route every new user-facing string in the chatbot through `tran()`.

rules.quote: with its key in every language's dictionary
rules.rule: Give each new `tran()` string a key in every language's dictionary.

rules.quote: a new language-specific rule goes into `assistant.json`
rules.rule: Put any new language-specific rule into `assistant.json`, not into code.

rules.quote: never put a per-question line into the system prompt
rules.rule: Never put a per-question line into the system prompt.

rules.quote: What a question is in goes at the END of the user turn
rules.rule: Place the reply-language line for a question at the end of the user turn.

rules.quote: The doubt always goes to the app language
rules.rule: When unsure which language a question is in, answer in the app language.

rules.quote: are the app's words
rules.rule: Answer yes/no words, numbers, commands, and pressed inputs (chips, options, suggestions, card rescues) in the app's language.

rules.quote: read only for an INSTALLED language
rules.rule: Read a language's `typed.json` only when that language is installed.

rules.quote: must keep their language
rules.rule: Every supported question, in English and in every packaged language with a `questions.json`, must keep its language (checked by `anyLanguage.test.ts`).

rules.quote: needs a sample line there
rules.rule: When a language is added to `questions.json`, add a sample line for it there.

rules.quote: A line is written only for an ask that carries `askedText` or `replyLang`
rules.rule: Write a reply-language line only for an ask that carries `askedText` or `replyLang`.

rules.quote: NOT `Intl.Segmenter`
rules.rule: Do not use `Intl.Segmenter` to split Khmer words for search.

rules.quote: Chips are judged by SCRIPT, not by package.
rules.rule: Judge chips by their script, not by their language package.

rules.quote: Generic: no language named.
rules.rule: Keep the translation logic generic, naming no language.

rules.quote: counting every English word an answer SHOWS, not only the window's.
rules.rule: When measuring language coverage, count every English word an answer shows, not only the window's words.

rules.quote: example kept as in English

rules.quote:
An

rules.quote: The chatbot's box is no longer `disabled={isBusy}`.

rules.quote: **Add** appears beside **Stop** once there are words in it
rules.rule: Show the Add control beside the Stop control only once the ask box contains text.

rules.quote: Drain only where the next model call is guaranteed.

rules.quote: the loop drains it AFTER pushing the tool results
rules.rule: In the askLlmBot loop, call the takeAdditions callback after pushing the tool results.

rules.quote: Draining near the early return would silently swallow what the user typed.

rules.quote: whatever is still queued when the promise settles is the leftover, asked as its own question with a note saying why.

rules.quote: `tool_result` blocks come FIRST
rules.rule: In a user message carrying tool results, place the tool_result blocks before any text blocks.

rules.quote: the addition is a trailing text block inside that same message.
rules.rule: Send a folded addition as a trailing text block inside the same user message that carries the tool results, after the tool_result blocks.

rules.quote: A second consecutive `user` message is MERGED rather than refused
rules.rule: Never send a second consecutive user message, since the API merges it silently instead of rejecting it.

rules.quote: The queue lives on the pending ask, not in the loop
rules.rule: Store the addition queue on the pending ask object, not inside the askLlmBot loop.

rules.quote: `handleCancelling` puts everything — taken and untaken alike — into the draft.
rules.rule: When a call dies mid-round, have handleCancelling move all queued additions, both taken and untaken, back into the draft.

rules.quote: Nothing a volunteer typed is ever dropped.

rules.quote: Route off `pendingAskListRef`, never off `isBusy`

rules.quote: never send an addition to a walkthrough rescue

rules.quote: A tool's error text may never reach the user.

rules.quote: Anything that asks "how does a user get to window X" reads the descriptor:
rules.rule: When answering how a user reaches a window, read the window's descriptor in botFocus.mjs rather than any other map.

rules.quote: Never write a second map beside it.
rules.rule: Never create a second map of windows and how to reach them beside the descriptor in botFocus.mjs.

rules.quote:

rules.rule: Navigate to main windows using owa_goto_page, with its enum derived from BOT_MAIN_WINDOW_PAGES.

rules.quote:
an unmapped

rules.rule: When a tool has no mapped phrase, fall back to the step text `Looking something up`.

rules.quote: printing the tool name is the cheap implementation
rules.rule: Do not print the raw tool name as the step text.

rules.quote:
A test fails on an underscore
  reaching the line

rules.quote:

rules.quote: Open a step before the work and close it in a `finally`
rules.rule: Open a step before its work begins and close it in a `finally` block.

rules.quote: It rides its **own module store**, not `ChatbotAppComp`'s state

rules.quote: Cleared when an ask starts, when the last one ends, and at a Stop

rules.rule: Do not fall through to the offline manual bot when a chatbot request is stopped.

rules.quote: never a boolean flag

rules.rule: Verify app-side changes through the app's own host at `mcpUrl`.

rules.rule: After closing an orphaned app's main window, touch a file under `tools/owa-devtools-mcp/` so nodemon relaunches the app.

rules.quote: `taskkill` is refused

rules.quote: `owa_click` by a title WITH its shortcut

rules.quote: takes "John 3:16" as the user said it

rules.quote: Default unless it holds it already
rules.rule: Before showing a Bible verse on screen, save it to the Bibles list's Default unless that list already holds it.

rules.quote: so say it back
rules.rule: When an answer involves the version the Bible Lookup is on, name that version in the answer.

rules.quote: Any test whose name claims a thing exists must go and look.

rules.quote: Grade a wrong-window answer's first step against the real control, not its intent.
rules.rule: When grading a wrong-window answer's first step, check it against the real control on the page the user is on, not against what the step was meant to do.

rules.quote: step 1 names the real control for THAT page
rules.rule: In the per-page system prompt text, step 1 must name the real control for that page.

rules.quote: The guide's own bot is NOT given

rules.quote: Keep it even when the prompt fact

rules.quote: check the manual before the prompt or the ranking.

answer with a

rules.quote:

rules.quote: treat `node extra-work/build-knowledge.mjs` as part of

rules.quote: No app restart is needed

rules.rule: When reviewing or building any acting tool in tools/owa-devtools-mcp, check whether it reports what the action actually DID (its effect), not only the element it touched, and make it report the effect.

rules.quote:
never let a unit

rules.quote: Never app files through it.
rules.rule: Never serve app files through the tunnel.

rules.quote:
downstream code reads the

rules.rule: Downstream code must read the request sender from the tunnel-aware sender helper (`readRequestSender`), never from `req.socket.remoteAddress`.

rules.quote: don't reuse for encrypt

rules.quote:
never a black box or a

rules.quote:
a background camera goes up at once instead of waiting for metadata

rules.quote:
never `false` in

a camera that opens after the display was lost is closed,

rules.quote:

rules.quote: anything left is ended by process id

rules.quote: leave a gap between asks

rules.rule: When a driver must be written, start from these rules.

rules.quote: pass `--testTimeout=60000`

rules.quote: it is a decision for the user.

rules.quote: pre-load what is lazy
rules.rule: In a test, pre-load lazily imported modules or chunks (e.g., in a beforeAll hook) so their cold load is not raced.

rules.quote: never give a slow test a hard timeout under 60 s
rules.rule: Never give a slow test a hard timeout under 60 s.

make the slow step slow on purpose in the test rather than
retrying

rules.quote: forwards only to an address SAVED in

rules.quote: Redirects are refused

rules.quote: answers capped at 4 MB

rules.quote: Stop cancels by request id

rules.quote: still nothing that loads, unloads or writes

rules.rule: Wait for the Exported to message before reading the archive.

rules.quote: poll longer
rules.rule: Poll longer for the Explorer reveal window when it comes after 7 seconds.

rules.quote: close only a window that is NEW.
rules.rule: Close only a window that is new, meaning one that appeared during the test.

rules.quote: drop on a tile by its full label
rules.rule: Drop on a tile by its full label, such as zz-x zz-x.png.

rules.quote: aim at the exact name
rules.rule: Aim at the exact name rather than a broad pattern.

rules.quote: answer questions inside the dialog, by its uid
rules.rule: Answer questions inside the dialog, targeting it by its uid.

rules.quote: queued input boxes clear with repeated **Escape**
rules.rule: Clear queued input boxes by pressing Escape repeatedly.

rules.quote: seed NO data-folder key (`stay-awake` included) in that profile
rules.rule: On a fresh profile used for Use This Folder, seed no data-folder key, including stay-awake.

rules.quote: fingerprint (`local-storage` sha1 + top level) before and after.
rules.rule: Fingerprint the profile (local-storage sha1 and top level) before and after the test.

rules.quote: must be opened by a process started with PowerShell `Start-Process`
rules.rule: Open the held file from a process started with PowerShell Start-Process.

rules.quote: Prove it before pressing
rules.rule: Prove the file is held before pressing Move Now.

rules.quote: renaming the folder must be refused
rules.rule: Confirm that renaming the folder is refused before pressing Move Now.

rules.quote: close it, wait, retry.
rules.rule: If a Folder In Use shell dialog appears after a Recycle Bin call, close it, wait, and retry.

rules.quote: do not steal focus to test a focus listener
rules.rule: Do not steal OS focus to test a focus listener.

rules.quote: raw CDP `Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled` on the page's own
rules.rule: To fire a focus event, send raw CDP Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled on the page's own webSocketDebuggerUrl, toggling false then true.

rules.quote: set it back to `false` afterwards.
rules.rule: Set Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled back to false afterwards.

rules.quote: Answer the dialog first
rules.rule: When a question dialog is up, answer the dialog before clicking the Desktop card's Close.

rules.quote: find the card's Close from its title DOWN in a snapshot
rules.rule: Find the Desktop card's Close button from its title downward in a snapshot, not the dialog's Close.

rules.quote: clean the stick from disk.
rules.rule: Clean the USB stick from disk, since the app cannot delete files on a subst drive.

rules.quote: an agent never gets Delete Permanently
rules.rule: Never use Delete Permanently.

rules.quote: A data folder is required.
rules.rule: Treat a data folder as required: when none is in use, show only the no-data-directory gate in every window except Settings.

rules.quote:
A missing or unset folder opens Path Settings with
  the box focused
rules.rule: When the data folder is missing or unset at start-up, do not show a start-up dialog; open Path Settings with the folder box focused instead.

rules.quote:
a missing chosen folder is only marked _Missing_ in Recent
  Folders
rules.rule: When the chosen data folder is missing, only mark it as Missing in Recent Folders; do not show a warning dialog naming it.

rules.quote:
The **default `~/.owa/open-worship-data` is a SUGGESTION**, created only when
  **Use This Folder** is pressed.
rules.rule: Treat the default ~/.owa/open-worship-data folder as a suggestion only, and create it only when the user presses Use This Folder.

rules.quote: never pick a folder for the person
rules.rule: Never choose a data folder on the user's behalf.

rules.quote: never offer the Desktop back
rules.rule: Never offer the Desktop as a data folder location.

rules.quote: never one on the Desktop
rules.rule: Do not recommend a data folder on the Desktop.

rules.quote: anything that reads data must go through a data folder in use
rules.rule: Any code that reads data must go through the data folder currently in use.

rules.quote: A Desktop data folder in use is said in EVERY window
rules.rule: When a Desktop data folder is in use, display the Desktop data-folder warning card in every window, not just once per launch.

rules.quote:
the assistant stays reachable with no
  folder
rules.rule: Keep the AI assistant reachable even when no data folder is in use.

rules.quote: the AI keys stay global
rules.rule: Keep the AI provider keys global, not tied to the data folder.

rules.quote: read the real directory off the UI (`PathSelectorComp` text in the Background panel) or check the `defaultStorageDirPath` parent dir first when verifying anything that writes user files in dev
rules.rule: When verifying anything that writes user files in dev, first determine the real data directory by reading the PathSelectorComp text in the Background panel or by checking the parent directory of appLocalStorage.defaultStorageDirPath, rather than assuming a -dev suffixed path.

rules.quote: if `npm run dev` dies with `Port 3000 is already in use`, find the owner
rules.rule: When `npm run dev` fails with `Port 3000 is already in use`, identify the process that owns port 3000 before taking any action.

rules.quote: `lsof -nP -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN` then `ps -o pid,lstart,args -p <pid>` (macOS)
rules.rule: On macOS, find the owner of port 3000 by running `lsof -nP -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN`, then `ps -o pid,lstart,args -p <pid>` on the reported pid.

rules.quote: leave it, and use that session's app
rules.rule: If the process on port 3000 is a live session's server, leave it running and use that session's app instead of stopping it.

rules.quote: stop only its tree, by pid
rules.rule: If the process on port 3000 is a leftover server, stop only its process tree, identified by pid.

rules.quote: never by image name
rules.rule: Never stop dev server processes by image name (for example, taskkill by executable name).

rules.quote: Before filing a "must be used within" error, compare its time with `date -r` on the files written around it
rules.rule: Before filing a "must be used within" error while the dev app is running, compare the error's time with `date -r` on the files written around it.

rules.quote: Compare what is served with what is on disk
rules.rule: When a dev-server edit seems half-applied, compare the served module with the file on disk.

rules.quote: Do this before reasoning about why half a change "does not work".
rules.rule: Compare the served module with the file on disk before reasoning about why a half-applied change does not work.

rules.quote: `touch` the file when they differ
rules.rule: When the served module differs from the file on disk, `touch` the file.

rules.quote: Add the import FIRST
rules.rule: When an edit adds a call and its import, add the import first.

rules.quote: `touch` every edited file and reload
rules.rule: If the served code is stale after edits, `touch` every edited file and reload the page.

rules.quote: Curl it with NO query
rules.rule: When curling a served dev-server module to check its content, request the plain path with no query string.

rules.quote: never send two `Edit`s to ONE file in the same batch
rules.rule: While the dev app is running, never send two Edit calls to the same file in one batch.

rules.quote: write the imported file first, then the import
rules.rule: When creating a new module and an import of it, write the imported file first, then the import.

rules.quote: `curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://localhost:3000/src/<path>`
rules.rule: To check whether a new dev-server module still returns 404, curl its path and read the HTTP status code.

rules.quote: `echo x > html/.owa-nudge.tmp`, wait a second, then `rm` it
rules.rule: To make the dev server drop a cached 404 for a new module, write a temporary file under `html/`, wait a second, then remove it.

rules.quote: before diagnosing a "shortcut is dead" symptom, check `performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')` / `performance.now()` for a recent reload
rules.rule: Before diagnosing a dead-keyboard-shortcut symptom, check the performance navigation entries and `performance.now()` for a recent reload.

rules.quote: If one happened, `navigate_page` reload
rules.rule: If a recent reload happened, reload the page with `navigate_page`.

rules.quote: re-run the whole open-then-drive sequence in ONE `evaluate_script` call
rules.rule: After a reload, re-run the whole open-then-drive sequence in a single `evaluate_script` call.

rules.quote: never print <temp>/open-worship-app-cdp/<pid>.json
rules.rule: Never print the discovery file at <temp>/open-worship-app-cdp/<pid>.json, because it contains the per-launch MCP bearer token.

rules.quote: list the directory — the file NAME is the pid — or print single fields
rules.rule: To check whether an app was relaunched, list the <temp>/open-worship-app-cdp/ directory (the file name is the pid) instead of printing the discovery file.

rules.quote: print single fields
rules.rule: When a field from the discovery file is needed, print only that single field (for example pid or startedAt) rather than the whole file.

rules.quote: reads it itself
rules.rule: A script that needs the MCP token must read the discovery file itself.

rules.quote: logs nothing of it
rules.rule: A script that reads the MCP token must not log or print any of it.

rules.quote: do not add a fourth copy
rules.rule: Do not add a fourth hand-rolled archive helper copy; implement a new bundled item kind through the shared config-object layer instead.

rules.quote: A new bundled item kind should be one more of these.
rules.rule: When adding a new bundled item kind, implement it as one more config-object re-export file like the existing document, bible list, and bible note archive helpers.

rules.quote: do not model a new kind on it
rules.rule: Do not model a new bundled item kind on `bibleNoteItemArchiveHelpers.ts`.

rules.quote: Change a rule ONCE, there.
rules.rule: When changing a rule shared by documents and presenting flows, change it once in `src/helper/appArchiveHelpers.ts` rather than in each feature's helper.

rules.quote: applied **only to a document this import WROTE**
rules.rule: When importing archives, apply color notes and canvas re-pointing only to documents that the import wrote, never to reused documents.

rules.quote: Both hooks walk the file as **raw JSON**, never through `Note`/`NoteItem`
rules.rule: When walking a note file's embedded content in archive hooks, process it as raw JSON, never through the `Note` or `NoteItem` classes.

rules.quote: Passing a raw document directly to the composed policy would undo the hydration protection.
rules.rule: Never pass a raw document directly to the composed slide sanitization policy (sanitizeSlideHtml); raw HTML must go through the raw policy (sanitizeHtml) first.

rules.quote:
Electron `file:`, `blob:` and `owa:` URI exceptions apply only to `src` on
img/video/audio/source, never links or frames.
rules.rule: Allow Electron file:, blob:, and owa: URI exceptions only on src attributes of img, video, audio, and source elements; never apply them to links or frames.

rules.quote:
Plain Text items escape markup
and preserve newlines; stored documents are not rewritten.
rules.rule: Escape markup in Plain Text items while preserving newlines, and do not rewrite stored documents.

rules.quote: calling HTML sanitization without a DOM fails closed.
rules.rule: When HTML sanitization is called without a DOM available, fail closed (refuse to sanitize and do not return unsanitized content).

rules.quote:
No cache of documents is
kept.
rules.rule: Do not cache documents in the sanitization layer.

rules.quote:
Clear DOMPurify's removed-node
list after every call, since it can retain the parsed document tree.
rules.rule: Clear DOMPurify's removed-node list after every sanitization call.

rules.quote: The raw policy runs BEFORE `genSlideHtml`'s static render, never inside it
rules.rule: Run the raw sanitization policy before genSlideHtml's static render, never inside the static render.

rules.quote:
Pin `OWA_CDP_PORT` on a
dedicated MCP client
rules.rule: When running live checks, pin OWA_CDP_PORT on a dedicated MCP client.

rules.quote: loading that route alone cannot prove projection.
rules.rule: Do not treat loading the screen.html route alone as proof of projection in live checks.

rules.quote: stages 0-5 only (6+ = stage 1)
rules.rule: In the document stage previewer, offer only stages 0-5 and treat stage 6 and above as stage 1.

rules.quote: max six panes
rules.rule: Show at most six stage panes in the document stage previewer.

rules.quote: No gear, no style
rules.rule: Do not add a gear control or a style panel to the document stage previewer.

rules.quote: stays the base slide everywhere
