rules.rule: Do not rewrite a document's slide data per stage; keep the base slide on every stage (click, drag, highlight, media, transitions, and map all use it).

rules.quote: be no change at all
rules.rule: On stage 0, show the document with no change.

rules.quote: stage 1 same stage 0 but has indexing
rules.rule: On stage 1, show the same as stage 0 but with indexing added.

rules.quote: Stage 0 never opens the document.
rules.rule: On stage 0, never open the document.

rules.quote: the coming slides are NEVER dimmed
rules.rule: Never dim the coming slides in the look-ahead layout, for both songs and documents.

rules.quote: the boxes sit flush in the top left corner with no margin
rules.rule: Place look-ahead boxes flush in the top-left corner with no margin.

rules.quote: NO gap between them
rules.rule: Leave no gap between look-ahead boxes.

rules.quote: whole SCREEN (`genDocumentStageLayout` with the screen as the stage area;
rules.rule: On the projector, lay out a document's stage look-ahead using the whole screen as the stage area.

rules.quote: Every slide on a counting stage carries its own count
rules.rule: Show a count on every slide of a counting stage, including the coming slides.

rules.quote: `render()`'s own Pdf -> Pptx -> Docx order, never by `DocxSlide.tryValidate`
rules.rule: Decide a slide's kind in render() using its own Pdf, then Pptx, then Docx order, never by DocxSlide.tryValidate alone.

rules.quote: A stage screen now renders PDF/Word pages FITTED even under Full Width.
rules.rule: On a stage screen, render PDF and Word pages fitted to the screen even when Full Width is on.

rules.quote: a new stage layout goes in `DOCUMENT_STAGE_DEFINITIONS` and
rules.rule: Define any new stage layout in DOCUMENT_STAGE_DEFINITIONS and make it work in both the previewer and projector halves.

rules.quote: Side boxes carry only text/html/image/bible
rules.rule: Limit side boxes to text, html, image, and bible canvas items (filtered by filterSideCanvasItems).

rules.quote: keep media out.
rules.rule: Keep media out of side boxes.

rules.quote: A chip's × is **Hide Stage N**, never "Remove"
rules.rule: Label a stage chip's × control as "Hide Stage N", never "Remove".

rules.quote: the chips' scrollbar stays hidden on purpose
rules.rule: Keep the stage chips' scrollbar hidden.

rules.quote:
**The rule that made it actually work:** the write must be registered
**synchronously, where it is STARTED**, not where it lands.
rules.rule: When a write is fire-and-forget, register it in the pending-write tracker synchronously at the point where the write is started, not where it completes.

rules.quote:
**Any new fire-and-forget
mutator has to do the same**, or it re-opens this.
rules.rule: Any new fire-and-forget mutator must register its write synchronously where it is started, the same way AppDocument.updateSlide does.

rules.quote:
`historyUndo`,
`historyRedo`, `historySave` and `historyDiscard` all `await` it before touching
the history
rules.rule: historyUndo, historyRedo, historySave and historyDiscard must await the pending write promise before touching the editing history.

rules.quote:
A failed write settles rather than rejects, so one bad save cannot leave every
later undo waiting for ever.
rules.rule: A failed write must settle (resolve) rather than reject, so that a failed save does not leave later undo/redo/save/discard calls waiting forever.

rules.quote: `trackPendingWrite(promise)` chains onto it
rules.rule: Track each new pending write by chaining its promise onto the single pendingWrite promise via trackPendingWrite(promise).

rules.quote: Renaming is not enough if the word stays in the label
rules.rule: When renaming a control's label to fix a generic-word match, remove the generic word entirely from the label; keeping it (for example, 'Show Hidden Controls') is not sufficient.

rules.quote: Before trusting a `find`, run `owa_find_ui` and read the `tier` column.
rules.rule: Before trusting the result of a find, run owa_find_ui and read the tier column.

rules.quote: A tier-0 or tier-1 hit on something you did not expect is the bug.
rules.rule: If a tier-0 or tier-1 find hit lands on an element you did not expect, treat it as a labeling bug rather than accepting the match.

rules.quote: check whether its last word is in `KIND_NOUNS` before touching the tiers
rules.rule: When a control with an exact name is reported as a loose fit, first check whether its last word is in KIND_NOUNS before changing the tiers.

rules.quote: When adding a kind noun to that list, run `domMatch.test.mjs`'s *a control named with a kind noun* case with a label ending in it.
rules.rule: When adding a kind noun to KIND_NOUNS, run the 'a control named with a kind noun' case in domMatch.test.mjs with a label ending in that noun.

rules.quote: so bump that number with a `guide.mjs` edit
rules.rule: When editing guide.mjs, bump GUIDE_RUNTIME_VERSION so pages holding an older guide runtime stop and replace it.

rules.quote: Clear them first:
rules.rule: After editing tools/owa-devtools-mcp/domMatch.mjs or guide.mjs, before verifying, delete window.__owaDomMatch and window.__owaGuide in the app page.

rules.quote: then restart any running guide
rules.rule: After clearing window.__owaDomMatch and window.__owaGuide, restart any running guide so it re-targets the new runtime.

rules.quote: Verify through the app's own MCP host, not your own `mcp__owa-devtools__*` tools
rules.rule: When verifying changes to the owa-devtools runtime, verify through the app's own MCP host, not through your own mcp__owa-devtools__* tools.

rules.quote: `evaluateInApp` from `cdp.mjs` is the way to reach
rules.rule: When evaluate_script is unavailable, use evaluateInApp from cdp.mjs to reach the app page.

rules.quote: target this repo only
rules.rule: When stopping Electron processes, target only this repo's processes, not all Electron processes matched by image name.

rules.quote: pkill -f 'open-worship-app-dt.*[Ee]lectron'
rules.rule: On macOS, stop this repo's Electron processes with `pkill -f 'open-worship-app-dt.*[Ee]lectron'`.

rules.quote: filtered on `CommandLine -like '*open-worship-app-dt*'`, then `Stop-Process`.
rules.rule: On Windows, find this repo's Electron processes by filtering `Win32_Process` on CommandLine like '*open-worship-app-dt*', then stop them with `Stop-Process`.

rules.quote: Verify afterwards that the open-lyric process count is unchanged
rules.rule: After stopping this repo's Electron processes, verify that the open-lyric process count is unchanged before moving on.

rules.quote: kill leftovers
rules.rule: Before relaunching the app, kill any leftover processes from the previous run.

rules.quote: wait for port 3000 (Vite)
rules.rule: Before relaunching the app, wait until port 3000 is free.

rules.quote: Running `npm run vite:dev` and `electron .` as two separate background commands
rules.rule: Run `npm run vite:dev` and `electron .` as two separate background commands, not as one combined command.

rules.quote:
gate dragover on the kind mime
(never on `text/plain`, which every internal drag carries)
rules.rule: When adding a drop target, gate dragover accept feedback on the `application/x-owa-drag-<kind>` mime type, never on `text/plain`.

rules.quote:
never assume
`target === currentTarget`
rules.rule: Never assume `event.target` equals `event.currentTarget` in drag-and-drop handlers.

rules.quote:
Read `currentTarget` synchronously into a
`{clientX, clientY, target}` object and pass that
rules.rule: In drop handlers, read `event.currentTarget` synchronously into a `{clientX, clientY, target}` object and pass that object onward instead of the raw event.

rules.quote: a mimetype gate needs an explicit `length > 0`
rules.rule: When gating on dataTransfer mime types, require an explicit `length > 0` check, since `.every()` on an empty `dataTransfer.items` is vacuously true.

rules.quote: what a source sets must be ready when `dragstart` fires
rules.rule: Have a drag source's dataTransfer payload fully ready before its dragstart event fires; never await before calling setData in dragstart.

rules.quote: keeps it in a ref
rules.rule: When a drag source must resolve data before dragstart, resolve it on pointerenter or pointerdown and store it in a ref.

rules.quote: `preventDefault`s the `dragstart` when nothing is ready
rules.rule: Call preventDefault on the dragstart event when the drag payload is not ready, so no drag starts.

rules.quote: read every `dataTransfer` field before the first await
rules.rule: In a drop handler, read every dataTransfer field before the first await.

rules.quote: never let a drop handler raise an error for text it does not understand
rules.rule: Never let a drop handler throw an error for dropped content it does not understand; ignore it instead.

rules.quote:
copies every
  file out before it yields the first
rules.rule: When reading dropped files, copy every file out of the dataTransfer list before yielding the first one.

rules.quote: A row stops only the drop it takes.
rules.rule: A list row should stop only the drop it actually handles and let other drops propagate.

rules.quote: and lets the rest bubble
rules.rule: When a background drop handler receives a drop it does not take, let that drop bubble on instead of stopping it.

rules.quote: Aim by the label a tool hands out.
rules.rule: When aiming a press or drag at an element with the test tools, use the full label the tool provides.

rules.quote: rename one first
rules.rule: When two rows share the same name, rename one of them before testing.

rules.quote: read `list_pages` in the same session before a `pageId`
rules.rule: Call list_pages in the same session before using a pageId, so the id is valid for that session.

rules.quote: delete it in each page first
rules.rule: After editing domMatch.mjs, delete window.__owaDomMatch in each page before testing.

rules.quote: stdio door only, fixture paths only
rules.rule: Use owa_drop_files only through the stdio door and only with fixture paths in test-results/ or the temp folder.

rules.quote: Send `dragOver` twice with a pause
rules.rule: When dropping files with owa_drop_files, send dragOver twice with a pause between them.

rules.quote: dispatch `dragover` with a typed `File`
rules.rule: To test the drag-over mimetype gate synthetically, dispatch a dragover event carrying a typed File.

rules.quote: then call the controller method directly
rules.rule: To drive the drop pipeline by hand, get the live CanvasController through React fibers and call its controller method directly.

rules.quote: Restore with the Undo toolbar button only
rules.rule: When restoring a canvas after a manual test, use only the Undo toolbar button.

rules.quote: never Discard changed
rules.rule: Never use the Discard changed action when restoring a canvas after a manual test.

rules.quote: Stamp `appFilePath` on the `File`
rules.rule: When faking a file drop with a real path, stamp appFilePath on the File object.

rules.quote: then let the handler's awaits run
rules.rule: In vitest, after dispatching a drag event, call seal() and then let the handler's awaits run.

rules.quote:
any `toLocale*String` / `Intl.*Format` that must read in the
app's language has to check `supportedLocalesOf([locale])` and fall back
rules.rule: For any date/time formatting via toLocale*String or Intl.*Format that must display in the app's language, check Intl.DateTimeFormat.supportedLocalesOf([locale]) first and fall back when the locale is unsupported.

rules.quote:
A test of it must mock `supportedLocalesOf` to `[]` to
be Electron
rules.rule: A test of locale-dependent formatting must mock supportedLocalesOf to return [] to simulate Electron's trimmed ICU.

rules.quote: a test that only runs a locale under Node proves nothing
rules.rule: Do not treat a test that only runs a locale under Node as proof that the locale formats correctly in the app.

rules.quote:
Number
glyphs come from the app's own `toStringNum` / language data, never from Intl.
rules.rule: Get number glyphs from the app's own toStringNum or language data, never from Intl.

rules.quote: don't burn calls retrying it.
rules.rule: Do not retry `evaluate_script` calls, because they fail deterministically under the current Node version.

rules.quote: the port comes from `owa_app_state`
rules.rule: Get the CDP port from `owa_app_state` instead of assuming a fixed port.

rules.quote: `GET http://127.0.0.1:<port>/json/list`
rules.rule: To find the page target, send a GET request to `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/json/list` using the port from `owa_app_state`.

rules.quote: `webSocketDebuggerUrl` with node's global `WebSocket`
rules.rule: Open the target's `webSocketDebuggerUrl` with node's global `WebSocket` to drive the page.

rules.quote: `Runtime.evaluate` with `{expression, returnByValue: true, awaitPromise: true}`
rules.rule: Evaluate page code by sending `Runtime.evaluate` with `{expression, returnByValue: true, awaitPromise: true}` over the CDP WebSocket.

rules.quote: so read geometry off
rules.rule: In Electron, read window geometry from the page (`screenX`/`screenY`/`outerWidth`/`outerHeight`) instead of calling `Browser.getWindowForTarget`.

rules.quote: never `import()` an app module.
rules.rule: Never use `import()` to load an app module in any code evaluated on the page.

rules.quote: don't 'fix' it
rules.rule: Do not modify or 'fix' the code in src/experiments/ (the html-in-canvas harness).

rules.quote: don't count it as product
rules.rule: Do not count src/experiments/ code as product code when reviewing or reporting.

rules.quote: Do not report its rough edges as product findings
rules.rule: When reviewing, do not report rough edges in src/experiments/ as product findings.

rules.quote: do not spend perf-review effort there
rules.rule: Do not spend performance-review effort on src/experiments/ code.

rules.quote: product code importing anything from `src/experiments/` fails the build — that IS a finding.
rules.rule: When reviewing, report any product code that imports from src/experiments/ as a finding, since it fails the build.

rules.quote: Every yt-dlp caller goes through `requireExtraBinPaths()` first
rules.rule: Every yt-dlp caller must call `requireExtraBinPaths()` before doing anything else.

rules.quote: callers reject with `EXTRA_BIN_MISSING_ERROR_MESSAGE`
rules.rule: When `requireExtraBinPaths()` returns null, callers must reject with `EXTRA_BIN_MISSING_ERROR_MESSAGE`.

rules.quote: the Background comps stay quiet for it
rules.rule: Background components must stay quiet (not show an error) for the `EXTRA_BIN_MISSING_ERROR_MESSAGE` error.

rules.quote: Anything reaching for `bin-helper/yt|ffmpeg|qjs` is stale by definition.
rules.rule: Do not reference `bin-helper/yt`, `bin-helper/ffmpeg`, or `bin-helper/qjs` paths; use the extra-bin paths from `extraBinHelpers.ts` instead.

rules.quote: do not copy that
rules.rule: Do not copy the `extractDownloadedBible` pattern of deleting the downloaded `bin-*.tar.gz` in a `finally` block.

rules.quote: The downloaded `bin-*.tar.gz` is deliberately kept
rules.rule: Keep the downloaded `bin-*.tar.gz` archive inside `extra-bin` so Re-extract works offline.

rules.quote: A blanket `catch → {}` there
rules.rule: Do not use a blanket `catch` that returns `{}` when reading `info.json` in `s3-push-release.js`.

rules.quote: reading the public URL and getting the CDN's SPA-index HTML
rules.rule: Do not read the platform `info.json` from its public URL during publishing.

rules.quote: `s3-push-release.js` READ-MODIFY-WRITES the platform `info.json`
rules.rule: When publishing, read the platform `info.json` via `GetObjectCommand`, modify it, and write it back, so older releases in the cumulative `extraBin` map are kept.

rules.quote: re-install and move on instead of hunting a regression
rules.rule: If the extra-bin pack shows Not installed after the parent data directory changed, re-install it rather than investigating a regression.

rules.quote: **in the background first**, then trigger the download.
rules.rule: To capture yt-dlp's command line, start the `Get-CimInstance` process poller in the background before triggering the download.

rules.quote: must hold a `cloudflared-*` file
rules.rule: Each platform directory in `experiment-building` must contain a `cloudflared-*` file, or `build-extra-bin.mjs` will throw on that host.

rules.quote: `<platform>` named exactly as `extra-work/buildPlatformHelpers.mjs` names packs
rules.rule: Name each per-OS extra-bin folder exactly as `extra-work/buildPlatformHelpers.mjs` names packs.

rules.quote: _provide maximum options_
rules.rule: When building the MCP client picker, provide maximum options, including tool-specific configuration and a plain binary file path.

rules.quote: never let Default be removed
rules.rule: Never allow the Default session to be removed from the folder-session strip.

rules.quote: Default is never offered for removal
rules.rule: Never offer the Default session for removal in MediaSessionsComp.

rules.quote: a new list or a new "save into the documents folder" path goes through `getActiveDirSourceSettingName`
rules.rule: When adding a new list or a new "save into the documents folder" path, resolve its target setting through getActiveDirSourceSettingName.

rules.quote: mock `folderSessionHelpers` per file
rules.rule: In tests that import these modules without a mocked settingHelpers, mock folderSessionHelpers in each test file rather than using a shared mock.

rules.quote: so the popup must not read the active setting
rules.rule: Editor popup windows must not read the active folder-session setting; they must use the session id passed in the URL.

rules.quote: a fake DirSource needs `settingName`
rules.rule: When faking a DirSource for useGenDirSourceReload, include a settingName property.

rules.quote:
check whether the reader touches
the timestamp
rules.rule: When adding or reviewing a cache, check whether the reader modifies the entry's timestamp.

rules.quote: an "expiring" cache with an LRU-style refresh is immortal under load
rules.rule: Do not refresh a cache entry's expiry timestamp on read (no LRU-style or sliding expiry); cache expiry must be absolute.

rules.quote: drive text entry through `owa_type`
rules.rule: When entering text into a controlled React input (such as the chatbot's ask box), use the `owa_type` tool rather than chrome-devtools `fill`.

rules.quote:
distrust the snapshot's `value=` — it is the DOM property, not
React state
rules.rule: When a button press's effect contradicts an accessibility snapshot, do not trust the snapshot's `value=` as the app's React state, since it reflects the DOM property.

rules.quote: give `#foreground` or that wrapper a `z-index`
rules.rule: Never give the `#foreground` layer or its wrapper element a `z-index`, because it confines `mix-blend-mode` and makes blend modes silently do nothing.

rules.quote: `z-index`, `isolation`,
rules.rule: Never give the `#foreground` layer or its wrapper element `isolation`, because it confines `mix-blend-mode` and makes blend modes silently do nothing.

rules.quote: `opacity` below 1
rules.rule: Never set `opacity` below 1 on the `#foreground` layer or its wrapper element, because it confines `mix-blend-mode` and makes blend modes silently do nothing.

rules.quote: a `filter`
rules.rule: Never apply a `filter` to the `#foreground` layer or its wrapper element, because it confines `mix-blend-mode` and makes blend modes silently do nothing.

rules.quote: a `transform`
rules.rule: Never apply a `transform` to the `#foreground` layer or its wrapper element, because it confines `mix-blend-mode` and makes blend modes silently do nothing.

rules.quote: `will-change`
rules.rule: Never apply `will-change` to the `#foreground` layer or its wrapper element, because it confines `mix-blend-mode` and makes blend modes silently do nothing.

rules.quote: `contain: paint`
rules.rule: Never apply `contain: paint` to the `#foreground` layer or its wrapper element, because it confines `mix-blend-mode` and makes blend modes silently do nothing.

rules.quote: `genForegroundExtraStyle` drops `backdropFilter` and the box shadow while a blend mode is in force
rules.rule: Drop `backdropFilter` and the box shadow from foreground extra style while a blend mode is in force, except for a box shadow preset the operator chose by hand.

rules.quote: keep their **own** dir sources
rules.rule: Give each foreground widget its own directory source rather than sharing one.

rules.quote: deliberately no shift-click "append"
rules.rule: Do not add a shift-click "append" behavior to foreground sessions.

rules.quote: `title: translate(widget.labelKey)`
rules.rule: Give each foreground menu row a `title` set to `translate(widget.labelKey)`, so its accessible name is the plain label without badges.

rules.quote: NO scroller
rules.rule: Do not add a second scroller inside a foreground panel; the panel's `.floating-widget__content` must remain the only scrollport.

rules.quote: Which panels are open is ONE setting (`foreground-open-panels`)
rules.rule: Store which foreground panels are open in the single `foreground-open-panels` setting, not in per-panel settings.

rules.quote: The show does NOT scroll the list.
rules.rule: Do not make the slide show scroll or re-center the foreground list on each tick.

rules.quote: Removing a session takes its overlay OFF the screens first.
rules.rule: When removing a foreground session, take its overlay off the screens before removing the session.

rules.quote: A panel whose prefix changes must be REMOUNTED.
rules.rule: Remount a panel whose settings prefix changes, by keying it on the prefix, so its controls read the new values.

rules.quote: anything else keyed by a changing
rules.rule: Key any other component whose settings prefix can change the same way, so it remounts when the prefix changes.

rules.quote: needs `z-index` ABOVE the tiles
rules.rule: Give the sticky session/Properties bar a `z-index` above the file tiles so the tiles do not paint over its controls.

rules.quote: Everything that acts on a session rides ONE sticky row
rules.rule: Put every control that acts on a session in one sticky row.

rules.quote: The flag rides the datum, never `extraStyle`.
rules.rule: Carry the `isBehind` flag on the foreground datum, never in `extraStyle`.

rules.quote: Build it with `withForegroundLayer(data, isBehind)`
rules.rule: Build foreground extra style with `withForegroundLayer(data, isBehind)`.

rules.quote: Every path that builds a datum must carry it
rules.rule: Every code path that builds a foreground datum must carry the `isBehind` flag.

rules.quote: A behind overlay carries no `z-index`.
rules.rule: Do not give an overlay in the behind-slide root a `z-index`.

rules.quote: Each root re-renders only its own overlays (`render(isBehind)`)
rules.rule: Have each foreground root re-render only its own overlays, on mount and on refresh.

rules.quote: `Screen Blend` rather than `Screen`
rules.rule: Label the screen blend mode with the translation key `Screen Blend`, not `Screen`, because the dictionary's `Screen` means the projector.

rules.quote: Keep that list's literals and its `] as const;`.
rules.rule: When editing `BLEND_MODE_GROUP_LIST`, keep its string literals and its `] as const;` ending so the coverage test can parse it.

rules.quote: `handleRemoving` calls `releaseMediaElement`.
rules.rule: Call `releaseMediaElement` when removing a foreground media element, so its player is freed.

rules.quote: may not import `tran`
rules.rule: Do not import `tran` into `cameraHelpers.ts`, because it loads in the screen window and must stay a leaf module.

rules.quote: may not import `tran`, the toast helpers or anything reaching `SettingManager`
rules.rule: Do not import the toast helpers into `cameraHelpers.ts`, because it loads in the screen window and must stay a leaf module.

rules.quote: may not import `tran`, the toast helpers or anything reaching `SettingManager`
rules.rule: Do not import any module that reaches `SettingManager` into `cameraHelpers.ts`, because it loads in the screen window and must stay a leaf module.

rules.quote: the one place it must never appear
rules.rule: Never show a toast in the screen window (when `appProvider.isPageScreen` is true).

rules.quote: the operator has to be told
rules.rule: When a camera fails with `NotReadableError` because a webcam is already in use, tell the operator, since the code cannot fix it.

rules.quote: live in ONE JSON setting per prefix
rules.rule: Store all of a foreground widget's border, shadow, padding and text decoration settings together as JSON in one setting per prefix, not as a separate file per property.

rules.quote: `toForegroundDecoration` validates FIELD BY FIELD
rules.rule: When reading a stored foreground decoration, validate each field separately and fall back to that field's default when it is invalid, without discarding the other fields.

rules.quote: Padding, line height and letter spacing are in `em`
rules.rule: Express padding, line height and letter spacing for foreground widgets in `em` units.

rules.quote: A box shadow belongs to the BOX, so it stays in pixels.
rules.rule: Express a foreground widget's box shadow in `px` units.

rules.quote: it is 0 for the media widgets
rules.rule: Default a foreground widget's padding to 0 for media widgets, which set no font size of their own.

rules.quote: A blend mode still drops the box shadow, but only the default one.
rules.rule: When a blend mode is set, drop the box shadow only if it is the default shadow; keep a shadow the user picked by hand.

rules.quote: The message stack counts the BOX, not only the lines.
rules.rule: When computing the offset of each message in the stack, count each box's padding and border as well as its lines.

rules.quote:
it keeps its own text and
interval and takes only the new style.
rules.rule: When applying a style change to the Show all in turn message, keep its own text and interval and apply only the new style.

rules.quote:
keeps each colour's hue,
  saturation and alpha
rules.rule: When computing Dark/Light foreground contrast colours, keep each colour's hue, saturation and alpha unchanged, changing only lightness.

rules.quote:
A colour already on its side
  comes back as the same string, so pressing the lit side writes nothing.
rules.rule: When a colour is already on the requested Dark/Light side, return it unchanged as the same string so that pressing that side writes nothing.

rules.quote: The side is read off the words' colour, never stored
rules.rule: Do not store the Dark/Light side of a foreground component; derive it from the text colour when needed.

rules.quote:
A preset's colours are its Dark
  side; pressed, it goes on in the side shown
rules.rule: When applying a foreground preset, use its Dark-side colours and then apply them in the side currently shown.

rules.quote: Unset colours follow the app theme
rules.rule: When a foreground colour is unset, make it follow the app theme.

rules.quote: reads `#app`'s `data-bs-theme`, NOT `themeHelpers`
rules.rule: Read the app theme for foreground default colours from `#app`'s `data-bs-theme`, not from `themeHelpers`.

rules.quote:
The pure helpers
  take the defaults as a parameter from callers that know the theme.
rules.rule: Pass theme default colours into pure foreground helpers as a parameter from callers that know the theme, rather than importing the theme into them.

rules.quote:
applying writes every saved field and
  REMOVES every other look key
rules.rule: When applying a saved foreground preset, write every saved field and remove every other look key so nothing of the replaced look remains.

rules.quote:
Not
  turned by the switch.
rules.rule: Do not change a saved foreground preset when the Dark/Light switch is pressed.

rules.quote: Save as Preset is exact
rules.rule: When saving a foreground preset, save the whole Properties for that component exactly so that applying it restores it exactly.

rules.quote: Every text preset says its font size, at scale 1
rules.rule: Every text preset must set its font size at scale 1.

rules.quote:
`TIMER_BOX_STYLE` (`min-width: max-content`) keeps a countdown's,
  stopwatch's or clock's box at least as wide as its `nowrap` digits
rules.rule: Apply `min-width: max-content` (TIMER_BOX_STYLE) to countdown, stopwatch and clock boxes so they stay at least as wide as their nowrap digits.

rules.quote:
the clock's caption is `width: 0; min-width: 100%` so a long city name wraps
  instead of widening it
rules.rule: Style the clock's caption with `width: 0; min-width: 100%` so long city names wrap instead of widening the box.

rules.quote: keep the switch a calculation and derived
rules.rule: Keep the Dark/Light switch a calculation derived from current colours, not stored state.

rules.quote: keep saved presets exact
rules.rule: Keep saved foreground presets exact.

rules.quote: Show is `putSessionData`, Hide is `removeSessionData(key, datum)`
rules.rule: To show a foreground session's datum, call `putSessionData`; to hide it, call `removeSessionData(key, datum)`.

rules.quote: `null` removes every session's entry -- only for a Clear of the whole kind
rules.rule: Pass `null` to remove every session's entry only when clearing the whole kind of foreground component (e.g. F10, a run sheet's Clear FG, or the assistant stopping a component).

rules.quote: The typed `set…Data(datum)` stayed as the put and takes no `null`
rules.rule: Do not pass `null` to the typed `set…Data(datum)` function; use `removeSessionData` to hide a session's datum.

rules.quote: It never goes at or below the last id
rules.rule: When generating a media session id, never produce an id at or below the last id the window has made.

rules.quote: still `s<base36>`
rules.rule: Keep generated media session ids in the format `s<base36>`.

rules.quote: Two sessions must have two ids
rules.rule: Give each foreground session its own distinct id.

rules.quote: a new per-session foreground kind goes into
rules.rule: When adding a new per-session foreground kind, add it to `ForegroundSessionListKeyType` and its list.

rules.quote: never a single slot
rules.rule: Never store a per-session foreground kind in a single slot; always use a per-session list.

rules.quote: that reads a saved foreground entry raw must accept both shapes
rules.rule: Any code that reads a saved foreground entry raw must accept both the old single-slot shape and the new list shape.

rules.quote: MUST be scoped per manager instance
rules.rule: Scope any registry that maps a foreground/overlay data object to a per-screen DOM node per manager instance, not at module level.

rules.quote: never module-global
rules.rule: Never make a registry that maps a foreground/overlay data object to a per-screen DOM node module-global.

rules.quote: **The state is in the screen DATUM**, never in a window
rules.rule: Store countdown and stopwatch start/pause/reset state in the screen datum, never in a window.

rules.quote: **Every rule is in `src/_screen/managers/timerStateHelpers.ts`**
rules.rule: Put all countdown and stopwatch timing-state rules in src/_screen/managers/timerStateHelpers.ts.

rules.quote: go up STOPPED by default
rules.rule: Countdowns and stopwatches start in the stopped state by default.

rules.quote: no controls, always runs.
rules.rule: A countdown to a date and time has no start/pause/reset controls and always runs.

rules.quote: A timing-only change must not remount the clock
rules.rule: When a change affects only timing, update the clock in place and do not remount it.

rules.quote: countdown rounds UP while counting down
rules.rule: Round a countdown up while it is counting down.

rules.quote: DOWN in the overtime
rules.rule: Round a countdown down while it is in overtime.

rules.quote: never per frame, and not at all while stopped.
rules.rule: Tick TimerClockController with a second-aligned setTimeout, never per frame, and do not tick while stopped.

rules.quote: under-a-second readings dropped
rules.rule: Drop stopwatch history readings under one second.

rules.quote: live in `StopwatchTimerComp`, keyed by session
rules.rule: Place the stopwatch controls and history list in StopwatchTimerComp, keyed by session.

rules.quote: builds its timing
rules.rule: Build timing for a new countdown or stopwatch start with genCountdownTiming or genStopwatchTiming.

rules.quote: never compute the state from a
rules.rule: Never compute countdown or stopwatch state from a window's own copy.

rules.quote:
Do not "fix" that into a
  flag or a default.
rules.rule: Do not change the unset keyField on the Free provider (LLM_PROVIDER_MAP.free) into a flag or a default.

rules.quote:
Before listing a model, drive it
  through the REAL loop
rules.rule: Before listing a free model, run it through the real tool loop on several corpus questions, not just a one-tool ping.

rules.quote:
Check `GET api.kilo.ai/api/gateway/models` for the ids
  before a release.
rules.rule: Before a release, check the Kilo gateway models endpoint for the current Free model ids.

rules.quote: leave them out.
rules.rule: Do not list router models (kilo-auto/free, openrouter/free) as Free models.

rules.quote: Every id must end `:free`;
rules.rule: Every Free model id must end with `:free`.

rules.quote: Removing a free model needs nothing more.
rules.rule: Removing a free model needs no extra steps beyond removing it.

rules.quote: status rides `hostStatus`, never `status`
rules.rule: Record a ToolHostError's status in hostStatus, never in status.

rules.quote:
Before blaming a
  provider for a failed answer, read the chatbot window's console for which
  URL failed
rules.rule: Before blaming a provider for a failed answer, read the chatbot window's console to see which URL failed.

rules.quote: do NOT reuse `RenderOpenPageButtonComp` for it
rules.rule: In Settings, do not reuse RenderOpenPageButtonComp for the Free provider's risk notice.

rules.quote: The risk is stated, never assumed:
rules.rule: State the Free provider's risk in the log and in Settings; never assume the user already knows it.

rules.quote:
Both **name the service and link
to its own site** off `FREE_SERVICE_MAP`
rules.rule: Have the Free risk warnings name the service and link to its own site, taken from FREE_SERVICE_MAP.

rules.quote: Measure on the user's own servers (a shared registry server, Ollama) first;
rules.rule: Measure on the user's own servers (a shared registry server, Ollama) before measuring against Free models.

rules.quote:
one stream, few runs, and tell the user
the quota was used.
rules.rule: When a Free model must be measured, use one stream and few runs.

rules.quote:
and tell the user
the quota was used.
rules.rule: When a Free model has been measured, tell the user the anonymous quota was used.

rules.quote: aim "Full view" by its panel (`Presenter > Full view`), never by the bare title.
rules.rule: When targeting the Full view button in CDP automation, address it by its panel (Presenter > Full view), never by the bare title.

rules.quote: check that setting file before suspecting your change.
rules.rule: If a middle-column panel disappears, check the widget size setting file before suspecting your own code change.

rules.quote: Restore just that one key to the layout default from
rules.rule: To fix a missing middle-column panel, restore only that panel's key in the widget size setting file to the layout default from AppPresenterMiddleComp.tsx (e.g. {"v1":["3"],"v2":["1"]}).

rules.quote: and reload.
rules.rule: After restoring the widget size key to its layout default, reload the page.

rules.quote: tick the one pane back open under **View → Widgets**
rules.rule: To reopen a single closed pane, tick it back open under View → Widgets.

rules.quote: **View → Reset Widgets Size**, which restores every pane live but wipes every size the user customized.
rules.rule: To restore every pane at once, use View → Reset Widgets Size, accepting that it wipes all sizes the user customized.

rules.quote: target `[data-react-comp-name]` or the `bi-arrows-fullscreen` icon
rules.rule: In a translated (e.g. Khmer) run, locate the Full view button by `[data-react-comp-name]` or the `bi-arrows-fullscreen` icon class instead of `[title="Full view"]`.

rules.quote: anywhere else the popup keeps `getAppThemeBackgroundColor()`
rules.rule: When the system is not glass-capable (`isGlassCapable` is false), keep the chatbot popup's background from `getAppThemeBackgroundColor()` so the popup stays opaque.

rules.quote: two MUST agree
rules.rule: Keep the main-process `isGlassCapable` answer and the renderer's `appProvider.systemUtils.isGlassCapable` answer identical, so the translucent stylesheet is never applied to a window the OS did not frost.

rules.quote: that cannot be see-through
rules.rule: For surfaces that cannot be see-through (such as `select.chat-pick` and `.chat-menu`), use the opaque `--chat-solid`/`--chat-solid-soft` variables instead of the translucent panel variables.

rules.quote: A desktop screenshot will not show the blur.
rules.rule: Do not judge whether the glass material is applied from a desktop screenshot made with CopyFromScreen/BitBlt, PrintScreen, or gdigrab, because those captures omit the DWM backdrop blur.

rules.quote: the tell is the **title bar** going translucent too
rules.rule: To confirm the glass material is applied, check whether the title bar is translucent too.

rules.quote: `EnableTransparency` — 0 there means Windows really is drawing it solid.
rules.rule: To check whether Windows is actually drawing transparency, read `EnableTransparency` under `HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize`; a value of 0 means the material is drawn solid.

rules.quote: An `import { ... } from 'react'` inside `core/` is a bug, not a shortcut.
rules.rule: Do not import from 'react' inside src/graph-view/core/; a React import there is a bug.

rules.quote: no React and no import from anywhere else in `src/`
rules.rule: Keep src/graph-view/core/ free of React and of any import from elsewhere in src/.

rules.quote: implement the interface,
rules.rule: To add a second graph dataset, implement the GraphSourceType interface for it.

rules.quote: add a lazy body component,
rules.rule: To add a second graph dataset, add a lazy body component for it.

rules.quote: add one line to the source switch in `GraphViewPanelsComp`
rules.rule: To add a second graph dataset, add one line to the source switch in GraphViewPanelsComp.

rules.quote: `RING_RADIUS >= NODE_WIDTH + NODE_GAP`
rules.rule: Keep RING_RADIUS >= NODE_WIDTH + NODE_GAP so ring 0 stays clear of the root.

rules.quote: `RING_STEP >= NODE_WIDTH + NODE_GAP`
rules.rule: Keep RING_STEP >= NODE_WIDTH + NODE_GAP.

rules.quote: `RING_STEP * RING_Y_RATIO >= NODE_HEIGHT + NODE_GAP`
rules.rule: Keep RING_STEP * RING_Y_RATIO >= NODE_HEIGHT + NODE_GAP.

rules.quote: Nodes are spaced by ARC LENGTH, not by angle
rules.rule: Space graph nodes by arc length (getAngleAtArcFraction), not by angle.

rules.quote: Each ring spans the WHOLE sweep independently.
rules.rule: Have each ring span the whole sweep independently of the other rings.

rules.quote: `NODE_HEIGHT` must match what the box actually renders at
rules.rule: Keep NODE_HEIGHT equal to the height the box actually renders at.

rules.quote: it must NOT go back to a per-edge `nodeList.find` +
rules.rule: Do not look up nodes per edge with nodeList.find plus getNodeView; use the viewByKey map.

rules.quote: never on `graph`
rules.rule: Key GraphSurfaceComp's getVisibleGraph and getPathEdgeKeySet memos on the structural fields, never on graph.

rules.quote: Wheel ticks are coalesced to one `setViewport` per rAF inside the wheel
rules.rule: Coalesce wheel ticks into one setViewport call per rAF inside the wheel effect.

rules.quote: Dragging writes straight to the DOM
rules.rule: During a node drag, write the box and edge positions straight to the DOM once per rAF.

rules.quote: commits to the store once on pointer-up
rules.rule: Commit a node drag to the store once on pointer-up, not per frame.

rules.quote: The edge SVG has NO `viewBox`
rules.rule: Do not give the edge SVG a viewBox.

rules.quote: Explicit px width/height in raw
rules.rule: Give the edge SVG explicit px width and height in raw graph units.

rules.quote: positioned from the computed world bounds
rules.rule: Position the edge SVG from the computed world bounds.

rules.quote: Edge labels use `paint-order="stroke"` for their halo
rules.rule: Draw edge label halos with paint-order="stroke", not a background rect.

rules.quote: Edges are STORED centre to centre and DRAWN border to border.
rules.rule: Store edges centre to centre and draw them border to border.

rules.quote: recomputing handles from the trimmed
rules.rule: Do not recompute curve handles from the trimmed ends; clip the full curve instead.

rules.quote: The arrow is now an ordinary `<path>`
rules.rule: Draw the edge arrowhead as an ordinary path (EDGE_ARROW_PATH_D), not a marker.

rules.quote: Its fill and the line's stroke both read one `--graph-edge-color` set
rules.rule: Read both the arrow fill and the line stroke from one --graph-edge-color set per relation group.

rules.quote: point to DRAW to; layout still works in stored coordinates
rules.rule: Draw edges to the point getNodeAnchor returns, not to node.x/y; layout still uses stored coordinates.

rules.quote: That constant is now pinned by the stylesheet the way `NODE_HEIGHT` is
rules.rule: Pin NODE_COLLAPSED_HEIGHT in the stylesheet the way NODE_HEIGHT is pinned.

rules.quote: Zoom is an INTEGER PERCENT
rules.rule: Represent graph zoom as an integer percent.

rules.quote: the wheel/pinch handling is hand-rolled
rules.rule: Hand-roll the graph's wheel/pinch zoom handling instead of using useZoomingRegistering.

rules.quote: anchored on the cursor, with a multiplicative step.
rules.rule: Make a plain wheel zoom the graph, anchored on the cursor, with a multiplicative step.

rules.quote: Never pass `isBodyDraggable: true`
rules.rule: Never pass isBodyDraggable: true to the widget.

rules.quote: override `.floating-widget__content`'s `overflow: auto` to `hidden`
rules.rule: Override .floating-widget__content's overflow: auto to hidden for the graph panel.

rules.quote: never a direct app call from the surface
rules.rule: Route anything a box shows that the dataset does not name through an optional source hook, never a direct app call from the surface.

rules.quote: resolve only what a menu is about to show, in `mapInYieldingBatches`
rules.rule: Resolve only what a menu is about to show, in mapInYieldingBatches.

rules.quote: A box's right-click menu is built from the same handlers its buttons call
rules.rule: Build a box's right-click menu from the same handlers its buttons call.

rules.quote: read the neighbour count from `countCacheRef`, never re-count
rules.rule: Read the neighbour count from countCacheRef; never re-count it.

rules.quote: hand the ORIGINAL right-click
rules.rule: Pass the ORIGINAL right-click event to rows that open a further menu, so the menu appears at the pointer.

rules.quote: Menu icons go through `genContextMenuItemIcon`
rules.rule: Route menu icons through genContextMenuItemIcon.

rules.quote: consecutive VIEWPORT changes inside 700ms are one
rules.rule: Treat consecutive viewport changes inside 700ms as one undo step.

rules.quote: pass `isUserMove: false` and record nothing.
rules.rule: Pass isUserMove: false for viewport moves the app makes; they record nothing in undo history.

rules.quote: Keys are handled on the focused panel, never on the window
rules.rule: Handle undo/redo keys on the focused panel, never on the window.

rules.quote: `pathNodeKeyList` has more than one entry the chain layout is rebuilt and the
rules.rule: When pathNodeKeyList has more than one entry, rebuild the chain layout and fan rings only off what hangs from it.

rules.quote: the caller MUST fit afterwards
rules.rule: Fit the graph after calling relayoutGraph.

rules.quote: Opening a record starts FRESH — there is no implicit last session.
rules.rule: Open a record as a fresh graph; do not restore an implicit last session.

rules.quote: NAMED PRESETS are the only persistence
rules.rule: Persist graphs only through named presets.

rules.quote: Picker rows resolve `getNodeView` per row for the English name
rules.rule: Resolve getNodeView per picker row to get the English name.

rules.quote: `setPath` re-roots and re-titles.
rules.rule: Make setPath re-root and re-title the graph.

rules.quote: The font is declared ONCE on `.graph-view`.
rules.rule: Declare the graph font once, on .graph-view.

rules.quote: Re-rooting must be followed by a re-layout and a fit, in ONE step.
rules.rule: Follow any re-rooting with a re-layout and a fit, in one step.

rules.quote: must be wrapped, and `handleFitToView` now checks
rules.rule: Wrap handlers with optional first arguments before passing them to onClick.

rules.quote: must use `result.graph.nodeList`
rules.rule: Fit after an expansion using result.graph.nodeList, not graphRef.

rules.quote: The Markdown CARRIES the diagram
rules.rule: Include the diagram in Copy as Markdown output as a mermaid fence under a ## Diagram heading, ahead of the tables.

rules.quote: The fence GROWS past any run of backticks inside the diagram
rules.rule: Make the markdown fence longer than any run of backticks inside the diagram.

rules.quote: a graph with no records writes no diagram rather than fencing an empty `flowchart`
rules.rule: When a graph has no records, write no diagram rather than an empty flowchart fence.

rules.quote: in `GRAPH_DIAGRAM_FORMAT_LIST`
rules.rule: Declare diagram formats in GRAPH_DIAGRAM_FORMAT_LIST, the one list the menu rows, toast title and buildGraphDiagram read.

rules.quote: with the full name on `ContextMenuItemType.title`
rules.rule: Name each diagram context-menu row short, and put the full name on ContextMenuItemType.title and in the toast.

rules.quote: and UNDIRECTED from the centre
rules.rule: Build the mindmap tree breadth-first and undirected from the centre.

rules.quote: parks anything unreachable on the centre
rules.rule: Park mindmap records that are unreachable from the centre on the centre.

rules.quote: Mermaid is a `flowchart LR` by default
rules.rule: Use flowchart LR as the default Mermaid direction, not TD.

rules.quote: The verse list is capped at 12 a record.
rules.rule: Cap the verse list at 12 references per record in copied output.

rules.quote: everything out of the dataset goes through the injected `translate`
rules.rule: Translate everything out of the dataset through the injected translate function; keep structural furniture in English.

rules.quote: A relation HEADING reads from the end the edge points at
rules.rule: Read a relation heading from the end the edge points at.

rules.quote: `&` is escaped BEFORE `#`
rules.rule: Escape & before # in Mermaid labels.

rules.quote: one holding a comma or a quote is dropped rather than breaking
rules.rule: Drop a classDef colour that contains a comma or a quote.

rules.quote: is derived from `fenceLanguage === 'mermaid'` rather than flagged
rules.rule: Derive MERMAID_LIVE_FORMAT_LIST from fenceLanguage === 'mermaid', not from a flag.

rules.quote: must match it byte for byte
rules.rule: Make the mermaid.live link match the editor's serializeState byte for byte.

rules.quote: URL-safe base64 unpadded, behind `pako:` in the FRAGMENT of
rules.rule: Encode the mermaid.live link as URL-safe base64 unpadded behind pako: in the URL fragment.

rules.quote: so past 8 000 the link goes to the
rules.rule: If a mermaid.live link exceeds 8000 characters, copy it to the clipboard with a sentence instead of opening it.

rules.quote: The compressor is driven through its own writer and reader, never a `Blob`
rules.rule: Drive the compressor through its own writer and reader; never use a Blob or Response.

rules.quote: A loose match must never be pressed.
rules.rule: Never press a control that was matched only by a loose matcher tier; loose matches are for pointing, not clicking.

rules.quote: `isPressSafe` (tier 0, or a label part equal to the words once `[F6]` and a leading glyph come off, or the very panel asked for) is the bar
rules.rule: Before pressing a control, require it to pass isPressSafe: an exact tier-0 match, or a label part equal to the requested words once any [F6] shortcut and leading glyph are removed, or the panel the step asked for.

rules.quote: Only `document.elementsFromPoint` at the control's own centre tells
rules.rule: To determine whether a control is reachable, check document.elementsFromPoint at the control's own centre rather than relying on whether it is visible or enabled.

rules.quote: `demo-failure-rate.mjs` run before and after
rules.rule: Run demo-failure-rate.mjs before and after any change to the walkthrough card or the matcher.

rules.quote: window first, or every refusal spends a model round
rules.rule: When running demo-failure-rate.mjs for a card-only change, close the chatbot window first.

rules.quote: Pace under the firewall's 25 acting calls a minute
rules.rule: Pace demo-failure-rate.mjs runs to stay under the firewall's limit of 25 acting calls per minute.

rules.quote: skip W-02, whose first press navigates the window and unloads
rules.rule: Skip step W-02 when running demo-failure-rate.mjs, because its first press navigates the window and unloads the card.

rules.quote: Grade the DONE rows by the label they clicked, not just the refusals.
rules.rule: When grading demo-failure-rate.mjs results, check the label each DONE row actually clicked, not only the refusals.

rules.quote: the chat window is never restored to
rules.rule: When delivering a guide-step rescue answer, never restore the minimised chat window; draw the answer on the guide card instead.

rules.quote: The model is held to `DO: <instruction>`
rules.rule: When answering a guide-step rescue question, reply in the form `DO: <instruction>` so the code can parse out the instruction.

rules.quote: Missing marker keeps the whole text
rules.rule: If a rescue answer lacks the `DO:` marker, keep the whole answer text rather than extracting a partial part of it.

rules.quote: Any future turn the app asks on the user's behalf needs both.
rules.rule: Any new turn the app asks the model on the user's behalf must pass both `shownText` and `formatAnswer` to `handleAsking`.

rules.quote: The steering all rides the rescue QUESTION, not `genSystemPrompt`
rules.rule: Put rescue steering instructions in the rescue user question, not in `genSystemPrompt`.

rules.quote: No new MCP tool
rules.rule: Do not add a new MCP tool for guide-step rescue; use the app's existing DOM-event relay.

rules.quote: **The tab's chat history** (`withoutHistory`)
rules.rule: A guide-step rescue must not include the tab's chat history; use `withoutHistory`.

rules.quote: **The offline manual bot** (`withoutOfflineFallback`)
rules.rule: A guide-step rescue must not fall back to the offline manual bot; use `withoutOfflineFallback`.

rules.quote: `unavailable` and the card's own plain instruction stands.
rules.rule: When the model cannot answer a rescue, report `unavailable` and leave the card's own plain instruction in place.

rules.quote: An assistant that degrades must degrade toward silence, not toward confidence
rules.rule: When the assistant fails or degrades, respond with silence or unavailability, never with a confident-sounding answer.

rules.quote: Failure rate is tracked, not eyeballed:
rules.rule: Measure rescue failure rate with the `rescue-failure-rate.mjs` script instead of judging it by eye.

rules.quote: Fires from `act()` only
rules.rule: Trigger guide-step rescue only from `act()`, i.e. on the Do it press.

rules.quote: it may not import an app module
rules.rule: The guide runtime must not import an app module.

rules.quote: The restore does **not** re-read `isMinimized()`.
rules.rule: When restoring a tucked-away help window after a walkthrough, do not re-read `isMinimized()` to decide whether to restore it.

rules.quote: `once('restore')` / `once('closed')` drop the reference
rules.rule: Learn that the user has taken the help window back by listening for its `restore` and `closed` events, and drop the window reference when either fires, rather than re-reading window state later.

rules.quote: Check `IsIconic` on the window handle
rules.rule: To verify that a window is minimised, check `IsIconic` on the window handle (for example with a PowerShell `EnumWindows` probe), not `document.visibilityState`.

rules.quote: so never make it corpus-first
rules.rule: Never make the owa_help_search lookup corpus-first; an exact corpus question must be treated as a label whose filed recipe is returned first.

rules.quote: no threshold above 6 is safe
rules.rule: Do not set the help search hit-score threshold above 6.

rules.quote: under which a hit is not an answer
rules.rule: Treat any help search hit scoring below MIN_HELP_HIT_SCORE (6) as not an answer.

rules.quote: quote held-out paraphrases (22/45)
rules.rule: When evaluating help search, use held-out paraphrases (22 of 45) as test queries.

rules.quote: never corpus top-1
rules.rule: Never evaluate help search by corpus top-1 results.

rules.quote: A retrieval change is graded with
rules.rule: Grade any retrieval change with grade-retrieval.mjs.

rules.quote: iterate `flattenQuestions(loadQuestionPages())`
rules.rule: When grading retrieval in a scratchpad, import help.mjs with OWA_KNOWLEDGE_DIR set and iterate over flattenQuestions(loadQuestionPages()).

rules.quote: Grade every retrieval change against it
rules.rule: When changing retrieval/search ranking, grade the change against the labelled question corpus in tools/owa-devtools-mcp/questions/*.json.

rules.quote: plus a **held-out** set
rules.rule: When changing retrieval/search ranking, also grade the change against the held-out paraphrase set in test-results/chatbot-quality/, because the corpus cannot grade a change that indexes the corpus.

rules.quote: RE-MEASURE rather than comparing a new score to
rules.rule: When the question corpus has changed since a recorded measurement, re-measure the current score instead of comparing a new score to the old recorded absolute figures.

rules.quote: Aggregate top-1 is the wrong headline
rules.rule: When reporting the effect of a retrieval change on the assistant's answer quality, do not use aggregate top-1 accuracy as the headline figure.

rules.quote: Report the per-query delta (9 fixed / 3 broken) and the size
rules.rule: When reporting a retrieval change, report the per-query delta (queries fixed vs. broken) and the size of the affected class of misses, not the mean top-1 score.

rules.quote: diagnose window state with a user32 EnumWindows script
rules.rule: When diagnosing the visibility or minimized state of an app popup's OS window, use a user32 EnumWindows script rather than CDP.

rules.quote:
new code that renames, copies or deletes onto a path someone
reads through `FileSource.readFileData` must do the same.
rules.rule: When new code renames, copies, or deletes onto a path that is read through `FileSource.readFileData`, call `FileSource.forgetCachedData(path)` (or `forgetCachedDataUnder(dir)` for a directory) so the stale cached read is dropped.

rules.quote: Do not move the mouse to do this.
rules.rule: Do not move the mouse to reveal a hidden control; force its :hover state (via revealHidden) instead.

rules.quote: A caller must not test "is it hidden?" before asking for a reveal
rules.rule: Do not check whether a control is hidden before requesting a reveal for it; request the reveal directly.

rules.quote: Any visibility judgement written that way is answering the wrong question.
rules.rule: Do not judge whether a control is visible using getBoundingClientRect().width > 0.

rules.quote: Element.checkVisibility({checkVisibilityCSS: true, opacityProperty: true})
rules.rule: Use Element.checkVisibility({checkVisibilityCSS: true, opacityProperty: true}) to judge whether a control is visible to the user.

rules.quote: so press the dots first
rules.rule: For a control inside a closed auto-hide footer (.app-auto-hide), press the footer's three dots first to open it before interacting with the control.

rules.quote:
clear `window.__owaDomMatch` before
  believing a live result
rules.rule: Clear window.__owaDomMatch before believing a live DOM match result.

rules.quote:
route new downloads through `initHttpRequest` +
`streamDownloadFile`
rules.rule: When adding a new download, route it through `initHttpRequest` and `streamDownloadFile`.

rules.quote:
Calling `appProvider.httpUtils.request`
directly
rules.rule: Do not call `appProvider.httpUtils.request` directly for downloads, because it only supports https.

rules.quote:
`streamDownloadFile` takes a 4th `isSilentSuccess` arg for
flows that download into a temp dir and shouldn't toast that path.
rules.rule: When a download flow saves into a temp directory and should not show a success toast, pass `isSilentSuccess` as the 4th argument to `streamDownloadFile`.

rules.quote: give such an animation a small iteration count and let it end on its steady state
rules.rule: When giving an infinite paint-property animation a fix, set a small iteration count so it ends on its steady state.

rules.quote: or animate `opacity`/`transform` on its own layer
rules.rule: As an alternative to a paint-property animation, animate `opacity` or `transform` on its own layer.

rules.quote: Prove it with an idle `performance_start_trace` (`reload: false`)
rules.rule: Verify an animation fix with an idle `performance_start_trace` run using `reload: false`.

rules.quote: `Paint` and `BeginMainThreadFrame` per second for the app renderer's pid.
rules.rule: When checking the trace, count `Paint` and `BeginMainThreadFrame` events per second for the app renderer's pid.

rules.quote: `document.getAnimations().filter(a => a.playState === 'running')`
rules.rule: Check for live animations at rest by running `document.getAnimations().filter(a => a.playState === 'running')`, which should return an empty result when the fix holds.

rules.quote: judge on the trace.
rules.rule: Judge the result on the performance trace, not on OS CPU-seconds from `app-vitals.mjs`, when DevTools is open in dev.

rules.quote: with the user's OK
rules.rule: Trace the Presenter with a screen showing only after getting the user's OK.

rules.quote: report it,
rules.rule: When a `[trace]` plus `App document file not found: Default.own` appears on a bible-note, lyric-editor, or web-editor popup load, report it as a real finding.

rules.quote: don't wave it off.
rules.rule: Do not dismiss a `[trace]` plus `App document file not found: Default.own` on a bible-note, lyric-editor, or web-editor popup load as pre-existing noise.

rules.quote: check the entry file when a popup behaves differently from the tab.
rules.rule: When a popup behaves differently from the main tab, check the entry-point `*.tsx` file for top-level side effects that depend on query params.

rules.quote: in a jsdom test, read it at run time
rules.rule: In a jsdom test file, load `node:sqlite` at run time with `process.getBuiltinModule('node:sqlite')` instead of a static import.

rules.quote: `type DatabaseSync = InstanceType<typeof DatabaseSync>;` for the type
rules.rule: In a jsdom test file that loads `DatabaseSync` via `process.getBuiltinModule`, declare the type with `type DatabaseSync = InstanceType<typeof DatabaseSync>;`.

rules.quote: anything new that claims a layer must keep them.
rules.rule: Any new code that claims a keyboard layer must keep the three layer-stack rules: addLayer re-asserts, context menus close the previous one, and hosts close on unmount.

rules.quote: `addLayer` RE-ASSERTS rather than stacks
rules.rule: When addLayer is called for a layer already on the keyboard layer stack, re-assert it by moving it to the top instead of pushing a duplicate.

rules.quote: There is no legitimate "two context menus".
rules.rule: Never leave two context menus open at the same time.

rules.quote: `showAppContextMenu` closes whatever is open first
rules.rule: When showing a context menu, first close whatever is already open via contextControl.closeCurrent.

rules.quote: `useAppContextMenuData` fires a `close` on UNMOUNT
rules.rule: A host that uses useAppContextMenuData must fire a close on unmount so its keyboard layer is released.

rules.quote: A modal or popup now CLAIMS a layer, and its own keys have to go with it
rules.rule: When a modal or popup opens, it must claim a keyboard layer, and its own keys must be handled through that layer.

rules.quote: both through `useKeyboardLayerClaim` in
rules.rule: Claim a keyboard layer for a modal or popup through useKeyboardLayerClaim.

rules.quote: which REFCOUNTS per layer
rules.rule: Make useKeyboardLayerClaim reference-count claims per layer.

rules.quote: the inner one closing must not hand
rules.rule: Do not release a keyboard layer when a nested inner modal closes while the outer claim is still active.

rules.quote: Read during RENDER, parent
rules.rule: Inside a claiming wrapper, read the layer from KeyboardLayerContext during render, not from the layer stack at mount.

rules.quote: pass the layer to
rules.rule: A component that renders a claiming wrapper must pass the layer to useKeyboardRegistering by hand, because it sits above its own context provider.

rules.quote: A new or changed shortcut needs a catalog row
rules.rule: When adding or changing a keyboard shortcut, add a row for it to the catalog in src/keyboard-shortcut/keyboardShortcutCatalog.ts.

rules.quote: and its km + fr `tran`
rules.rule: When adding or changing a keyboard shortcut, add its km and fr `tran` keys, because dev throws without them.

rules.quote: grades on the assistant the user's window is set to (read the head row)
rules.rule: When running /owa-enhance-chatbot, grade the chatbot on the assistant the user's window is set to, reading that from the head row.

rules.quote: spaces Kimi asks ~60 s apart
rules.rule: When running /owa-enhance-chatbot against Kimi, space successive Kimi requests about 60 seconds apart.

rules.quote: expects 429s
rules.rule: When running /owa-enhance-chatbot against Kimi, expect 429 (rate-limit) responses from Kimi.

rules.quote: follows each chip through to the press a volunteer would make next
rules.rule: When running /owa-enhance-chatbot, follow each chip through to the next button press a volunteer would make, rather than grading only the first answer.

rules.quote: that is the model, not a hang
rules.rule: Do not treat Kimi K2.6's 15–60 second thinking time on a question under the 6000-token budget as a hang.

rules.quote: Never reuse `OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL_PATTERN` for Kimi.
rules.rule: Do not reuse `OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL_PATTERN` to match Kimi model IDs; Kimi needs its own model matching.

rules.quote: A fourth provider must extend `AISecretKeyNameType`
rules.rule: When adding a new chatbot provider, extend `AISecretKeyNameType` with its key name.

rules.quote: **The provider set is declared ONCE**, in `LLM_PROVIDER_MAP`
rules.rule: Declare the LLM provider set only once, in `LLM_PROVIDER_MAP`, and do not duplicate it elsewhere.

rules.quote:
`chatSessionHelpers.ts` keeps its own `Record<LlmProviderType, true>` instead of
importing the list
rules.rule: In `chatSessionHelpers.ts`, keep a local `Record<LlmProviderType, true>` rather than importing the provider list from `LLM_PROVIDER_MAP`.

rules.quote: so **all** of them need `OPENAI_MAX_TOKENS`
rules.rule: Give every Kimi model the large `OPENAI_MAX_TOKENS` budget, not only reasoning-model variants.

rules.quote:
Writing a doc: the token holds the exact `tran()` key and nothing else, the way
  `[en:tran:Clear Long Text]` does.
rules.rule: When writing a doc that names an app control, put only the exact tran() key in the template token, e.g. [en:tran:Clear Long Text], never a hand-written translation.

rules.quote: Never a hand-written twin
rules.rule: Never write a hand-written translated label beside an English label in a doc; use the template token instead.

rules.quote: The key must EXIST.
rules.rule: Ensure any tran() key used in a doc exists in the dictionary; do not use unknown keys.

rules.quote:
A language's words that are CONTENT — a bible's name, a book title in that
  language, a translation key like `ពគប`, or a name to type into the lookup —
  stay verbatim.
rules.rule: Keep a language's content words (bible names, book titles, translation keys, names to type into lookup) verbatim rather than templating them.

rules.quote:
Only labels
  are templated.
rules.rule: Only template UI labels; do not template content words.

rules.quote: A doc change still needs the knowledge rebuild
rules.rule: After changing a doc, run the knowledge rebuild.

rules.quote: raises `version` in that language's `meta.json` in the SAME change
rules.rule: When you touch any file under `src/lang/data/online/<code>/`, raise `version` in that language's `meta.json` in the same change.

rules.quote: patch for a fix, minor for new content
rules.rule: When raising a language's version, bump the patch number for a fix and the minor number for new content.

rules.quote: `meta.json` is the only place a version is written
rules.rule: Write a language's version only in its `meta.json`.

rules.quote: One raise per change (a commit), not per file saved in it.
rules.rule: Raise a language's version once per change (commit), not once per file saved in it.

rules.quote: Then pack it, in the same change
rules.rule: After raising a language's version, pack that language in the same change.

rules.quote: `npm run lang:pack -- --pack=<code>[,<code>]` for the languages touched
rules.rule: For the languages a change touches, run `npm run lang:pack -- --pack=<code>[,<code>]` with those language codes.

rules.quote: bare `npm run lang:pack` when a change touches many
rules.rule: When a change touches many languages, run bare `npm run lang:pack` instead of listing codes.

rules.quote: then in the dev app Settings > Languages > **Refresh** > **Update to**
rules.rule: After packing, in the dev app go to Settings > Languages, press Refresh, then press Update to.

rules.quote: so raise, THEN pack
rules.rule: Raise the language's version before packing it.

rules.quote: is reached by deleting the installed copy (its trash icon) and pressing **Install** again
rules.rule: To pack a second edit under a version that is already installed, delete the installed copy with its trash icon and press Install again.

rules.quote: it does not change `meta.json` and is no substitute
rules.rule: Do not use `npm run lang:pack -- --bump=<code>` as a substitute for raising the version in `meta.json`.

rules.quote: raise past the highest version EVER packed for the language
rules.rule: Choose a new version higher than the highest version ever packed for that language, including in the dev catalog (`extra-work/lang/info.json`).

rules.quote: A fact about another language goes in ITS folder, and raises ITS version.
rules.rule: Put a fact about a language in that language's own folder and raise that language's version.

rules.quote:
a new font list goes through `useFontList` (or the
`genLang*FontFamilies` / `genLangOpenLyricFontFaces` helpers for a package's
own picker), never `getFontFamilyMapByNodeFont` alone
rules.rule: When creating a new font list, build it through `useFontList` (or the `genLang*FontFamilies` / `genLangOpenLyricFontFaces` helpers for a language package's own picker), not through `getFontFamilyMapByNodeFont` alone.

rules.quote:
never drops the
`app-` faces
rules.rule: Never drop the `app-` font faces from a font list.

rules.quote:
something that puts Bible text in a new place sets
`getBibleFontFamily`'s face
rules.rule: When adding Bible text to a new place, set that text's font face using `getBibleFontFamily`'s face.

rules.quote: A caller that only needs fonts uses `initAllLangCss()`
rules.rule: When a caller only needs font data, use `initAllLangCss()`.

rules.quote: need a dictionary, a script test or book names, load the language (`getLangDataByCodeAsync`)
rules.rule: When a caller needs a dictionary, a script test, or book names, load the language with `getLangDataByCodeAsync` instead of using `initAllLangCss()`.

rules.quote: A language this window already loaded for real is used as it is
rules.rule: If the window has already fully loaded a language, use that loaded language as it is.

rules.quote: a plugin with no (or an unreadable) facts file is loaded whole, as before
rules.rule: If a language plugin has no facts file or an unreadable one, load the whole plugin.

rules.quote: A change to the facts' shape is a plugin-format change: raise every language's version
rules.rule: When changing the shape of the facts file, raise the version of every language.

rules.quote: `npm run lang:pack` (all 87)
rules.rule: When changing the shape of the facts file, run `npm run lang:pack` for all 87 languages.

rules.quote:
fix every app-side failure and
re-test first
rules.rule: For a language-quality goal, fix every app-side failure and re-test before doing anything else.

rules.quote:
measure each
language live
rules.rule: For a language-quality goal, measure each language live.

rules.quote: leave native review and model limits as open BN items
rules.rule: For a language-quality goal, leave native-speaker review and model limitations as open BN items instead of trying to resolve them automatically.

rules.quote: ask with the numbers instead of looping on a bar no run can reach
rules.rule: When a language-quality bar cannot be reached by any run, ask the user with the measured numbers instead of continuing to loop.

rules.quote: Never write the locale into the data folder's files again.
rules.rule: Never write the interface locale into the data folder's files.

rules.quote: to make another setting computer-wide, add its key to `COMPUTER_SETTING_NAME_LIST`
rules.rule: To make a setting computer-wide, add its key to COMPUTER_SETTING_NAME_LIST.

rules.quote: and to the catalog's `MOVED_TO_HOME_KEY_LIST` (+ `HOME_KEY_LEAF_MAP`)
rules.rule: To make a setting computer-wide, also add its key to the settings archive catalog's MOVED_TO_HOME_KEY_LIST and HOME_KEY_LEAF_MAP.

rules.quote: Every language but English lives in `src/lang/data/online/<code>/`
rules.rule: Keep every language except English in its own data folder at src/lang/data/online/<code>/, never in the app build.

rules.quote: a non-English check starts with `npm run lang:pack -- --pack=<code>` and Settings > Languages > Install.
rules.rule: Before any non-English check, run `npm run lang:pack -- --pack=<code>` and then install the language from Settings > Languages > Install.

rules.quote: A language whose source changed is packed again and updated (Refresh > Update to) before any live check
rules.rule: When a language's source has changed, repack it and update it (Refresh > Update to) before any live check.

rules.quote: Changing one raises its `meta.json` version
rules.rule: Raise a language's meta.json version whenever its data changes.

rules.quote: A language brings its own `locale` and `direction` in `meta.json`
rules.rule: Put a language's locale and direction in its own meta.json.

rules.quote: a new language edits nothing outside its folder
rules.rule: Do not edit anything outside a language's own folder when adding a language.

rules.quote: It is NOT open-lyric's song list
rules.rule: Do not use en/open-lyric-locales.json as the generic list of languages.

rules.quote: Never use `import.meta.url` in one
rules.rule: Never use import.meta.url in a language plugin.

rules.quote: assets resolve through `host.assetUrl()`
rules.rule: Resolve a language plugin's assets through host.assetUrl().

rules.quote: never the app's manifest.
rules.rule: Declare a language's song-plugin dependencies in the language's own package.json and node_modules, never in the app's manifest.

rules.quote: never a file in a plugin folder.
rules.rule: Turn a language on or off only through the home setting disabled-lang-codes, never through a file in a plugin folder.

rules.quote: call `forceReloadAppWindows()` once the change succeeds, never `applyStore.pendingApply()`.
rules.rule: After a language setting change succeeds, call forceReloadAppWindows() and never applyStore.pendingApply().

rules.quote: already in force reloads nothing
rules.rule: Do not reload any window when the language selected is already the one in force.

rules.quote: lights Apply instead, or the reload would wipe the toast telling the person
rules.rule: When a language delete fails because files are still in use, light Apply instead of reloading the app.

rules.quote: ask before changing it
rules.rule: Ask the user before changing the help window's owa_language install so it does not reload.

rules.quote: A window must `await ensureLangPlugins()` before reading the locale
rules.rule: Await ensureLangPlugins() in a window before reading the locale.

rules.quote: The chatbot/aichat entries import their pages AFTER `ensureLangFiles( 'assistant.json')`
rules.rule: Import the chatbot and aichat pages only after ensureLangFiles('assistant.json') has run.

rules.quote: A test that reads `getSupportedLangCodes()` synchronously must `await ensureLangPlugins()` first.
rules.rule: In a test that reads getSupportedLangCodes() synchronously, await ensureLangPlugins() first.

rules.quote: outward-facing, ask first.
rules.rule: Ask the user before running npm run release:lang to publish the language catalog.

rules.quote: it is one pass now — keep it so.
rules.rule: Keep the packages' duplicate-key check as a single pass, not a nested O(n²) loop.

rules.quote: Never put `dir` back on `<html>`
rules.rule: Never set the dir attribute on the html element for the UI.

rules.quote: give CONTENT its own `dir` instead
rules.rule: Give content elements their own dir attribute instead of setting dir on html.

rules.quote: is withheld from the model
rules.rule: Do not expose owa_language to the model.

rules.quote: and offers **Install it** / **Not now** -- the press is the consent.
rules.rule: When a language is missing, offer Install it and Not now in the help window, and install only if the user presses Install it.

rules.quote: A check that fails says nothing and the conversation goes on.
rules.rule: When a language check fails, say nothing and let the conversation continue.

rules.quote: A new chat string is a key in all fifty packages
rules.rule: Add a new chat string as a key in every language package.

rules.quote: and a version bump of each.
rules.rule: Bump the version of each language package when a new chat string is added.

rules.quote: _all keys are translated, fail on dev for non traslated_
rules.rule: Translate every key in each language package, so that a missing key fails in dev.

rules.quote: each at least a `meta.json`, a `flag.svg` and a `dictionary.json` of EVERY key
rules.rule: Give each language folder at least a meta.json, a flag.svg and a dictionary.json containing every key.

rules.quote:
stops when the newest batch -- the current code, the current
held-out set -- is read Best in 95% of its reads
rules.rule: Stop the lesson-goal loop once the newest batch is read Best in at least 95% of its reads.

rules.quote:
count Best of 32 for the newest
batch once it is unblinded against `lesson-ab.mjs`'s key (the `after`
rows of both readers)
rules.rule: After each blind read, once the newest batch is unblinded against lesson-ab.mjs's key, count Best out of 32 using the after rows of both readers.

rules.quote:
At 31 or more, write its scoreboard row, push,
and stop the loop and say so
rules.rule: When the newest batch has 31 or more Best of 32, write its scoreboard row, push, stop the loop, and tell the user it has stopped.

rules.quote:
below it, keep fixing what the reads
name

rules.quote: the driving has to go through the app
