rules.quote: Asking the skill for `presentingFlow` (or `run sheet` / `.owpf`) selects **presenting flow deep mode**
rules.rule: When asked for presentingFlow (or run sheet / .owpf), run the presenting flow deep mode.

rules.quote: runs P0..P10 in order
rules.rule: In presenting flow mode, run phases P0 through P10 in order.

rules.quote: Scope = 69 rows: PL-10, PL-29, PL-32..PL-76, PL-81..PL-102.
rules.rule: In presenting flow mode, limit scope to the 69 rows PL-10, PL-29, PL-32..PL-76, and PL-81..PL-102.

rules.quote: out of scope except where the fixture uses them
rules.rule: Treat other PL rows as out of scope in presenting flow mode, except where the fixture uses them.
When the presenting flow scope is touched, also cover the adjacent rows PL-77..80, NAV-17/18, and XW-01..07.

rules.quote: driving the real `screen.html` target
rules.rule: Discharge the mandatory core (§6a) in presenting flow mode by presenting from the sheet and driving the real screen.html target.

rules.quote: build `zz-robot-<runid>` and tear it down
rules.rule: Build a fixture named zz-robot-<runid> for the run, and tear it down afterward.

rules.quote: get their own report lines
rules.rule: Give their own report lines to every screen action fired against a SHOWING screen (PL-72/74), the folded-sheet walk (PL-99), and the perf measurements with numbers (PL-63/70).

rules.quote: add a scratch screen 1 and Solo it
rules.rule: On a one-display machine, add a scratch screen 1 and Solo it.

rules.quote: Plan its teardown up front
rules.rule: Plan the scratch screen's teardown before starting the run.

rules.quote: clears it layer by layer, hides it, re-Solos screen 0 and asks the user to delete it
rules.rule: When tearing down the scratch screen, clear it layer by layer, hide it, re-Solo screen 0, and ask the user to delete it.

rules.quote: It must be `GetTypefaces()` with `IsBoldSimulated` faces dropped
rules.rule: When enumerating a font family's weights on Windows, call GetTypefaces() and drop faces marked IsBoldSimulated.

rules.quote:
NEVER
  `FamilyTypefaces`
rules.rule: Never use FamilyTypefaces to enumerate a font family's weights on Windows.

rules.quote: Weight NAMES (`700 Bold`) are not `tran()`'d
rules.rule: Do not pass weight names such as `700 Bold` through tran().

rules.quote:
on a Mac or Linux robot run, open a text box's Font section
and check the weight select lists more than `Default` for a multi-weight
family before trusting it
rules.rule: On a Mac or Linux robot run, before trusting the font list, open a text box's Font section and verify that the weight select lists more than Default for a multi-weight family.

rules.quote: fix the parser against the real output
rules.rule: Fix the macOS/Linux font-list parser against real system output rather than synthetic test output.

rules.quote: Do not drop the question to make offline smoother
rules.rule: Do not remove the unverified-file confirmation question to make offline pack imports smoother.

rules.quote:
The unverified-file confirm
cannot be answered by an agent
rules.rule: Do not answer the unverified-file confirmation yourself; it can only be answered by a person.

rules.quote:
leave it
for the person or test that path
rules.rule: When the unverified-file confirmation appears during testing, leave it for the person to answer.

rules.quote: test that path with a file the dev pack vouches for
rules.rule: To test the unverified-file path, use a file that the dev pack vouches for.

rules.quote: `WM_SETTEXT` the path, then `WM_COMMAND` `IDOK`
rules.rule: To drive the native Open dialog in a live test, set the file box text to the path with WM_SETTEXT, then send WM_COMMAND with IDOK.

rules.quote:
`robocopy <repo> release\rbsrc-<runid> /E /XJ /XD <repo>\node_modules <repo>\.git <repo>\release
   <repo>\dist <repo>\electron-build <repo>\coverage <repo>\coverage-electron <repo>\test-results
   <repo>\extra-work\tmp <repo>\extra-work\experiment-building`
rules.rule: When packing a release while a dev app is running, create the snapshot by copying the repo into release\rbsrc-<runid> with the robocopy command that excludes node_modules, .git, release, dist, electron-build, coverage, coverage-electron, test-results, extra-work\tmp, and extra-work\experiment-building.

rules.quote: then `mklink /J release\rbsrc-<runid>\node_modules <repo>\node_modules`
rules.rule: After copying the snapshot, create a directory junction at release\rbsrc-<runid>\node_modules that points to the repo's node_modules using mklink /J.

rules.quote:
In the snapshot: `npm run build`, then
   `electron-builder build --win "-c.directories.output=<repo>/release"`
rules.rule: Inside the snapshot, run npm run build and then electron-builder build --win with the output directory set to <repo>/release.

rules.quote: `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1`
rules.rule: When running electron-builder from Git Bash, set MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1.

rules.quote: Unlink the junction before deleting the snapshot.
rules.rule: Unlink the node_modules junction before deleting the snapshot directory.

rules.quote: Check `fs.lstatSync(p).isSymbolicLink()`
rules.rule: Before deleting the snapshot, check with fs.lstatSync(p).isSymbolicLink() whether the node_modules path is a symbolic link.

rules.quote: and `fs.unlinkSync(p)` (Node removes only the link)
rules.rule: Remove the node_modules junction with fs.unlinkSync(p), not a recursive delete.

rules.quote:
then verify `<repo>/node_modules` is
  intact
rules.rule: After unlinking the junction, verify that <repo>/node_modules is intact.

rules.quote: then `rm -rf`
rules.rule: Only after verifying the repo's node_modules is intact, delete the snapshot with rm -rf.

rules.quote: never upload them
rules.rule: Never upload the test builds produced from a snapshot.

rules.quote: Run the gate in the repo, not the snapshot
rules.rule: Run test:electron in the repo, not in the snapshot.

rules.quote: `lint:all:error`, `test` and `lint:es` run fine in the snapshot
rules.rule: Run lint:all:error, test, and lint:es in the snapshot.

rules.quote:
`lint:pre`/`test:electron` are check-only and
  safe in the repo beside a dev app.
rules.rule: Lint:pre and test:electron may be run in the repo while a dev app is running, since they are check-only.

rules.quote: Compare the live tree to the snapshot with `cmp` per changed file
rules.rule: To compare the live tree with the snapshot, use cmp on each changed file.

rules.quote:
writing rows
into the head
rules.rule: To fill a presenting flow, write the rows into the head file <file>.owpf.histories/<n>-head rather than editing the .owpf file on disk.

rules.quote: Write that JSON from a script file, not an inline `node -e`
rules.rule: Write JSON for the history head from a script file, not from an inline node -e command.

rules.quote: One that sets `widgetName` by hand should set `widgetKey` too whenever an English name exists.
rules.rule: When setting `widgetName` by hand on a panel, also set `widgetKey` whenever an English name exists for that panel.

rules.quote: Name a new floating panel and check the same thing: does anything else on screen already answer to that word?
rules.rule: When naming a new floating panel, check whether anything else on screen already answers to that word, since a named element competes as a control in the matcher.

rules.quote: Before "fixing" a matcher that cannot find a panel, check the panel is _named_ first
rules.rule: Before changing a DOM matcher that fails to find a panel, check that the panel has a name attribute.

rules.quote: verify in BOTH the open and the collapsed state
rules.rule: Verify a panel-related fix in both the open and the collapsed states before considering it fixed.

rules.quote: A scope must FIT the panel, not merely share its words
rules.rule: When matching a scope to a panel, require that the scope fits the panel itself, not merely that it shares words with the panel's label.

rules.quote: Scopes are tiers 0-2 now
rules.rule: Restrict scope matching to match tiers 0 through 2 only (SCOPE_MAX_TIER in domMatch.mjs).

rules.quote: A live re-check needs a fresh server AND a page reload
rules.rule: Before a live re-check of matcher changes, restart the server and reload the page, since the server caches the module and the page memoises the matcher.

rules.quote: `--no-run` always
rules.rule: When running coverage-gap.mjs, always pass `--no-run`.

rules.quote: never another flag
rules.rule: Never pass any flag to coverage-gap.mjs other than `--no-run`.

rules.quote: to their own `--coverage.reportsDirectory`
rules.rule: Send focused coverage output to the agent's own `--coverage.reportsDirectory`, not to the shared report directory.

rules.quote: Put `node extra-work/language-confinement.mjs <their new files>` in the brief
rules.rule: Include `node extra-work/language-confinement.mjs <their new files>` in the brief given to test-writing agents.

rules.quote: A test about one language goes in its package's own `tests/`
rules.rule: Put a test about one language in that language package's own `tests/` folder.

rules.quote: with a scratch tsconfig that `extends` the repo's and `include`s
rules.rule: Let agents check only their own files with a scratch tsconfig that extends the repo's tsconfig and includes `src/**/*.d.ts` plus their test files.

rules.quote: own compiler, `node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc`
rules.rule: Type-check with the gate's own compiler, `node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc`.

rules.quote: repo's own node_modules/@types, with the node types named
rules.rule: In a scratch tsconfig, point the type roots at the repo's own node_modules/@types and name the node types explicitly.

rules.quote: only through a scratch config that extends `electron.tsconfig.json`
rules.rule: Type-check an electron test only through a scratch config that extends `electron.tsconfig.json`.

rules.quote: write `Mock<(value: number) => void>`
rules.rule: Type a mock passed as a typed prop as `Mock<(value: number) => void>` instead of `ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>`.

rules.quote: Six agents was the right size for a ~400-line gap
rules.rule: For a gap of about 400 uncovered lines, use six agents, each on a disjoint batch.

rules.quote: Run ~8 at a time
rules.rule: Run about 8 subagents concurrently, not 17.

rules.quote: when the agents are idle
rules.rule: Measure full-suite runs only when no agents are running.

rules.quote: Build such characters at run time or fix
rules.rule: Build invisible or special characters at run time, or fix them afterwards, instead of writing them as escapes in file content.

rules.quote: confine searches to `src`, `electron`,
rules.rule: Confine agent file searches to `src`, `electron`, and `tools`, not `extra-work/`.

rules.quote: a made-up language (`xx`, an invented name)
rules.rule: Use a made-up language such as `xx` in any test fixture that needs a language.

rules.quote: never an ASCII spelling of a real one
rules.rule: Never use an ASCII spelling of a real language's name in a test fixture.

rules.quote: File-path and file-name logic belongs in `src/server/fileHelpers.ts`
rules.rule: Put all file-path and file-name logic in src/server/fileHelpers.ts.

rules.quote: A call site asks fileHelpers;
rules.rule: At call sites, request path and file-name handling from fileHelpers rather than implementing it locally.

rules.quote: it does not `split('/')`
rules.rule: Do not split paths on '/' at call sites; use fileHelpers instead.

rules.quote: `lastIndexOf(pathSeparator)`
rules.rule: Do not call lastIndexOf(pathSeparator) at call sites; use fileHelpers instead.

rules.quote: or keep its own sanitizer
rules.rule: Do not keep a file-name sanitizer at call sites; use the fileHelpers sanitizer instead.

rules.quote: The primitives themselves may live in a leaf
rules.rule: Path primitives may be defined in the leaf module storageFileHelpers.ts, re-exported by fileHelpers.ts.

rules.quote: Start-up code imports the leaf;
rules.rule: Start-up code must import path primitives from the leaf module storageFileHelpers.ts, not from fileHelpers.ts.

rules.quote: everything else still asks fileHelpers.
rules.rule: All code other than start-up code must get path handling from fileHelpers.ts.

rules.quote: add a new path/name helper to fileHelpers.ts
rules.rule: Add new path or file-name helpers to fileHelpers.ts.

rules.quote: When touching a site that parses paths itself, route it through fileHelpers.
rules.rule: When modifying a site that parses paths itself, route that parsing through fileHelpers.

rules.quote: rule borrowed with `importOriginal`
rules.rule: A test file that stubs ./fileHelpers wholesale must borrow the real rule from the original module using importOriginal.

rules.quote: and `pathUtils.sep` on its appProvider
rules.rule: A test file that stubs ./fileHelpers wholesale must also set pathUtils.sep on its appProvider stub.

rules.quote: Compare paths only through it
rules.rule: Compare paths only through toPathCompareKey.

rules.quote: a separator added to a key goes through it too
rules.rule: When adding a separator to a path key before a prefix check, pass the result through toPathCompareKey.

rules.quote: never reintroduce a per-slide loop in that preload
rules.rule: Never reintroduce a per-slide loop in the presenter's attached-background preload (preloadAttachedBackground); it must make a single file-scoped getAttachedBackground call.

rules.quote: must ride a short-lived setting read on mount AND on window focus
rules.rule: When deep-linking into an already-open or new popup window at a specific field, deliver the request through a short-lived setting that the target reads, rather than through a URL query parameter.

rules.quote: the target reads it on MOUNT (a new window)
rules.rule: The target popup window must read the one-shot request setting when it mounts.

rules.quote: and on `window` `focus` (an open one the dedupe raised)
rules.rule: The target popup window must also read the one-shot request setting on its window focus event.

rules.quote: write a one-shot setting (`setting-ai-key-focus`, JSON with `requestedAt`, ignored after 30 s) BEFORE `openPopupWindow`
rules.rule: Before calling openPopupWindow to open a popup deep-link, write the one-shot request setting (JSON with requestedAt, ignored after 30 s).

rules.quote: Read with `getSettingForce`, never `getSetting`
rules.rule: When reading the deep-link request setting, use getSettingForce, never getSetting.

rules.quote: The component that owns the target TAKES (removes) the request
rules.rule: The component that owns the deep-link target must take (remove) the request setting after handling it.

rules.quote: a parent that only picks the tab looks without taking
rules.rule: A parent component that only selects the tab must read the request setting without removing it.

rules.quote: bring the picking window forward first (`Page.bringToFront`)
rules.rule: When driving the pick over CDP, call Page.bringToFront on the picking window before evaluating the pick.

rules.quote: any "open window X at thing Y" asked from another window.
rules.rule: When another window asks to open window X at thing Y, use this deep-link pattern.

rules.quote: never "simplify" it to a plain `replaceAll`
rules.rule: Never replace the `$DATA_DIR_PATH` alias with a plain `replaceAll`; use a function-based replacement, because `$&` in a folder name is treated as a replacement pattern.

rules.quote: must go through `fileHelpers` or apply the transform itself
rules.rule: When adding a new raw reader or writer of data-folder text, route it through `fileHelpers` or apply the alias transform in the new code itself.

rules.quote: A NAME derived from a path goes through `toDataDirRelativePath`
rules.rule: When a file name is derived from a path, pass it through `toDataDirRelativePath`.

rules.quote: never the absolute path
rules.rule: Never use an absolute path as a file name derived from a path inside the data folder.

rules.quote: decide whether it must see real paths or the alias.
rules.rule: When adding code that reads, writes, copies or packs data-folder text, or hands such a file to something other than the app's own readers, decide whether that code must see real paths or the alias.

rules.quote: Stale absolute paths are repaired on request
rules.rule: Repair stale absolute paths only when the user requests it (Repair Links), not automatically.

rules.quote: Never automatic: it reads every text file once.
rules.rule: Do not run the Repair Links operation automatically, since it reads every text file once.

rules.quote: The user wants every such path/name helper in `src/server/fileHelpers.ts`
rules.rule: Place every path/name helper in `src/server/fileHelpers.ts`.

rules.quote: use `grep -- pattern ./*`
rules.rule: When searching the settings folder from a shell, use `grep -- pattern ./*` so files whose names start with `-` are not read as options.

rules.quote: Edit `pptx-in-html-out` (C# and `PptxToHtml-JS`)
rules.rule: When changing the PPTX converter, edit the `pptx-in-html-out` source (both the C# and `PptxToHtml-JS` parts).

rules.quote: bump the version on both sides
rules.rule: When changing the PPTX converter, bump its version on both the C# and `PptxToHtml-JS` sides.

rules.quote: `./pack.sh --only pptx` builds `packages/pptx-to-html-conv`.
rules.rule: To build the PPTX converter package after a converter change, run `./pack.sh --only pptx`.

rules.quote: Sync that into `../pptx-to-html-conv-dist`.
rules.rule: Sync the built PPTX converter package into `../pptx-to-html-conv-dist`.

rules.quote: `npm install` in the app refreshes the copy.
rules.rule: After syncing the converter dist folder, run `npm install` in the app to refresh the copied package.

rules.quote: Relaunch, because the main process holds the converter module.
rules.rule: After the converter is updated, relaunch the app so the main process loads the new converter module.

rules.quote: Check with `node -e "require('pptx-to-html-conv').getVersion()"`
rules.rule: To verify the converter is installed and loadable, run `node -e "require('pptx-to-html-conv').getVersion()"`.

rules.quote: after any converter edit, repack and reinstall before a live check
rules.rule: After any converter edit, repack the converter before a live check.

rules.quote: after any converter edit, repack and reinstall before a live check
rules.rule: After any converter edit, reinstall the converter before a live check.

rules.quote: When conversion fails in the main process, look for the symlink first.
rules.rule: When PPTX conversion fails in the main process, check whether `node_modules/pptx-to-html-conv` is a symlink before investigating further.

rules.quote:
check the new
graph's top levels for `new Function` / `eval` / a library that does it at
load; make such code lazy.
rules.rule: Before adding an import from a main-process module into `electronHelpers` (or anything a `client/*` preload reaches), check the new import graph's top-level code for `new Function`, `eval`, or a library that calls them at load time.

rules.quote: make such code lazy.
rules.rule: If code that uses `new Function`, `eval`, or a library doing so at load is found in a preload's import graph, make it lazy (run on first call instead of at module load).

rules.quote:
open the chatbot window FRESH (not a
reload) and read its console.
rules.rule: To check for preload load failures, open the chatbot window fresh (not via reload) and read its console.

rules.quote: Fix a rule in the shared module, not here.
rules.rule: When changing a rule for the presenting-flow archive export/import that is shared with the single-document bundle, make the fix in src/helper/appArchiveHelpers.ts, not in src/presenting-flow/presentingFlowArchiveHelpers.ts.

rules.quote: a CDP-fabricated `dataTransfer` with `appFilePath` on the `File` drives the whole
rules.rule: When QA-testing the dropped-import pipeline for presenting-flow archives, simulate the drop with a CDP-fabricated dataTransfer whose File has appFilePath set to a real file on disk.

rules.quote: The one signal is the preview's CURSOR changing
rules.rule: Run-moving clocks (timeout and interval) must respond only to the preview's cursor changing, never to raw clicks or key presses.

rules.quote: Do not "fix" this into cancelling.
rules.rule: Do not change an interval so that a run moving somewhere cancels it; it is cleared only by its own off controls, the widget closing, reaching the end of the sheet, or the Next: Clear Interval action.

rules.quote: a time already gone by is refused with `The set time is already due` and arms nothing
rules.rule: When arming a time of day, refuse a time that has already passed today with the message 'The set time is already due' and arm nothing.

rules.quote: never rolled over to tomorrow
rules.rule: Never roll a past time-of-day arming over to tomorrow.

rules.quote: each tick RE-READS the remainder from it
rules.rule: While a dueTime is set, each tick must re-read the remaining time from the wall clock rather than subtracting one per tick.

rules.quote: A timeout met by a running interval LENDS it its count for one cycle
rules.rule: When a timeout meets a running interval, lend the interval its count for one cycle instead of replacing the interval.

rules.quote: A CC'd timeout BORROWING a held interval's cycle does not let it go
rules.rule: A CC'd timeout borrowing a held interval's cycle must not un-hold that interval.

rules.quote: which is dropped when the cycle ends
rules.rule: Drop a borrowed cycle's dueTime when that cycle ends.

rules.quote: Pausing CLEARS the ticking rather than skipping
rules.rule: When pausing a clock, clear its ticking rather than skipping ticks on a flag.

rules.quote: a paused countdown gives up its `dueTime`
rules.rule: When a countdown is paused, drop its dueTime.

rules.quote: The pill goes dashed while held
rules.rule: Show the pill as dashed while its clock is held.

rules.quote: The only thing withheld is another JUMP
rules.rule: When a jump lands, do not fire another jump from that landing.

rules.quote: Doing it twice is doing it once and says nothing
rules.rule: Running Next: Clear Interval when an interval is already cleared must do nothing and show no message.

rules.quote: with no run open it refuses with the family's `Open the presenting flow preview to use this action`
rules.rule: Refuse Next: Clear Interval with the message 'Open the presenting flow preview to use this action' when no run is open.

rules.quote: a line named after the interval must not silently kill a wait
rules.rule: Next: Clear Interval must end only a running interval and must never cancel a timeout.

rules.quote: Every path that ARMS one settles the cursor FIRST
rules.rule: Every code path that arms a clock must settle the preview cursor before arming, so the arming gesture cannot cancel itself.

rules.quote: Keep it that way.
rules.rule: Keep arming paths settling the cursor before arming.

rules.quote: notifies the panel's listeners ONLY
rules.rule: When a repair writes back a shifted selection position, notify only the panel's listeners and not the run-moving notification.

rules.quote: nothing in this module may hold a run sheet or a document's slides
rules.rule: Never hold a run sheet or a document's slides in the auto-next helpers module; the run controller is registered from outside.

rules.quote: Unregistering stops the clock.
rules.rule: When a run controller is unregistered, stop its clock.

rules.quote: A tick settles the slot BEFORE stepping and re-checks a `generation` counter after
rules.rule: On each tick, settle the slot before stepping, then re-check the generation counter afterward and hand over the clock if it changed.

rules.quote: `firePresentingFlowRunAction` lives in THIS module, not `presentingFlowHelpers`
rules.rule: Define firePresentingFlowRunAction in the auto-next helpers module, not in presentingFlowHelpers.

rules.quote: `PresentingFlowItem` is a TYPE-only import here
rules.rule: Import PresentingFlowItem as a type-only import in the auto-next helpers module.

rules.quote: the toast is titled with the action's own label
rules.rule: Title each auto-next toast with that action's own label.

rules.quote: both the question and the setter deal in one `PresentingFlowActionArmingType`
rules.rule: Both the arming question and the arming setter must use the single PresentingFlowActionArmingType.

rules.quote: `applyPresentingFlowActionArming` DELETES the other
rules.rule: When applying an arming, delete the other alternative (actionNumber or actionTime) so only one remains.

rules.quote: **A CC stores `{uuid, screenIds?}` and NOTHING else.**
rules.rule: A CC entry in a presenting flow must store only a uuid and optional screenIds, and nothing else.

rules.quote: Every entry carries a `uuid`
rules.rule: Every presenting flow entry must carry a uuid.

rules.quote: `genPresentingFlowItemUuid`, minted on add
rules.rule: Mint a new uuid with genPresentingFlowItemUuid when adding a presenting flow entry.

rules.quote: a DUPLICATE is re-keyed
rules.rule: When an entry is duplicated, re-key the duplicate with a new uuid.

rules.quote: reading a sheet never rewrites a file
rules.rule: Never rewrite a presenting flow file just because a sheet was read.

rules.quote: only when something first points at it
rules.rule: Give a legacy entry without a uuid one only when something first points at it.

rules.quote: is read off that entry every time
rules.rule: Read what a CC shows and sends from the entry it references every time, not from a stored copy.

rules.quote: re-arming a `Next: Timeout` element re-arms
rules.rule: Re-arming a Next: Timeout element must re-arm every CC of it at once.

rules.quote: **Resolution needs the LIST, not the item.**
rules.rule: Resolve CC references using the full list of presenting flow items, not a single item.

rules.quote: Rows are stamped `data-presenting-flow-item-uuid`
rules.rule: Stamp each presenting flow row with a data-presenting-flow-item-uuid attribute holding its bare uuid.

rules.quote: **Every CC has an element of its own in the sheet.**
rules.rule: Every CC must have its own element in the sheet.

rules.quote: APPENDED at the bottom first and the CC then points at it;
rules.rule: When a payload is dropped from outside, append it at the bottom of the sheet first and then point the CC at it.

rules.quote: presenting flow is copied in the same way
rules.rule: When a row is dragged from another presenting flow, copy it in as a new element and point the CC at the copy.

rules.quote: in ONE write (`PresentingFlow.attachItemCcItem`)
rules.rule: Append the element and attach the CC in one write, so a refused attach never leaves an appended line.

rules.quote: Removing an element DROPS every CC of it
rules.rule: When removing an element, drop every CC that points at it.

rules.quote: a reference answering to nothing is simply not
rules.rule: Do not draw a CC reference that points at nothing.

rules.quote: **A CC must never reach `chooseScreenIds`.**
rules.rule: Never pass a CC to chooseScreenIds.

rules.quote: It rides the screens its host resolved to
rules.rule: A CC must ride the screens its host resolved to.

rules.quote: Passing an empty list as a preset falls through to the
rules.rule: Never pass an empty list as the preset when choosing screens for a CC.

rules.quote: The latch is keyed by the NATIVE event, never React's wrapper
rules.rule: Key the screen-choosing latch by the native event, never by React's wrapper event.

rules.quote: same event across its `setTimeout`.
rules.rule: selectVarySlide must carry the same event across its setTimeout.

rules.quote: Arming happens at `sendPresentingFlowItemToScreens`
rules.rule: Arm CCs through sendPresentingFlowItemToScreens.

rules.quote: A document entry's own CCs ride with **every** slide of it
rules.rule: A document entry's own CCs must ride with every slide of that document.

rules.quote: **Dropping onto a row now attaches a CC instead of appending an element.**
rules.rule: Dropping a payload onto a row must attach a CC instead of appending an element.

rules.quote: The drop MUST
rules.rule: A drop onto a row must call stopPropagation().

rules.quote: A `null` payload must not stop propagation.
rules.rule: A drop with a null payload must not call stopPropagation().

rules.quote: the presenting flow NAME row / empty state only
rules.rule: Add a new element only from the presenting flow name row or the empty state.

rules.quote: source from the presenting flow BY INDEX (`PresentingFlow.addItemCcFromItemIndex`) instead of from
rules.rule: When presentingFlowDraggingStore.current is set, resolve the drop source from the presenting flow by index instead of from dataTransfer.

rules.quote: take the POSITION, the middle attaches
rules.rule: On an element row drop, the top and bottom bands set the position and the middle attaches.

rules.quote: **Ctrl/⌘ forces the position, Alt forces the attach**
rules.rule: Holding Ctrl/⌘ forces a position drop and holding Alt forces an attach drop, anywhere on the row.

rules.quote: Ctrl wins
rules.rule: When both Ctrl and Alt are held on a row drop, treat it as a position drop.

rules.quote: so it attaches unless Ctrl is held
rules.rule: An outside payload dropped on a row attaches unless Ctrl is held.

rules.quote: The handlers live on `PresentingFlowRowComp`, NOT
rules.rule: Put the row drop handlers on PresentingFlowRowComp, not on PresentingFlowItemComp's wrapper.

rules.quote: Slide rows and CC rows have nothing to reorder, so their whole row
rules.rule: Slide rows and CC rows must attach the whole row on drop and never reorder.

rules.quote: It is fired from `applyPresentingFlowCcItemsOnScreenIds` before the screen
rules.rule: Fire a Next: Timeout CC from applyPresentingFlowCcItemsOnScreenIds before screen resolution, so it never asks for a screen.

rules.quote: A `Next: Interval` is the one
rules.rule: Refuse a Next: Interval as a CC.

rules.quote: the split is `canBeCcItem` on the registry entry
rules.rule: Decide whether a kind can be a CC by its canBeCcItem flag on the registry entry.

rules.quote: BORROWS its cycle rather than replacing it
rules.rule: A CC'd timeout met by a running interval must borrow its cycle rather than replace it.

rules.quote: **A `Jump to` host turns the CC into a POINTER, not a follower**
rules.rule: A Jump to host must treat its CC as a pointer to a target line, not as a follower.

rules.quote: Exactly one, capped in `attachItemCcItem`
rules.rule: A Jump to host must have exactly one CC target, enforced in attachItemCcItem and again when reading ccItems.

rules.quote: **A CC is NEVER parked.**
rules.rule: Never park a CC.

rules.quote: Clicking a CC row never presents it
rules.rule: Clicking a CC row must reveal the element it points at, never present it.

rules.quote: the preview's frame capture handler must skip
rules.rule: The preview's frame capture handler must skip elements matching [data-presenting-flow-cc-row].

rules.quote: **Migrating a real presenting flow means migrating `<file>.owpf.histories/<n>-head`**
rules.rule: When migrating a real presenting flow, also migrate its .owpf.histories/<n>-head file, not just the .owpf file.

rules.quote: don't reintroduce a derived identity
rules.rule: Do not reintroduce a derived identity for presenting flow entries; use uuids.

rules.quote: Use a clear action to take both down.
rules.rule: To take down both a live slide and its CC, use a clear action.

rules.quote: `box-sizing: content-box` on the gutter.
rules.rule: Set `box-sizing: content-box` on the run-sheet gutter component (not border-box).

rules.quote: pass `lineNumber={null}`
rules.rule: Run-sheet rows that the run cannot stop on (CC followers, a document's slides, placeholders) must pass `lineNumber={null}` to the gutter.

rules.quote: they still draw the gutter
rules.rule: Run-sheet rows that the run cannot stop on must still draw the gutter so the rail stays unbroken and labels align.

rules.quote: `depth` indents **after** the gutter, never as row padding
rules.rule: Indent nested run-sheet rows by `depth` after the gutter, never as row padding.

rules.quote: The tree's cursor comes from `usePresentingFlowPreviewIsItemSelected`
rules.rule: Derive the tree row's run cursor from `usePresentingFlowPreviewIsItemSelected`, the same store the preview widget uses.

rules.quote: applied by a class on the *row*, not passed into the gutter
rules.rule: Apply the run cursor as a class on the row, not as a prop passed into the gutter.

rules.quote: Rows are `role="button"` + `tabIndex={0}`
rules.rule: Make run-sheet rows `role="button"` with `tabIndex={0}`.

rules.quote: answer **Enter only**
rules.rule: Make run-sheet rows respond to Enter only, and do not add a Space handler to them.

rules.quote: change the gutter in one place
rules.rule: Change the run-sheet gutter in one place only, shared by the tree row and the preview header.

rules.quote: check both panels
rules.rule: After changing the run-sheet gutter, check both the tree and the floating preview.

rules.quote: Colour decisions here follow [[console-design-system-tokens]]
rules.rule: Make colour decisions for the run-sheet gutter follow the console design system tokens.

rules.quote: re-add the element from its own list
rules.rule: When a presenting flow element drop onto another presenting flow's card is a no-op, re-add the element from its own list instead.

rules.quote: not a bug to re-file
rules.rule: Do not re-file the cross-presenting-flow drag no-op as a bug.

rules.quote: it MUST `stopPropagation()`
rules.rule: When handling a drop onto a presenting flow row, call stopPropagation() so the drop does not also reach PresentingFlowFileComp.

rules.quote: clicks in the presenting flow tree `stopPropagation`
rules.rule: Call stopPropagation() on clicks inside the presenting flow tree so they do not bubble to the enclosing FileItemHandlerComp li.

rules.quote: goes through `toPresentingFlowSettingName`
rules.rule: Pass every setting name the presenting flow persists through toPresentingFlowSettingName.

rules.quote: Presenting Flow rows reach a screen through `dragStore.onDropped`, not `dataTransfer`.
rules.rule: Deliver presenting flow rows to a screen through dragStore.onDropped, not dataTransfer.

rules.quote: do not "simplify" that subscription away
rules.rule: Do not remove or simplify the subscription that makes PresentingFlowDocumentSlidesComp re-subscribe to its referenced document's update event and re-run loadVaryAppDocumentSlides.

rules.quote: keep the timer per-instance
rules.rule: Keep the genTimeoutAttempt(500) debounce timer in PresentingFlowDocumentSlidesComp per component instance, not at module level.

rules.quote: Do not confuse this with PL-62
rules.rule: Do not treat the expanded-document stale-rows bug as PL-62, which concerns the .owpf file itself.

rules.quote: never key these rows by position again
rules.rule: Never key presenting-flow item rows by their array position or index; key each row by its entry's uuid.

rules.quote: do not "fix" that
rules.rule: Do not change the behavior where two entries of the same document share one expansion setting and expand together.

rules.quote: Ctrl and Shift ONLY, and at least one of them.
rules.rule: When arming a Keyboard Event run action with a shortcut, only allow Ctrl and/or Shift as modifiers, requiring at least one of them; do not allow Alt, Meta, or a bare key.

rules.quote: A bare key is refused because `ArrowDown`/`Space` step the run.
rules.rule: Do not allow a bare key (no Ctrl or Shift modifier) as a Keyboard Event shortcut, because bare keys like ArrowDown or Space would step the run.

rules.quote: **UNIQUE per presenting flow**, enforced in `PresentingFlow` (the write funnel), not at the question:
rules.rule: Ensure each Keyboard Event shortcut is unique within a presenting flow, enforcing this in the PresentingFlow write path rather than at the question prompt.

rules.quote: `duplicateItemAtIndex` / `addItemCcFromItemIndex` DELETE `actionKey` on the copy
rules.rule: When duplicating an item or adding a CC from an item index, delete the actionKey on the copy so it does not retain the original's shortcut.

rules.quote: `collectPresentingFlowRunShortcutKeys` still dedupes on read (first wins)
rules.rule: When collecting presenting flow run shortcut keys, deduplicate them on read, keeping the first occurrence.

rules.quote: It is the ONE run action that resolves screens.
rules.rule: The Keyboard Event run action must resolve screens by arming its CC followers and choosing screens, rather than only firing a run action.

rules.quote: With NOTHING attached it falls back to `firePresentingFlowRunAction` for the toast.
rules.rule: When a Keyboard Event run action has nothing attached, fall back to firing the presenting flow run action to show the toast.

rules.quote:
Registering through the app's keyboard
  LAYER (not a raw window listener) is what lets a modal take the key back.
rules.rule: Register Keyboard Event shortcuts through the app's keyboard layer rather than a raw window listener, so modals can take the key back.

rules.quote: The widget now focuses itself on open
rules.rule: When the presenting flow preview widget opens, focus it automatically so the operator's first key press is handled.

rules.quote: Leaving it as the latter would have made a `Keyboard Event`'s followers TARGETS
rules.rule: Do not treat a Keyboard Event run action as a CC target host; its CC followers must not be targets.

rules.quote: `isScreenPinnable` includes it
rules.rule: Include the Keyboard Event run action in the isScreenPinnable check so the pin is read for its followers' screens.

rules.quote: when a lyric slide misbehaves, check whether it is a structure slide or an appended attachment slide before suspecting the stage.
rules.rule: When a lyric slide misbehaves, first check whether it is a structure slide or an appended attachment slide, before suspecting the stage document.

rules.quote: do not add it to `PresentingFlowItem.validate`
rules.rule: Do not add toPresentingFlowMediaControl to PresentingFlowItem.validate.

rules.quote: Every field but `mode` is absent-means-leave-alone
rules.rule: When a media-control field other than mode is absent, leave the existing value alone instead of applying a default.

rules.quote: An unset volume must not undo the level the operator set by hand on the mini screen
rules.rule: When the volume is unset, do not change the volume level the operator set by hand on the mini screen.

rules.quote: must do NOTHING
rules.rule: When a media-control pin names a screen the host never reached, do nothing.

rules.quote:
nothing under
  `_screen` may import the presenting flow
rules.rule: Do not import the presenting flow from any module under `_screen`.

rules.quote: Everything armed is dropped when the slide changes
rules.rule: When the slide changes, drop everything armed by media control, including pending pauses and timeupdate watchers.

rules.quote: One slot per SCREEN — a later controller supersedes the earlier one outright.
rules.rule: Keep one armed media-control controller per screen; a later controller replaces the earlier one entirely.

rules.quote: `stopPropagation` is mandatory
rules.rule: The gear icon's click handler must call stopPropagation.

rules.quote: one module-level `Set` of subscribers + `useSyncExternalStore` per row
rules.rule: In the presenting flow on-screen marking, use one module-level Set of subscribers with useSyncExternalStore per row, so each row re-renders only when its own answer changes.

rules.quote: A single SHARED `genTimeoutAttempt(500)` is correct here
rules.rule: For presenting flow on-screen marking, use a single shared genTimeoutAttempt(500) debounce for all rows instead of per-instance timers.

rules.quote: never per file.
rules.rule: Call checkIsAnythingOnScreen() once in each of its two callers, never once per presenting flow file.

rules.quote: never call `getSlides()` from a check
rules.rule: Never call getSlides() from an on-screen check.

rules.quote: marquee and message rows match on TEXT
rules.rule: Match marquee and message rows in the on-screen preset matcher on their text.

rules.quote: `time`/`camera`/`screen` on id
rules.rule: Match time, camera, and screen rows in the on-screen preset matcher on their id.

rules.quote: `web`/`video`/`image` on filePath
rules.rule: Match web, video, and image rows in the on-screen preset matcher on their filePath.

rules.quote: `fill`/`animation` on their `src`
rules.rule: Match fill and animation rows in the on-screen preset matcher on their src.

rules.quote: Countdown / stopwatch / quick-text match on a ROW KEY
rules.rule: Match countdown, stopwatch, and quick-text rows on a row key, stamping rowKey = toForegroundRowKey(data) on what applyForegroundDragData puts up and comparing it in the matcher.

rules.quote: `foregroundOnScreenMatcherMap` is keyed by `ForegroundDragTargetType` on purpose
rules.rule: Key foregroundOnScreenMatcherMap by ForegroundDragTargetType.

rules.quote: never mark a PL presenting flow row BLOCKED "because it's dev-only"
rules.rule: Never mark a PL presenting flow row as BLOCKED on the grounds that the panel is dev-only.

rules.quote:
don't
re-add that caveat to a tutorial
rules.rule: Do not re-add the "dev only" caveat to a tutorial about the Presenting Flows panel.

rules.quote:
If a run on a packaged build can't find the panel, that
is a real finding, not the expected gate.
rules.rule: If a test run on a packaged build cannot find the Presenting Flows panel, report this as a real finding rather than treating it as the expected dev-only gate.

rules.quote: Space / ↓ / → / PageDown step FORWARD only
rules.rule: In the presenting flow preview widget, Space, ↓, → and PageDown step the run forward only.

rules.quote: never wrapping.
rules.rule: Never wrap the run back to element 1 when stepping forward in the presenting flow preview.

rules.quote: Gated on focus being inside the widget
rules.rule: Gate the preview widget's step keys on focus being inside the widget (container.contains(document.activeElement)).

rules.quote: the run only moves on once the cursor is on its last slide
rules.rule: Advance the run past a document element only once the cursor is on that document's last slide.

rules.quote: crossing INTO a document always starts at its FIRST slide
rules.rule: When the run crosses into a document element, start at its first slide, even if a middle slide is still live.

rules.quote: PARKED is the ONLY reason a line is stepped over
rules.rule: Step over a run line only when it is PARKED.

rules.quote: must not decide what is in the run
rules.rule: Do not let folding a document element decide what is in the run.

rules.quote: which must not run inside the commit that just mounted them
rules.rule: Dispatch the deferred slide-entry click in a later macrotask, not inside the commit that mounted the slide cards.

rules.quote: The widget focuses itself on open
rules.rule: Focus the preview widget itself when it opens.

rules.quote: never derived from the screens
rules.rule: Never derive the run cursor from the screens; use the panel's own cursor (selectingState.childId).

rules.quote: A keyboard step PROPAGATES A CLICK
rules.rule: For a keyboard step, dispatch a click on the target card rather than calling handleVarySlideSelecting directly.

rules.quote: Only what wears `cursor: pointer` moves the cursor
rules.rule: Move the run cursor only on a click whose event.target has computed cursor pointer.

rules.quote: BOTH must match to mark an element
rules.rule: Mark an element as selected only when both its key and its index match.

rules.quote: SEVERAL widgets may be open at once, one per FILE
rules.rule: Allow several presenting flow preview widgets to be open at once, one per file.

rules.quote: Slide cards inside the widget get a **restricted** right-click menu
rules.rule: Give slide cards inside the preview widget a restricted right-click menu limited to Show on Screens.

rules.quote: Bible entries render read-only for the same reason.
rules.rule: Render Bible entries read-only in the preview widget.

rules.quote: Measured against `findVerticalScrollingParent`, NOT the preview's own
rules.rule: Measure whether the run element hangs off the bottom against findVerticalScrollingParent, not the preview's own container.

rules.quote: What the run lands on is scrolled `nearest`, or CENTRED when it hangs off the bottom
rules.rule: Scroll the run's landing element into view with 'nearest', or center it when it hangs off the bottom.

rules.quote: inject state into
rules.rule: For presenting flow QA, inject test state into the `<presentingFlow>.owpf.histories/<n>-head` file, not the saved `.owpf` file.

rules.quote: Edit the `-head` file instead
rules.rule: When a change to an editable document must show up in the UI, edit its `-head` file under `.owpf.histories/` rather than the saved `.owpf`/`.ows` file, then use Reload.

rules.quote: check whether the file is history-backed
rules.rule: Before blaming a cache for stale-looking editable document state, check whether the document is history-backed.

rules.quote: read **both** the head file and the saved file
rules.rule: When a document value looks wrong, read both the `-head` file and the saved file before drawing conclusions, since they can legitimately differ while the document is dirty.

rules.quote: Never triage a cross-window propagation failure with "was it saved?"
rules.rule: Never triage a cross-window propagation failure by asking whether the document was saved, because saving does not determine what readers display.

rules.quote: A duration countdown stores `durationSecond`, not a resolved date
rules.rule: When storing a duration countdown preset in a presenting flow, store its `durationSecond` value, not a resolved date.

rules.quote: quick text stores its markdown, not rendered html
rules.rule: When storing quick text in a presenting flow, store its markdown source, not the rendered html.

rules.quote: both paths must keep producing the same result
rules.rule: Keep the `dragStore.onDropped` closure path and the serialized `handleDragStart` foreground path producing the same result when a foreground is dropped.

rules.quote: Every `Foreground*Comp` drag button now ALSO calls `handleDragStart` with a serialized `DragTypeEnum.FOREGROUND` payload
rules.rule: Make every `Foreground*Comp` drag button also call `handleDragStart` with a serialized `DragTypeEnum.FOREGROUND` payload.

rules.quote: Snapshotting the dragged slide JSON would silently project stale text.
rules.rule: Do not snapshot the dragged slide JSON into a presenting flow entry; store a file reference (`filePath` + `id`) and resolve it at click time.

rules.quote: `.owapf.tar.gz` via `tarCreate`/`tarExtract`, NOT a real zip
rules.rule: Export and import presenting flows as `.owapf.tar.gz` archives using `tarCreate`/`tarExtract`, not zip.

rules.quote:
The requirement was absolute: the old word appears nowhere in the
project, not even as a legacy constant.
rules.rule: Never leave the old subsystem name anywhere in the project, including as a legacy constant.

rules.quote:
Sweep
`src/lang/data/online/*/` (every language's `dictionary.json`, and its translated `manual/` and `questions.json`) for the old TERM in the target language on any future rename.
rules.rule: On any future rename, sweep every language folder under src/lang/data/online/ (dictionary.json, translated manual/, and questions.json) for the old term in each target language, not just English source and identifiers.

rules.quote:
`--no-playlist` in [src/server/appHelpers.ts](../../src/server/appHelpers.ts)
  (plus assertions in `appHelpers.test.tsx`) — yt-dlp's own
  CLI flag. Renaming it breaks every media download
rules.rule: Never rename the yt-dlp `--no-playlist` flag in src/server/appHelpers.ts or its assertions in appHelpers.test.tsx.

rules.quote:
`RUN_SHEET_PATTERN` (`src/chatbot/helpBotHelpers.ts`) matches the word as one a user may type —
  kept on purpose (the user's decision, 2026-10-11)
rules.rule: Keep the word 'playlist' in RUN_SHEET_PATTERN in src/chatbot/helpBotHelpers.ts unchanged, since it matches what a user may type.

rules.quote:
before any future sweep for a leftover, check the survivor
first.
rules.rule: Before any future sweep for a leftover old-name occurrence, check whether the match is a surviving lookalike (such as --no-playlist or HLS playlist terms) before changing it.

rules.quote:
If the migration ever needs extending, extend the discovery, not a
hard-coded name.
rules.rule: When extending the presenting flow rename migration, extend its discovery logic rather than hard-coding the old name.

rules.quote: `--no-playlist` in [src/server/appHelpers.ts](../../src/server/appHelpers.ts)
rules.rule: Do not sweep up or rename lookalike 'playlist' survivors such as the HLS playlist references in electron/ files.

rules.quote:
the migration itself is intact
(`src/helper/presentingFlowRenameMigration.ts`, claimed in `initPresentingFlowRenameMigration`, `src/boot.ts`)
rules.rule: Do not reintroduce the old word anywhere, including in the migration code, even for the migration itself.

rules.quote: Add an action = append to `presentingFlowActionList` + widen `PresentingFlowActionIdType`
rules.rule: To add a new presenting flow action, append it to presentingFlowActionList and widen the PresentingFlowActionIdType type.

rules.quote: a new FOREGROUND clear is just an entry in `foregroundClearMap`
rules.rule: To add a new foreground clear action, add an entry to foregroundClearMap.

rules.quote: Appending to `presentingFlowActionMenuList` is a SEPARATE decision
rules.rule: Decide separately whether to add a new presenting flow action to presentingFlowActionMenuList.

rules.quote: `acceptedDragTypeList` must keep refusing it
rules.rule: Keep acceptedDragTypeList refusing PRESENTING_FLOW_ACTION_TYPE so that nothing else can produce a presenting flow action drag item.

rules.quote: Only the id is stored (`{type:'action', data:id}`)
rules.rule: When storing a presenting flow action, store only its id (as {type:'action', data:id}), plus actionNumber for run-family actions, and do not store a captured title.

rules.quote: the number is appended AFTER `tran`, never baked into the key
rules.rule: Append actionNumber after calling tran() on the label, never include the number in the translation key.

rules.quote: Reuse a label the app already ships
rules.rule: Reuse an existing shipped label for a new action when one fits.

rules.quote: the key must be added to every
rules.rule: When a new action needs a label the app does not already ship, add the translation key to every language's dictionary.

rules.quote: Narrow with `PresentingFlowItem.screenAction` / `.runAction`, never `action.apply` behind an
rules.rule: Narrow presenting flow items with PresentingFlowItem.screenAction or PresentingFlowItem.runAction, never by calling action.apply behind an isAction test.

rules.quote: Everything routes through `sendPresentingFlowItemToScreens`
rules.rule: Route all presenting flow action items through sendPresentingFlowItemToScreens in presentingFlowHelpers.ts.

rules.quote: a run action is peeled off BEFORE `armPresentingFlowCcPropagation`
rules.rule: Peel run actions off in sendPresentingFlowItemToScreens before calling armPresentingFlowCcPropagation.

rules.quote: Colours mirror the clear bar's button variants
rules.rule: Colour new screen action icons to mirror the button variants of the mini screen's clear bar.

rules.quote: they use `--bs-gray-500`
rules.rule: Use --bs-gray-500 as the colour for actions whose clear-bar variant is secondary.

rules.quote: must keep overriding a pin
rules.rule: Show on Screens and dragging onto a mini screen must keep overriding a pinned preset, so the operator always has a one-off escape hatch.

rules.quote: Precedence: force → preset → selected → menu.
rules.rule: When choosing screens, apply the precedence force, then preset, then selected screens, then menu.

rules.quote: every one of those paths ALSO has to arm the CC followers
rules.rule: Every presenting path that presents a flow item or slide must also arm the CC followers.

rules.quote: `screenChoosingHelpers.ts` must stay a leaf.
rules.rule: Keep screenChoosingHelpers.ts a leaf module; do not add imports to it that pull in the settings or file graph, such as a translation import.

rules.quote: Getters read defensively (`toScreenIds`) instead of `validate` throwing
rules.rule: Pin getters should read defensively via toScreenIds rather than calling validate, which throws.

rules.quote: a bad pin must never turn a row into an error row mid-service.
rules.rule: A bad pin must never turn a presenting flow row into an error row.

rules.quote: never a silent fallback to the selected screens.
rules.rule: When a pinned screen is gone, show the 'Failed to apply to screen' toast and project nowhere; never silently fall back to the selected screens.

rules.quote: Audio and error rows stay out.
rules.rule: Audio rows and error rows must not be pinnable.

rules.quote: so it must be pinnable
rules.rule: A document must be pinnable, even though it is never shown as a unit.

rules.quote: DELETES the key (and the map with it)
rules.rule: When a slide's pin list is emptied, delete its key from slideScreenIds, and delete the map too if it becomes empty.

rules.quote: clearing a slide hands it BACK to the document rather than pinning it to nothing.
rules.rule: Clearing a slide's pin must return the slide to the document's screens, not pin it to an empty set.

rules.quote: keyed by slide ID, not position
rules.rule: Key per-slide pins (slideScreenIds) by slide ID, not by slide position.

rules.quote: inherits the document's `screenIds`
rules.rule: A slide with no entry in slideScreenIds uses the document's screenIds.

rules.quote: BEFORE the line is written
rules.rule: When adding a Screen: Show or Screen: Hide action from the Add Action menu, ask the user to choose screens before the action line is written, and add nothing if the user cancels.

rules.quote: an empty tick is refused with `Please choose at least one screen`
rules.rule: When the screen checklist for a Screen: Show or Screen: Hide action is submitted with no screens ticked, refuse it with the message `Please choose at least one screen`.

rules.quote: an empty list omits the key rather than storing `[]`
rules.rule: When saving a Screen: Show or Screen: Hide action with no screens selected, omit the screenIds key instead of storing an empty array.

rules.quote: refuses with the same toast
rules.rule: When sending a presenting flow item to screens for a Screen: Show or Screen: Hide action whose screenIds pin is empty, refuse with the same toast and do not fall back to the selected screens or show a screen-choice menu.

rules.quote: does not rewrite the pin
rules.rule: When the Apply on Screens entry is used for a Screen: Show or Screen: Hide action, still ask the user which screens to use, and do not overwrite the action's screenIds pin.

rules.quote: `apply` reads `isShowing` before writing.
rules.rule: In the apply step of Screen: Show and Screen: Hide, read screenManager.isShowing first and only write it when the value needs to change.

rules.quote: Icons/colours mirror the mini screen toggle
rules.rule: Give Screen: Show and Screen: Hide the same icons, colours, and ON/OFF badges as the mini screen toggle.

rules.quote: Menu order is clears → FG group → these two → run family.
rules.rule: Order the presenting flow Add Action menu as clears, then the FG group, then Screen: Show and Screen: Hide, then the run family.

rules.quote: `npx prettier --tab-width 4 --write <file>`
rules.rule: When formatting any .mjs file with prettier, run `npx prettier --tab-width 4 --write <file>` so the file keeps its 4-space indentation.

rules.quote: look at `git diff --stat`
rules.rule: After running prettier on a .mjs file, check `git diff --stat` to confirm the diff is limited to the lines you changed.

rules.quote: leave those as they are rather than formatting them whole
rules.rule: Do not run prettier on whole files that were hand-wrapped and never prettier-clean (such as `llm-tunnel.mjs`); leave their formatting unchanged.

rules.quote: Any future change to a `flexSizeDefault` of a pane users have already seen has the same problem.
rules.rule: When changing the flexSizeDefault of a pane that users have already seen, add a one-off migration for stored layouts, because a changed default is not applied to files that already have a stored layout.

rules.quote: which writes exactly what _Close Second Widget_ writes and skips a layout already collapsed
rules.rule: A one-off layout migration should write exactly what the Close Second Widget action writes, and should skip any layout that is already collapsed.

rules.quote: Do not fold their helpers together
rules.rule: Do not merge the helper functions of the Public Domain Songs plugin with those of the song-select plugin.

rules.quote: to add songs, append to `publicDomainSongsData.json`
rules.rule: To add songs to the Public Domain Songs catalog, append new records to publicDomainSongsData.json.

rules.quote: Texts must avoid `[`/`]`, backticks and leading `//`
rules.rule: Keep song texts in the Public Domain Songs catalog free of square brackets, backticks, and a leading //.

rules.quote: `Structure` strings MAY repeat
rules.rule: Structure strings in open-lyric may repeat a section code.

rules.quote: repeats `C` after every verse
rules.rule: For a hymn with a refrain, declare one Chorus fence and repeat C after every verse in its Structure string.

rules.quote: Don't file them again.
rules.rule: Do not re-file the listed presenter behaviours (blank first slide card, bible item replacing background, video time sync console spam, PDF full-width blank output, OBS Virtual Camera spinner) as bugs.

rules.quote: when a QA observation looks wrong, read the source before filing
rules.rule: When a QA observation looks wrong, read the source code before filing it as a bug.

rules.quote: present onto an **empty** layer
rules.rule: To QA the screen block without disturbing a live setup, present onto an empty layer.

rules.quote: note that the background will still change.
rules.rule: When presenting a bible item onto an empty layer for QA, note that the background will still change.

rules.quote: check `el.isConnected` before trusting a measurement
rules.rule: Before trusting a measurement taken with a probe listener on the mini-preview video element, check that the element is still connected (`el.isConnected`).

rules.quote: Flip to `Not Full Width` to confirm the contain path
rules.rule: To confirm the contain path for a PDF slide with a blank projector output, switch On Screen Width to Not Full Width.

rules.quote: put the setting back
rules.rule: After testing with On Screen Width set to Not Full Width, restore the original pdf-full-width setting.

rules.quote: Whenever the knowledge changes, update this folder in the same change.
rules.rule: Whenever the app's knowledge changes, update the question corpus folder (tools/owa-devtools-mcp/questions/) in the same change.

rules.quote: Add, reword or delete the affected questions
rules.rule: When the knowledge changes, add, reword, or delete the affected questions in the corpus.

rules.quote: bump the file's `updated` date
rules.rule: When changing a corpus file, bump its `updated` date.

rules.quote: Check `owa_app_state`
rules.rule: Before saving a corpus file, check `owa_app_state` to see whether an app run is up.

rules.quote: the LAST write of the change and say so, or ask.

rules.quote: Extend the list there, not at the call sites.

save `git diff --cached --name-only`

patch for every file shown `MM` (staged in part)

the fully staged files again

rules.quote: Never stash (the `owa-gi` rule)

rules.quote: do not add a visible error for a `.json` that is not a link list

rules.quote: do not widen the scheme allowlist

rules.quote: Reads are on demand and uncached

rules.quote: as the row appears for a verse match

rules.quote:
Do not "fix" this with
a watcher.

rules.quote: never a drag or a present

rules.quote: deliberately does NOT import `genCommonMenu`

rules.quote: Truncation is surfaced in the UI, never silent.

rules.quote: deliberately NOT removed with a folder

rules.quote: The list is persisted from the handlers,

paths go through `escapeHtmlText` before the composed

rules.quote: and never overwrites

rules.quote: A disk failure is RETURNED, not thrown

rules.quote: Tests to copy from

rules.quote: don't reintroduce a hover timer for this

rules.quote:
don't hand-roll a
reveal — push `genRevealOriginal(...)` into the row's menu.
rules.rule: Do not hand-roll a custom reveal mechanism for presenting flow entry origins; instead push genRevealOriginal(...) into the row's context menu.

rules.quote: test THAT area only
rules.rule: When the user scopes a robot test to a specific area, test only that area.

rules.quote: are out of scope unless the user asks for them

rules.quote: before adding a block or a row, ask whether it is the named area

rules.quote: a drop INTO a chosen folder or a copy TO a chosen place is path selection

rules.quote: outside the area is reported, not chased.
rules.rule: When a fault is found outside the user's named test area, report it without investigating or testing it further.

rules.quote: stop testing and report what was run
rules.rule: When the user asks for a report, stop testing and report what was run.

rules.quote: and `<scratch>\data` created

rules.quote: stop it by pid before the session ends
rules.rule: Stop the scratch instance by its pid before the session ends.

rules.quote: Seed `stay-awake` false as above,

rules.quote: Launch the scratch instance with

rules.quote: Not `npm run dev` and not `electron:build`.

rules.quote: the `.js` for a main-process change before counting on it.

rules.quote: then read the new target out of `<data dir>/local-storage/screen-ft-manager`

rules.quote: Do NOT put clear/request in a React effect cleanup
rules.rule: Do not put clear or sync-request calls in a React effect cleanup; trigger them from the toggle click handler instead.

rules.quote: Do NOT re-merge `setupContainer` into
rules.rule: Do not merge `setupContainer` back into the per-frame `syncCanvasSize` render path; keep canvas creation and styling separate from per-frame resizing.

rules.quote: NEVER per pointer-move
rules.rule: Never call `saveDrawData` on each pointer move; save only on committed events.

rules.quote: `saveDrawData` fires on committed events only
rules.rule: Call `saveDrawData` only for committed events (stroke-complete, undo, redo, clear, enable, disable, and receiveSyncScreen sync/commit/clear).

rules.quote: every LOCAL send MUST call

rules.quote: read off `canvas.getRootNode().activeElement`, NOT `document.activeElement`
rules.rule: Read overlay focus from `canvas.getRootNode().activeElement`, not `document.activeElement`, because the overlay lives in a shadow root.

rules.quote: needs TWO pointer-downs (or a `focus()`) first.
rules.rule: In tests that draw strokes with synthetic pointer events, issue two pointer-downs or call `focus()` first.

rules.quote: It deliberately does **not** `preventDefault()`
rules.rule: Do not call `preventDefault()` in the palette shortcut handler, so other overlay panels' listeners still run.

rules.quote: Bindings must stay in sync with the button `title`s via `toShortcutTitle`.
rules.rule: Keep the palette shortcut bindings in sync with the button titles by generating the titles via `toShortcutTitle`.

rules.quote: Panel buttons carry `onMouseDown={handleKeepOverlayFocus}` (preventDefault).
rules.rule: Give every palette panel button `onMouseDown={handleKeepOverlayFocus}` so clicking a button does not move focus off the canvas.

rules.quote: `checkIsDrawShortcutKey` MUST resolve the key with
rules.rule: Resolve the key in `checkIsDrawShortcutKey` with `KeyboardEventListener.toEnUsKey(event)`, not `event.key`.

rules.quote: `undo`/`redo` are deliberately NOT bound in the panel
rules.rule: Do not bind undo or redo in the draw panel; the canvas keydown handler already consumes those keys.

rules.quote: The panel's arming effect (setPaintTool) can stay in an effect
rules.rule: The panel may keep its setPaintTool arming logic in a React effect because it is local and idempotent.

rules.quote: NOT driven from an effect
rules.rule: Do not drive the render-quality toggle from a React effect; call `setRenderQuality` from the handler.

rules.quote: Eraser strokes force `isStraight/is3D/isDots` to FALSE at creation

rules.quote: `handlePointerDown` bails on `event.button !== 0`.

rules.quote: switch to normalized 0..1 coords if that ever matters.

rules.quote: it gates BOTH the palette

rules.quote: `isFocused` also requires `document.hasFocus()`

rules.quote: Full `sync` snapshot only on init/screen-show.
rules.rule: Send a full `sync` snapshot only on initialization or screen show, never per move.

rules.quote: CLONE incoming data
rules.rule: When receiving a sync message, clone the incoming data instead of keeping shared object references.

rules.quote: coordinates are NATIVE screen pixels
rules.rule: Store stroke coordinates in native screen pixels of the source screen.

rules.quote: clears ONLY if no other group member has `isDrawEnabled`
rules.rule: When disabling draw, clear the shared drawing only if no other sync-group member still has `isDrawEnabled`.

rules.quote: `receiveSyncScreen` calls `forwardToOwnScreenOutput(data)`
rules.rule: In draw's `receiveSyncScreen`, call `forwardToOwnScreenOutput(data)` so the screen's own output window receives group updates.

rules.quote: extend `DrawDataType`
rules.rule: To add a new draw mode, extend `DrawDataType`.

rules.quote: add render + a sync action
rules.rule: To add a new draw mode, add its render logic and a sync action.

rules.quote: deliberately never on mere focus

rules.quote: deliberately NOT persisted

rules.quote: (the `?.` matters — preview test mocks lack `screenDrawManager`)

rules.quote: Do not merge them back.

rules.quote:
extend these rather than re-copying
into a third overlay
rules.rule: When adding overlay plumbing, extend the shared modules (screenOverlayHelpers.ts and miniScreenOverlayControlComps.tsx) rather than copying the code into a new overlay.

rules.quote: Keep them the same hue.
rules.rule: Keep the clear and dim colour stops of the focus mask gradient the same hue.

rules.quote: The clear stop is `#rrggbb00`, not the `transparent` keyword.
rules.rule: Use the dim colour at alpha 00 (#rrggbb00) as the clear gradient stop, never the transparent keyword.

rules.quote: don't "optimize" back to it.
rules.rule: Do not render the moving spotlight hole with a box-shadow; use the radial-gradient background on the overlay div.

rules.quote: No canvas on purpose

rules.quote: Repaints are rAF-coalesced

rules.quote: Also caches the overlay rect for the gesture
