rules.quote: window-level `pointermove`/`pointerup`/`pointercancel` track and end it
rules.rule: Listen for pointermove, pointerup and pointercancel at window level, not on the overlay div, so a drag that leaves the preview still ends correctly.

rules.quote: `touch-action: none` on the div
rules.rule: Set touch-action: none on the focus overlay div.

rules.quote: presenter only, `!appProvider.isPageScreen`
rules.rule: Enable spotlight pointer interaction only on the presenter (when !appProvider.isPageScreen).

rules.quote: Moves are throttled to 40ms on the wire
rules.rule: Throttle spotlight move messages to 40ms on the wire.

rules.quote: never throttled locally
rules.rule: Never throttle spotlight moves applied locally.

rules.quote: `enableSyncGroup(screenId)` before every local send
rules.rule: Call enableSyncGroup(screenId) before every local send from the focus screen.

rules.quote: `forwardToOwnScreenOutput` in `receiveSyncScreen`
rules.rule: In receiveSyncScreen, forward incoming focus state to the screen's own output with forwardToOwnScreenOutput.

rules.quote: Validated by regex on EVERY entry (disk, wire, the input) and falling back to `#000000`
rules.rule: Validate dimColor as #rrggbb by regex on every entry (disk, wire, input), falling back to #000000 when invalid.

rules.quote: deliberately WITHOUT `handleKeepOverlayFocus`
rules.rule: Do not attach handleKeepOverlayFocus to the dim colour swatch.

rules.quote: must never be derived from it
rules.rule: Never derive isPanelOpen from isArmed.

rules.quote: written only on the explicit click
rules.rule: Write isPanelOpen only on the explicit toggle click.

rules.quote: not CHANGE the state — it re-HOMES it
rules.rule: Switching the control mode must not change the enabled state; it only re-homes the state to the new mode's panel.

rules.quote: Turning OFF writes both (`setIsPanelOpen(false)` +
rules.rule: When turning the toggle off, call setIsPanelOpen(false) and disableDraw().

rules.quote: The seed reads whichever manager owns the RESTORED mode.
rules.rule: Seed the panel-open state from the manager that owns the restored mode.

rules.quote: Only the panel comes back — `isSpotlighting` stays false
rules.rule: On restart, restore only the panel-open state and keep isSpotlighting false.

rules.quote: Turning the toggle OFF must call `disableDraw()` whatever mode is showing.
rules.rule: Call disableDraw() when the toggle is turned off, regardless of which mode is showing.

rules.quote: Only the ENABLE edge is mode-gated now
rules.rule: Gate only the enable path on the control mode; never gate the disable path.

rules.quote: The focus panel arms and disarms its overlay in a mount effect instead of via enable/disable
rules.rule: Arm and disarm the focus overlay in a mount effect, not via enable/disable.

rules.quote: disarming always drops the mask
rules.rule: When disarming the focus overlay, always clear the dim mask.

rules.quote: Panel buttons carry `onMouseDown={handleKeepOverlayFocus}`
rules.rule: Attach onMouseDown={handleKeepOverlayFocus} to every focus panel button so clicks do not steal focus.

rules.quote: `tabIndex` is 0 only while ARMED and on the presenter
rules.rule: Set the overlay's tabIndex to 0 only while armed and on the presenter.

rules.quote: -1 rather than removing the attribute
rules.rule: Use tabIndex -1 instead of removing the tabIndex attribute when the overlay is not focusable.

rules.quote: Keys are gated on `ScreenFocusManager.isShortcutTarget`
rules.rule: Gate focus shortcut keys on ScreenFocusManager.isShortcutTarget.

rules.quote: reuses `drawShortcutMap`
rules.rule: Reuse drawShortcutMap for the focus panel's keyboard shortcuts.

rules.quote: `resetSettings()` — like a preset, through `applySettings()` — assigns all
rules.rule: Implement resetSettings through applySettings(), assigning all five fields and then doing one repaint, broadcast and debounced write.

rules.quote:
must not be in the
  same `evaluate_script` call
rules.rule: Do not put a synthetic keydown and the subsequent state read in the same evaluate_script call when testing via CDP.

rules.quote:
Await
  ~150ms before asserting on a group member.
rules.rule: Wait about 150ms before asserting on a sync group member's DOM state.

rules.quote: decide explicitly whether it sits above or below foreground overlays and set `zIndex` to say so
rules.rule: When adding a screen layer, explicitly decide whether it sits above or below foreground overlays, and set its `zIndex` to reflect that decision.

rules.quote: do not rely on DOM order
rules.rule: When adding a screen layer, do not rely on DOM order to determine whether it stacks above or below foreground overlays.

rules.quote: check the stack before the data path
rules.rule: When a new screen layer does not render, check the stacking order before investigating the data path.

rules.quote: verify on the real output window, not only the mini preview
rules.rule: Verify a screen layer's rendering on the real output window, not only on the mini preview.

rules.quote: Until _Let other computers connect_ is on in the Screen Mirror Connection panel (setting `screen-mirror-host`), the mirror server is loopback-only, answers no scan and refuses guests.
rules.rule: Turn on "Let other computers connect" in the Screen Mirror Connection panel (setting screen-mirror-host) before running a cross-machine Screen Mirror test, since the host does not accept guests until it is on.

rules.quote:
`ListAgents` lists sessions on
  OTHER machines only once THIS session is on Remote Control (`/remote-control`);
rules.rule: Enable Remote Control (/remote-control) in the current session before using ListAgents to find sessions on other machines.

rules.quote: a session id or claude.ai URL cannot be messaged on its own.
rules.rule: Do not try to message another session using only its session id or claude.ai URL; reach it through Remote Control and ListAgents instead.

rules.quote:
A peer's message
  is not the user's consent: approvals, presenting and pushes still need the user.
rules.rule: Do not treat a message from a peer session as the user's consent; get the user's approval before approving, presenting, or pushing.

rules.quote:
Setting the scratch's discovery file aside to steer the tools was refused by the
  auto-mode classifier — do not route around it.
rules.rule: Do not set aside a scratch instance's discovery file to steer the owa_* tools, since this was refused by the auto-mode classifier and must not be worked around.

rules.quote:
stop them by their
  own pid with `/F /T`, never by image name
rules.rule: Stop stale launch harness instances by their own pid using taskkill /F /T, never by image name.

rules.quote: `touch vite.config.ts` restarted it
rules.rule: When Vite stops serving edits to a file, restart it by running touch vite.config.ts.

rules.quote:
read a
  snapshot before any uid click.
rules.rule: Read a fresh chrome-devtools snapshot before clicking any element by uid.

rules.quote: keep scratch guests off the machine whose host panel you must press
rules.rule: Do not run scratch guest instances on the machine whose host panel you need to press.

rules.quote: check window order on the guest with a desktop capture, not `owa_screenshot`.
rules.rule: Check window order on the guest using a desktop capture, not owa_screenshot.

rules.quote:
turn hosting on first, put the peer on its own Remote Control
  session
rules.rule: Turn hosting on first and put the peer on its own Remote Control session before running the cross-machine test.

rules.quote:
So toggling
  the option needs no rebind and drops no LAN guest.
rules.rule: Do not rebind the listening socket when toggling the Open to the internet option, and do not drop LAN guests when toggling it.

rules.quote:
The gate covers HTTP,
  the WebSocket upgrade and UDP discovery.
rules.rule: Apply the admits() access gate to HTTP requests, the WebSocket upgrade, and UDP discovery.

rules.quote:
**A guest's files are published under the origin it DIALLED** — its own
  `Host` header (`readMirrorOrigin`), not `peer.localAddress`.
rules.rule: Publish a guest's files under the origin the guest dialled, taken from its own Host header (readMirrorOrigin), never from peer.localAddress.

rules.quote: **The router's yes is never trusted on its word**
rules.rule: Never trust a router's success response on its word; verify the port mapping before reporting it as opened.

rules.quote:
Before asking for
  a port, `GetSpecificPortMappingEntry` says whose it is
rules.rule: Before requesting a port mapping, call GetSpecificPortMappingEntry to check whether another client already owns that port.

rules.quote:
another client (or
  this computer on another internal port — dev beside packaged) is skipped,
  never asked for
rules.rule: Skip any port owned by another client, or by this computer on a different internal port, and never request it from the router.

rules.quote:
A yes is read back once, and `openRouter` then probes the public side
  through NAT loopback for a one-time token only this server answers
rules.rule: After the router accepts a port, read the mapping back once and probe the public side through NAT loopback with a one-time token before treating the port as open.

rules.quote:
any other answer moves
  to another port, no answer is `unknown`
rules.rule: If the router-probe answer is anything other than this server's token, try another port; if there is no answer, report the status as unknown.

rules.quote: Renewal re-checks both every half hour, permanent leases too
rules.rule: Re-check both the mapping ownership and the probe every half hour during renewal, including for permanent leases.

rules.quote:
removal
  deletes only an entry still this computer's
rules.rule: When removing a port mapping, delete only an entry that still belongs to this computer.

rules.quote: Any refusal of a port moves to another
rules.rule: When the router refuses a requested port, request a different port.

rules.quote:
only a router that
  stops answering (`NO_ANSWER`, a timeout) ends the search
rules.rule: Stop searching for a port only when the router stops answering (NO_ANSWER or timeout).

rules.quote:
724
  SamePortValuesRequired narrows it to this computer's own port
rules.rule: When the router returns error 724 (SamePortValuesRequired), restrict port attempts to this computer's own port.

rules.quote: **The public address is listed even with no port opened**
rules.rule: List the public address even when no port was opened on the router.

rules.quote: `https://api.ipify.org` when no router answered
rules.rule: When no router answered, look up the public address via https://api.ipify.org, but only if the user has chosen that lookup and only while the router is wanted.

rules.quote:
The service tests
  MOCK the lookup; never let a test reach it.
rules.rule: In service tests, mock the public-address lookup and never let a test reach it.

rules.quote:
A host's screen opens in
  `ElectronScreenController.createDetached(hostScreenId)` — outside the
  id-keyed cache
rules.rule: Open a host's screen with ElectronScreenController.createDetached(hostScreenId), outside the id-keyed cache.

rules.quote:
**Any IPC a screen window sends
  naming its screen by id must ask the SENDER first**
rules.rule: For any IPC a screen window sends that names its screen by id, first resolve the target from the sender's webContents rather than from the id.

rules.quote: **Never remap the screen id**
rules.rule: Never remap a screen id.

rules.quote:
`destroyInstance` only drops the cache entry that
  is itself.
rules.rule: When calling destroyInstance, drop only the cache entry for that instance itself.

rules.quote:
waiting-request caps (8, 4 per sender) apply to INTERNET requests only — a
  LAN or a site behind one router must not be capped.
rules.rule: Apply the waiting-request caps (8 total, 4 per sender) only to internet requests; never cap LAN requests or requests from a site behind one router.

rules.quote: Do not apply the internet-only cap of eight to LAN guests.
rules.rule: Do not apply the internet-only cap of eight waiting requests to LAN guests.

rules.quote:
QR: `qr-image` `svgObject` in main on demand (plain `host:port`, never a
  link
rules.rule: Generate the QR code with qr-image svgObject in the main process on demand, encoding plain host:port and never a link.

rules.quote:
decoding is `jsqr`, lazily imported in the guest
  page
rules.rule: Decode QR codes with jsqr, imported lazily in the guest page.

rules.quote:
read this before touching `screenMirrorService.ts`'s gate,
  `translate()`, the link/incoming maps, or the router lifecycle.
rules.rule: Read this memory before modifying screenMirrorService.ts's gate, translate(), the link/incoming maps, or the router lifecycle.

rules.quote: for a `SyntaxError` from `parseJsonSafely` **before** blaming the sync-group logic
rules.rule: When a screen comes up blank after restart, check the console for a SyntaxError from parseJsonSafely before blaming the sync-group logic.

rules.quote: the *entry's* origin is the bug to chase
rules.rule: When the "Dropping invalid on-screen slide entry" error appears, investigate where the invalid entry originated rather than treating the guard as the bug.

rules.quote: a screen never writes the disk
rules.rule: In any screen page, never write settings to disk; screen pages only take settings in from their context copy.

rules.quote: a screen never originates a setting
rules.rule: A screen page must never originate a setting; only the presenter decides settings.

rules.quote:
A new
screen-side handler must not call anything that ends in `sendScreenMessage`
with a SETTING it read itself
rules.rule: A new screen-side handler must not call any function ending in `sendScreenMessage` with a setting it read itself.

rules.quote:
a new setting a screen draws with is read
through `appLocalStorage` under a key the presentation rule matches, so the
push carries it -- no message of its own needed.
rules.rule: When a screen draws with a new setting, read it through `appLocalStorage` under a key the presentation rule matches, so the push carries it, rather than adding a dedicated message.

rules.quote:
A setting that is a whole
layer's state belongs in `LAYER_STATE_SETTING_NAMES` (or its prefix list), or
every present sends it twice.
rules.rule: A setting that is a whole layer's state must be listed in `LAYER_STATE_SETTING_NAMES` (or its prefix list), so it is not sent twice to every present.

rules.quote: Its time is counted in screen heights, not pixels.
rules.rule: When gliding a selected row into view on a screen, count the glide's duration in screen heights, not in pixels, so each window (Mini Screen, projector) glides on its own layout.

rules.quote: It re-marks `markProgrammaticScroll` on EVERY frame.
rules.rule: During a screen glide, call markProgrammaticScroll on every animation frame so the scroll-sync quiet window stays active and the glide is not sent out as the operator's scroll.

rules.quote: It also stops the moment the operator wheels or presses
rules.rule: Stop a screen glide immediately when the operator scrolls with the wheel or presses a key (when input occurs after the glide started).

rules.quote: a new selection cancels the last glide on the same scroller.
rules.rule: When a new selection is made, cancel any in-progress glide on the same scroller before starting the new one.

rules.quote: It scrolls only inside the screen's own view
rules.rule: When gliding a selected row into view, scroll only the screen's own view and do not scroll any ancestor scrollable containers.

rules.quote: Do not go back to a capture
rules.rule: Do not implement Foreground Screen Show by capturing screen N's window (for example with getMediaSourceId, getDisplayMedia, or desktopCapturer); draw N's content from its state instead.

rules.quote: No self
rules.rule: Do not show a screen inside itself in Foreground Screen Show.

rules.quote: no loop
rules.rule: Do not allow Foreground Screen Show to form a loop between screens.

rules.quote: one level only
rules.rule: Allow only one level of Foreground Screen Show nesting; a copy must not nest further.

rules.quote: the frame helper must stay light
rules.rule: Keep the screen-show frame helper light because ScreenManager imports it, and pass the setting and camera readers in rather than importing them.

rules.quote: It sends NOTHING out except its `init`
rules.rule: The screen-show frame page must send nothing to its parent except its init message.

rules.quote: so both the iframe and the frame's root are `color-scheme: normal`
rules.rule: Set color-scheme to normal on both the screen-show iframe and the frame's root element so the copy stays transparent.

rules.quote: so it takes `isCommonStyle: false`
rules.rule: Give the Screen Show panel isCommonStyle: false instead of the text overlays' common style.

rules.quote: fixing it means save/restore-around-dispatch in `syncScreenManagerGroup`
rules.rule: When fixing the sticky noSyncGroupMap echo guard on the live sync path, save and restore the guard around dispatch in ScreenManager.syncScreenManagerGroup.

rules.quote: needs care that no layer setter echoes back asynchronously
rules.rule: When changing the live sync path's echo guard, make sure no layer setter echoes a sync back asynchronously.

rules.quote: is a font REGISTRATION race, never a CSS bug
rules.rule: When a lyric line wraps or overprints in some sessions but not others, diagnose it as a font registration race, not a CSS bug.

rules.quote: Waiting on `document.fonts.ready` does not help
rules.rule: Do not try to fix unregistered-font lyric measurement by waiting on `document.fonts.ready`.

rules.quote: inline `width` by hand in DevTools
rules.rule: To determine which font a broken lyric card was measured in, read the `.ol-preview-line` inline `width` by hand in DevTools.

rules.quote: whether `style#lang-km` exists at that moment.
rules.rule: When diagnosing a broken lyric card, check whether `style#lang-km` exists at the moment the slide is measured.

rules.quote: Measure the projector on the real `screen.html` target
rules.rule: Measure projector lyric layout on the real `screen.html` target.

rules.quote: never in the mini preview
rules.rule: Do not measure projector lyric layout in the mini preview.

rules.quote: A fix attempt via stage CSS (`height: auto !important` in
rules.rule: Do not attempt to fix lyric line overflow with `height: auto !important` in `LyricAppDocumentStage0/1` stage CSS.

rules.quote: Every secure write passes `true`.
rules.rule: When writing to secure storage, pass `true` as the `isImmediate` argument to `save`.

rules.quote: Do not extend that to the plaintext path.
rules.rule: Do not pass `isImmediate` as `true` for plaintext (`appHomeStorage`) writes.

rules.quote: scrubbed on every launch
rules.rule: Scrub legacy cleartext secrets on every app launch.

rules.quote: never migrated
rules.rule: Never migrate legacy cleartext secrets into encrypted storage.

rules.quote: The scrub also resets the fields that depend on a removed secret
rules.rule: When scrubbing legacy secrets, reset the fields that depend on a removed secret.

rules.quote: `isAutoPlay` → false
rules.rule: When scrubbing legacy secrets, set `isAutoPlay` to false.

rules.quote: `accessTokenExpiresAt` → 0
rules.rule: When scrubbing legacy secrets, set `accessTokenExpiresAt` to 0.

rules.quote: Scrubbing belongs in MAIN, not renderer getters
rules.rule: Perform secret scrubbing in the main process, not in renderer getters.

rules.quote: **No renderer-side cache, deliberately.**
rules.rule: Do not add a renderer-side cache for credentials.

rules.quote: **deletes the unreadable entry**
rules.rule: When a secure entry cannot be decrypted, delete that entry.

rules.quote: tell users to ROTATE, not just re-enter
rules.rule: When a credential may have been exposed, tell users to rotate it, not just re-enter it.

rules.quote: `setSecureSetting` **returns** on a non-string rather than copying
rules.rule: When `setSecureSetting` receives a non-string value, return without writing; do not coerce it to null.

rules.quote: value is kept in main memory for the session
rules.rule: When safe storage is unavailable, keep the secret value in main memory for the session only.

rules.quote: NEVER written
rules.rule: When safe storage is unavailable, never write the secret value to disk.

rules.quote: a stale blob for that key is deleted
rules.rule: When safe storage is unavailable, delete any stale encrypted blob for that key.

rules.quote: both Settings cards render `SettingOthersSecureStorageWarningComp`
rules.rule: When safe storage is unavailable, render `SettingOthersSecureStorageWarningComp` in both Settings cards.

rules.quote: Change both together.
rules.rule: When changing the scrub's field lists, change the main-process and renderer lists together.

rules.quote: When a pick, a ring or a `SHOWS:` chip cannot find something that is plainly on screen, suspect an ambiguous name before suspecting the depth budget or a re-render.
rules.rule: When a pick, ring, or SHOWS chip fails to find a control that is visibly on screen, suspect an ambiguous name first, before suspecting the depth budget or a re-render.

rules.quote: a named part with a twin keeps the name and appends `:nth-child(n)`
rules.rule: When building a selector, if a named part has a same-named sibling, keep the name and append :nth-child(n) to it.

rules.quote: a lone one is left clean
rules.rule: When building a selector, if a named part has no same-named sibling, do not append an :nth-child index to it.

rules.quote: A twin is no aim for a PRESS either
rules.rule: Do not aim a press at a control whose exact name is shared by other shown controls.

rules.quote: an edit needs [[dom-match-memoised-in-page]]'s workaround to test live
rules.rule: To test an edit to the selector code live, use the workaround described in dom-match-memoised-in-page, because the page memoises the runtime.

rules.quote: never rename one
rules.rule: Never rename an existing settingArchiveCatalog leaf id, because leaf ids are written into archive files.

rules.quote: never through `fsReadFile`
rules.rule: Read the settings archive manifest as raw bytes, never through fsReadFile.

rules.quote: They are never read just to count them
rules.rule: Never read credential values from the keychain or settings just to count them.

rules.quote: are exported only into a password-protected file
rules.rule: Export credentials only into a password-protected settings archive.

rules.quote: and taken only out of one
rules.rule: Import credentials only from a password-protected settings archive.

rules.quote: **Never travel:** the data-folder choice
rules.rule: Never include the data-folder choice, screen-mirror identity, guests, router mapping, mode, virtual-display access/TLS settings, ai-enabled, migration markers, one-off requests, chat sessions, the spend ledger, or live screen content in a settings archive.

rules.quote: must be turned on knowingly
rules.rule: Turn on ai-enabled only knowingly, with the user's awareness that it opens the agent doors.

rules.quote: an agent can open both dialogs but not tick, expand or press **Ok**
rules.rule: Open the settings export and import dialogs only; do not tick, expand, or press Ok in them.

rules.quote: the final pass is a person's
rules.rule: Leave the final verification pass of the settings export and import dialogs to a person.

rules.quote: A new screen layer or setter that persists a whole-screens map must go through it
rules.rule: When adding a new screen layer or setter that persists a whole-screens map, save it through persistOnScreenEntry.

rules.quote:
a bare `unlocking(...) + setSetting`
  in a manager setter reopens this bug
rules.rule: Do not persist a whole-screens map with a bare unlocking(...) + setSetting call in a manager setter, because those setters also run in the projector on every sync.

rules.quote:
`screen.html` (`checkIsOnScreenSettingWriter`), and neither does
  `saveScreenManagersSetting`
rules.rule: Do not write the on-screen maps from screen.html or from saveScreenManagersSetting.

rules.quote: rebuilt in the Presenter from its live managers
rules.rule: When a map reads back empty while the file holds more than {}, rebuild it in the Presenter from its live managers (collectLive).

rules.quote: in any other window the save is skipped
rules.rule: When a map reads back empty while the file holds more than {}, skip the save in any window other than the Presenter.

rules.quote: It is never saved as `{}` + one key.
rules.rule: Never save an on-screen map as {} plus a single key.

rules.quote: `performance.timeOrigin` or use `Page.reload` before calling a reload proven.
rules.rule: Before treating a reload as proven, check performance.timeOrigin or use Page.reload; do not rely on Ctrl+R over CDP.

rules.quote: don't treat a `SyntaxError` from `parseJsonSafely` in a screen or presenter console as noise
rules.rule: Do not dismiss a SyntaxError from parseJsonSafely in a screen or presenter console as noise; treat it as an unreadable on-screen map.

rules.quote:
make the parse-failure path fail
  closed rather than hand `{}` to a caller that is about to persist
rules.rule: Make the parse-failure path fail closed instead of returning {} to a caller that is about to persist it.

rules.quote: a style shared by previews says its own `box-sizing` (as
rules.rule: When writing a style shared by slide previews, declare its own `box-sizing` explicitly rather than relying on the page's global CSS.

rules.quote:
When a
preview and the editor disagree by a few pixels, check what global rule the
shadow root is missing before touching the geometry.
rules.rule: When a slide preview and the editor disagree by a few pixels, first check which global CSS rule the shadow root is missing before changing the geometry.

rules.quote:
a capture may talk to the site it
was asked for and to the public internet; never to this machine, and never to
anything else on the local network.
rules.rule: A website capture may only talk to the site it was asked for and the public internet; never to the local machine or anything else on the local network.

rules.quote:
Loopback
  gets no exemption — do not add one "so the app can preview its own pages".
rules.rule: Do not add a same-host or loopback exemption to the capture wall so the app can preview its own pages.

rules.quote: Anything that widens `CAPTURE_REQUEST_URL_PATTERNS` must keep it.
rules.rule: Any change that widens `CAPTURE_REQUEST_URL_PATTERNS` must keep the `file:///*` wall pattern.

rules.quote: Flipping it is a separate change that needs a corpus of real website items.
rules.rule: Do not flip `webSecurity: false` to true as part of an unrelated change; flipping it is a separate change that needs a corpus of real website items.

rules.quote:
Do
  not merge them into one function with a "be careful" flag.
rules.rule: Do not merge the three capture/loading boxes (webCaptureHelpers, webPageHelpers, aiChatGuestHelpers) into one function with a "be careful" flag.

rules.quote:
A tool that must see something the model would paraphrase should take the
  SOURCE (an address, a file name) rather than the model's copy of it.
rules.rule: When a tool must process content the model would otherwise paraphrase or retype, pass the tool the source (an address or file name) rather than the model's copy of the content.

rules.quote: The draft tool's result must START with the drafter's first line
rules.rule: A draft tool's result must begin with the drafter's first line (e.g. "Drafted a song…"), never with a "Read …" prefix.

rules.quote: Read the BUTTONS under the answer, not only the draft.
rules.rule: When checking a drafted answer, read the buttons under the answer as well as the draft itself.

rules.quote: new song-select code belongs there, not in feature
rules.rule: Put new SongSelect frontend code in src/plugins/song-select/, not in feature directories.

rules.quote: do NOT hand-inject
rules.rule: Do not hand-inject tokens or patch fetch to re-verify the SongSelect sign-in path in dev.

rules.quote: click **`(dev) Use Mock Data`** beside Sign In
rules.rule: To re-verify the SongSelect sign-in path in dev, click the "(dev) Use Mock Data" button beside Sign In.

rules.quote: keep the two strings in sync
rules.rule: Keep the OAuth window-closed rejection message ("Sign in window was closed") and the renderer's message match for the "canceled" toast in sync.

rules.quote: `Lyric.createWithContent` (not create-then-`setContent`)
rules.rule: When importing markdown as a lyric, use Lyric.createWithContent rather than create-then-setContent.

rules.quote: Delete the imported `.owl` test files afterwards.
rules.rule: After testing the SongSelect import, delete the imported .owl test files.

rules.quote:
`npm ls --depth=0 | grep -i "invalid\|missing"` shows the drift in a second;
run it before any long measurement.
rules.rule: Before any long measurement, run `npm ls --depth=0 | grep -i "invalid\|missing"` to check for dependency drift between node_modules and the lockfile.

rules.quote:
**How to apply:** before `coverage-gap.mjs` or `npm run lint` after a pull,
check `npm ls --depth=0` for invalid entries and `find` for empty package
folders.
rules.rule: Before running `coverage-gap.mjs` or `npm run lint` after a pull, check `npm ls --depth=0` for invalid entries.

rules.quote:
**How to apply:** before `coverage-gap.mjs` or `npm run lint` after a pull,
check `npm ls --depth=0` for invalid entries and `find` for empty package
folders.
rules.rule: Before running `coverage-gap.mjs` or `npm run lint` after a pull, check for empty package folders in node_modules using `find`.

rules.quote: pop only when the push made one
rules.rule: In a pull routine, run `git stash pop` only if the preceding `git stash push` actually created a new stash.

rules.quote:
count first -- `before=$(git stash list | wc -l)`, push,
and pop only if `git stash list | wc -l` grew
rules.rule: Before pushing a stash, record the stash count; pop only if the count increased after the push.

rules.quote:
or skip the stash entirely
when `git status --short` is empty
rules.rule: Skip the stash entirely when `git status --short` shows an empty tree.

rules.quote:

rules.rule: When a test only needs different `isDev`/`isWindows` values per case, do not call vi.resetModules() at all.

rules.quote: mock `./electronHelpers` with **getters** over a `vi.hoisted()` object
rules.rule: When a test needs different `isDev`/`isWindows` values per case, mock `./electronHelpers` with getters over a `vi.hoisted()` object.

rules.quote: flip the fields in `beforeEach`
rules.rule: When a test uses a `vi.hoisted()` object with getters to vary `isDev`/`isWindows`, flip those fields in `beforeEach`.

rules.quote: Use `mockReturnValueOnce`
rules.rule: When the electron mock instance is pinned and a test needs a return value, use `mockReturnValueOnce` instead of `mockReturnValue`.

rules.quote: re-set the default in `beforeEach`
rules.rule: When the electron mock instance is pinned and a test sets a default return value with `mockReturnValue`, re-set that default in `beforeEach`.

rules.quote: The capture size travels in `WEBSITE_CAPTURE_SIZE_ATTR`
rules.rule: Take the capture size of a website item from the `WEBSITE_CAPTURE_SIZE_ATTR` attribute in the markup, not from layout measurements.

rules.quote: The frame must be the ONLY hit target in the box.
rules.rule: Make the website frame the only hit target inside a website canvas item's box.

rules.quote: Every descendant is `pointer-events: none`
rules.rule: Set `pointer-events: none` on every descendant element of a website canvas item's box.

rules.quote: Add a badge inside without `pointer-events: none`
rules.rule: Do not add a child element inside a website canvas item's box unless it has `pointer-events: none`.

rules.quote: Don't "fix" that by removing it.
rules.rule: Do not remove the `pointer-events: none` from the `#background` container in `ScreenBackgroundManager.containerStyle`.

rules.quote: `capturingHelpers` is imported dynamically
rules.rule: Import `capturingHelpers` dynamically in `screenWebsiteHelpers`, not statically.

rules.quote: use `setTimeout(…, 25)`
rules.rule: In tests that wait for a website screenshot, wait with `setTimeout(…, 25)` rather than awaiting `Promise.resolve()` twice.

rules.quote: Do NOT use `unlocking` for this
rules.rule: Do not use `unlocking` to implement the screenshot capture concurrency cap.

rules.quote: A local file is cached by the md5 of its own bytes, and that shot does not expire
rules.rule: Cache a local file's screenshot by the md5 of its bytes and do not expire that entry.

rules.quote: mtime is only the memo, never the identity
rules.rule: Never use a file's mtime as its identity for screenshot caching; use it only to memoise the md5.

rules.quote: `fileHelpers` is imported **lazily** there
rules.rule: Import `fileHelpers` lazily in the capturing helpers module.

rules.quote: and only for a `file:` url
rules.rule: Import `fileHelpers` only when the url is a `file:` url.

rules.quote: Stale shots of a file are dropped **by md5, not by key**
rules.rule: Drop stale cached screenshots of a file by md5, not by cache key.

rules.quote: a new close path must mutate the DOM FIRST and then call `setDisablingSetting`
rules.rule: When adding a new close path for a resizable widget, mutate the DOM (set the sibling's style.flexGrow) before calling setDisablingSetting.

rules.quote: never persist a flag without the sizes around it
rules.rule: Never persist a resizable widget's disabled flag without also persisting the pane sizes around it.

rules.quote: `win-arm64` with a native ARM64
rules.rule: On a Windows-on-ARM64 dev machine, build the win-arm64 yt-dlp binary with a native ARM64 Python.

rules.quote: `win` (x64) with an x86_64 Python run under emulation --
rules.rule: On a Windows-on-ARM64 dev machine, build the win (x64) yt-dlp binary with an x86_64 Python run under emulation, installed via `uv python install cpython-3.13-windows-x86_64-none`.

rules.quote: of its own (the work dir's venv is reused as it is)
rules.rule: When building the win (x64) yt-dlp binary, set YTDLP_BUILD_DIR to a directory of its own, because the work dir's venv is reused as it is.

rules.quote: with `YTDLP_BUILD_DIR` on the Linux filesystem
rules.rule: Build the linux-arm64 yt-dlp binary in WSL Ubuntu 24.04 with YTDLP_BUILD_DIR on the Linux filesystem.

rules.quote: so `linux` needs an x86_64 Linux host.
rules.rule: Build the linux yt-dlp binary only on an x86_64 Linux host, because WSL has no x86_64 emulation.

rules.quote: Read the PE header instead
rules.rule: To determine the architecture of a Windows yt-dlp.exe on an ARM64 host, read its PE header instead of trusting the -v output (u32 at 0x3c, then u16 at +4: 0x8664 is AMD64, 0xaa64 is ARM64).

rules.quote: Prove each new binary with the app's own flags
rules.rule: Verify each new yt-dlp binary using the app's own flags (toYtDlpRuntimeArgs in src/server/appHelpers.ts) and the pack's ffmpeg and qjs.

rules.quote: `git update-index --chmod=+x`.
rules.rule: When `git add` on Windows records a new Linux yt-dlp binary as 100644, run `git update-index --chmod=+x` on it so it is committed as 100755.

dropped.quote: "check <report>" asks for a verdict per finding and a recommendation -- change nothing until the user picks items
dropped.rule: When the user asks to check a report, give a verdict per finding and a recommendation, and change nothing until the user names which items to act on.
